## Chapter 1: The First Badge

Source: https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch01-first-badge/

You start in Pallet Town. Professor Oak has asked you and Blue to try for the Viridian Gym Leader job, and the road to it runs through Viridian Forest to Pewter City and your first Badge.

**Main quest in this chapter:** choose your starter, reach Viridian City, take Oak's Parcel back to Pallet Town, beat Blue on Route 22, cross Viridian Forest, then win the **Boulder Badge** from Brock in Pewter City.

Three things in this chapter can be lost for good, so do them before you move on: the Pallet Town send-off gifts (before you walk into Viridian), the Viridian Academy exchange students (before you leave Viridian northward; the challenge cannot actually be started in a normal game, see the quest) and the Pewter Pokémon Center's Elite Four Bruno (before Mt. Moon).

### Walkthrough

**Pallet Town.** Pick your starter in Professor Oak's lab. Then talk to Mom at home (she gives you the Running Shoes) and get the Town Map from Daisy before you leave town. Each starter has a send-off gift waiting in town: Pikachu from the man with the Eevee, Charmander from the man by the south fence, Bulbasaur from the Poliwag in your own kitchen.

**Opens up:**

- [Pallet Town: send-off gifts (one per starter, before Viridian)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch01-first-badge/#pallet-town-send-off-gifts-one-per-starter-before-viridian) Missable

**Route 1.** Head north. Green (Red if you are a girl) shows you how to catch a Pokémon. When the scene is over, the three Viridian thief quests are armed, one per starter.

**Viridian City.** Walking in from Route 1 plays Blue's scene beside the Pokémon Center: he gives you his number and heads for the Indigo Plateau. **This closes the Pallet Town send-off gifts for good.** From here on the town is yours. Your starter's thief quest, the would-be professor's quiz (Exp. Share) and the Pokémon Academy are open now (but its exchange-student challenge cannot be started, see the quest).

**Opens up:**

- [Viridian City: the would-be professor's quiz](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch01-first-badge/#viridian-city-the-would-be-professors-quiz)
- [Viridian City: the Meowth thief (Charmander starters only)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch01-first-badge/#viridian-city-the-meowth-thief-charmander-starters-only) Charmander only
- [Viridian City: the Pikachu thief (Bulbasaur starters only)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch01-first-badge/#viridian-city-the-pikachu-thief-bulbasaur-starters-only) Bulbasaur only
- [Viridian City: the Mankey thief (Pikachu starters only)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch01-first-badge/#viridian-city-the-mankey-thief-pikachu-starters-only) Pikachu only
- [Viridian City: Pokémon Academy exchange students (missable early)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch01-first-badge/#viridian-city-pok%C3%A9mon-academy-exchange-students-missable-early) Missable

**The parcel.** The clerk in the Viridian Poké Mart asks you to carry a parcel from Johto to Professor Oak. Take it back to Pallet Town; Oak thanks you with an Apricorn Box. You need that box to leave Viridian northward.

**Route 22.** Walk west from Viridian to the end of Route 22. Blue is stuck at the League guard (you need eight Badges to enter) and challenges you; beat him. You can't go north out of Viridian until you have done this.

**Leaving Viridian northward.** With the parcel delivered and Blue beaten, the road north opens. **This closes the Academy's exchange students** (Steven and Cynthia leave the classroom). Head north onto Route 2: fake police block the road to Pewter, so go through the gatehouse into Viridian Forest.

**Viridian Forest, south end.** The man in the south gatehouse offers $20,000 to bring back his runaway Snubbull; the Snubbull is playing with a Pidgey in the middle of the forest. The flower-garden woman on the east side gives you 2 Honey for scaring off the Spearow flock, and the Honey tree in the south-west spreads it for a weekday Bug Pokémon.

**Opens up:**

- [Viridian Forest: the runaway Snubbull ($20,000, one-time choice)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch01-first-badge/#viridian-forest-the-runaway-snubbull-20000-one-time-choice)
- [Viridian Forest: the flower garden and the Spearow (missable)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch01-first-badge/#viridian-forest-the-flower-garden-and-the-spearow-missable) Missable
- [Viridian Forest: the Honey tree (weekday Bug Pokémon)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch01-first-badge/#viridian-forest-the-honey-tree-weekday-bug-pok%C3%A9mon)

**The Team Rocket scene.** In the middle of the forest a Team Rocket grunt corners an Eevee. When the scene ends, you say you must hurry to the Viridian Gym for your assessment. Nurse Joy heals the Eevee, and it waits for you in the far north-east corner of the forest.

**Opens up:**

- [Viridian Forest: the rescued Eevee (optional)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch01-first-badge/#viridian-forest-the-rescued-eevee-optional)

**Viridian Gym (optional now, story whenever you enter).** The first time you walk into the Gym after the forest scene, Brock tells you the Gym Leader assessment deadline has passed, Blue becomes the Viridian Gym Leader and Brock leaves to run Misty's assessment in Cerulean. The Gym itself stays shut until much later (Giovanni is away).

**North exit of the forest.** Past the gatehouse, Route 2 continues north towards Pewter. A weak Charmander (Pikachu starters) or an abandoned Nidoran♀ with a man who wants it (other starters) wait just outside the exit. Both need something from Pewter City first: Pikachu starters must hear a Trainer in the Pewter Pokémon Center brag about his "garbage" Charmander; the others need a Friend Ball, which the warm-up Trainer in Pewter gives you after you beat him.

**Opens up:**

- [Route 2, north of Viridian Forest: the abandoned Charmander (Pikachu starters only)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch01-first-badge/#route-2-north-of-viridian-forest-the-abandoned-charmander-pikachu-starters-only) Pikachu only Missable
- [Route 2, north of Viridian Forest: Nidoran♀ and the Apricorn Ball maker (non-Pikachu starters)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch01-first-badge/#route-2-north-of-viridian-forest-nidoran-and-the-apricorn-ball-maker-non-pikachu-starters) Charmander / Bulbasaur only

**Pewter City.** Look around before the Gym: Anemone's flower garden on the hill (Sitrus Berries for the hiker's Hard Stone and the Sudowoodo man's TM69), the small house in the south-west for Apricorn Balls, and the Pokémon Center, where the Elite Four's Bruno will fight you once. **Blue ambushes you on the path between the Pokémon Center and the Gym**; beat him (a later Mt. Moon scene needs him). The Museum of Science has Steven, another companion you will want in Mt. Moon.

**Opens up:**

- [Pewter City: finding Brock (the Gym Leader's errands)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch01-first-badge/#pewter-city-finding-brock-the-gym-leaders-errands)
- [Pewter City: Sitrus Berries → Hard Stone → TM69](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch01-first-badge/#pewter-city-sitrus-berries--hard-stone--tm69)
- [Pewter City: the Apricorn Ball maker](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch01-first-badge/#pewter-city-the-apricorn-ball-maker) Missable
- [Pewter Pokémon Center: Elite Four Bruno (one attempt, before Mt. Moon)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch01-first-badge/#pewter-pok%C3%A9mon-center-elite-four-bruno-one-attempt-before-mt-moon) Missable

**The Pewter Gym.** Brock keeps leaving. Follow him from the Gym to the north-east house, then the museum (answer the siblings' quizzes), then Anemone's garden, and he finally battles you back at the Gym. Win the **Boulder Badge**, 5 TM39 Rock Tomb and Brock's number. With the badge you can use Rock Smash.

**Opens up:**

- [Field moves: which Badge each one needs](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch01-first-badge/#field-moves-which-badge-each-one-needs)

Quests in this chapter:

- Pallet Town: send-off gifts (one per starter, before Viridian)
- Viridian City: the would-be professor's quiz
- Viridian City: the Meowth thief (Charmander starters only)
- Viridian City: the Pikachu thief (Bulbasaur starters only)
- Viridian City: the Mankey thief (Pikachu starters only)
- Viridian City: Pokémon Academy exchange students (missable early)
- Viridian Forest: the runaway Snubbull ($20,000, one-time choice)
- Viridian Forest: the flower garden and the Spearow (missable)
- Viridian Forest: the Honey tree (weekday Bug Pokémon)
- Viridian Forest: the rescued Eevee (optional)
- Route 2, north of Viridian Forest: the abandoned Charmander (Pikachu starters only)
- Route 2, north of Viridian Forest: Nidoran♀ and the Apricorn Ball maker (non-Pikachu starters)
- Pewter City: finding Brock (the Gym Leader's errands)
- Pewter City: Sitrus Berries → Hard Stone → TM69
- Pewter City: the Apricorn Ball maker
- Pewter Pokémon Center: Elite Four Bruno (one attempt, before Mt. Moon)
- Field moves: which Badge each one needs

---

## Chapter 2: Mt. Moon

Source: https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch02-mt-moon/

You have the Boulder Badge and Rock Smash. The next stop is Mt. Moon, but a roadblock of "construction" guards sits at the north end of the first cave, and it only opens once **Blue, Misty, Steven and Cynthia are all waiting there** and you hold the Boulder Badge.

**Main quest in this chapter:** meet Misty on Route 3, bring Steven and Cynthia into the cave, then talk to the guard. The fight that follows (four Multi Battles) leads to Mt. Moon Square and the way on to Cerulean City.

Closes in this chapter: Bruno at the Pewter Pokémon Center.

### Walkthrough

**Pewter City, before you leave.** The Gym's sparring partner now takes a Pecha Berry to train your Defense. If you haven't yet, beat **Steven** at the Museum of Science (he must be in your pocket for the roadblock) and Blue on the path to the Gym.

**Opens up:**

- [Gym sparring partners: EV training for a Berry](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch02-mt-moon/#gym-sparring-partners-ev-training-for-a-berry)

**Route 3.** Walking east you pass a Bug Catcher (a Scyther chase for Charmander starters, a battle for everyone else) and an old painter who is ill and wants Fresh Water for a Big Root and his late wife's Ralts. You can't buy Fresh Water yet; it goes on sale in Mt. Moon Square once the roadblock story is over.

**Opens up:**

- [Route 3: the Scyther chase (Charmander starters) / Bug Catcher Kenji (others)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch02-mt-moon/#route-3-the-scyther-chase-charmander-starters--bug-catcher-kenji-others)
- [Route 3: the old painter's Ralts (Fresh Water errand; before the Cascade Badge)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch02-mt-moon/#route-3-the-old-painters-ralts-fresh-water-errand-before-the-cascade-badge) Missable

**Misty's Gyarados.** Walk past the Trainer further east and Misty's runaway Gyarados charges you. Win or lose, the story goes on. Misty apologises and asks "Comfort Misty?": **answer Yes**. Answering No closes her romance route. Either answer puts her in Mt. Moon as your second companion.

**Opens up:**

- [Route 3: Misty's Gyarados, "Comfort Misty?" (romance choice)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch02-mt-moon/#route-3-mistys-gyarados-comfort-misty-romance-choice)

**Mt. Moon, first cave.** Talk to Cynthia at the first fork (any answer to her left-or-right question works). Take the east passage down to the inner cave for Steven (talk to him again after beating him at the Museum) and for the Super Nerd who sells fossils. Nurse Joy heals you inside the cave.

**Opens up:**

- [Mt. Moon: the fossil seller](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch02-mt-moon/#mt-moon-the-fossil-seller)

**The roadblock.** With Blue, Misty, Steven and Cynthia all standing by the guards and the Boulder Badge in your case, talk to the guard. Green (Red for a girl) exposes them as Team Rocket and you fight four Multi Battles, one beside each companion. This leads to the Mt. Moon Square scene (Mew), and **Bruno leaves the Pewter Pokémon Center**. The Underground Path doorways on Route 5, 6, 7 and 8 also open now.

**Opens up:**

- [Mt. Moon: what opens the fake guards' roadblock](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch02-mt-moon/#mt-moon-what-opens-the-fake-guards-roadblock)

**Out of Mt. Moon.** A small cave entrance between Mt. Moon and Mt. Moon Square leads, on Monday nights (20:00 to 23:59) and early Tuesday mornings (00:00 to 03:59) by the DS clock, to a copy of the Square where six Clefairy dance around a rock and leave a **Moon Stone**. Route 4 leads to Cerulean City. The Fresh Water shop in Mt. Moon Square is open now, so the painter on Route 3 can be helped if you want his Ralts.

**Opens up:**

- [Mt. Moon Square: the Clefairy dance (Monday nights)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch02-mt-moon/#mt-moon-square-the-clefairy-dance-monday-nights)

Quests in this chapter:

- Gym sparring partners: EV training for a Berry
- Route 3: the Scyther chase (Charmander starters) / Bug Catcher Kenji (others)
- Route 3: the old painter's Ralts (Fresh Water errand; before the Cascade Badge)
- Route 3: Misty's Gyarados, "Comfort Misty?" (romance choice)
- Mt. Moon: the fossil seller
- Mt. Moon: what opens the fake guards' roadblock
- Mt. Moon Square: the Clefairy dance (Monday nights)

---

## Chapter 3: Cerulean City and the Cascade Badge

Source: https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch03-cerulean-cascade/

Cerulean City is where the story slows down. Misty's sister Daisy hands out the Cascade Badge for free, Misty takes it back and sends you to the **Cerulean Cape Battle Festival** first, and only after the festival (and a computer-virus emergency at Bill's cottage) does she give it to you properly.

**Main quest in this chapter:** reach Cerulean City, take part in the Battle Festival on Route 25, help Bill and Misty at the Sea Cottage (Bill thanks you with the **S.S. Ticket**), and win the **Cascade Badge** from Misty.

The Cascade Badge scene is a big door closing. It removes the "tasty treat" man on Route 25, makes the old painter on Route 3 pass away and takes the roadside Charmander and the Pewter Trainer who talks about it, so do those first.

### Walkthrough

**Cerulean City.** Blue meets you on the north side of town and wants a battle ("the festival is taking forever to start"). Pay attention to the robbed house north-east of the Pokémon Center: the police officer there starts a burglary case, and it has a deadline (see the quest).

**Opens up:**

- [Route 24 / Cerulean City: the burglary case → TM Case → TM28 Dig](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch03-cerulean-cascade/#route-24--cerulean-city-the-burglary-case--tm-case--tm28-dig) Missable

**The Gym, first visit.** If you already walked into the Viridian Gym after the forest (Chapter 1), the Cerulean Gym is full of spectators for the final round of Misty's Gym Leader assessment. Talk to Brock: Misty beats the challenger Curtis in a Water-type-only match and Brock appoints her Leader. The Gym then opens normally. Otherwise you start straight at the next part.

**Daisy's free badge.** Daisy is the Gym Leader on duty and hands you the Cascade Badge for nothing. Misty comes in, is furious, and takes it back: she is going to the Cerulean Cape (north of town) to enter the Battle Festival, and you should show what you can do there first.

**Nugget Bridge (Route 24) and Route 25.** Beat the Trainers on the bridge. On Route 25, a man on the path north of the bridge offers you a "tasty treat": **say No.** Yes gets you robbed; No gets you a one-time battle. He disappears when you win the Cascade Badge.

**Opens up:**

- [Route 25: Nugget Bridge's "tasty treat" (say No)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch03-cerulean-cascade/#route-25-nugget-bridges-tasty-treat-say-no) Missable

**The Cape Battle Festival (Route 25).** Walk on east along Route 25 and join the festival. Beat the Trainers in order, answer the quiz at the checkpoint (all five right heals you; otherwise you battle the examiner), and the awards ceremony places you 1st to 3rd depending on how the two festival battles went. You get Rare Candies for your placing.

**Opens up:**

- [Route 25: the Cerulean Cape Battle Festival (quiz and placing)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch03-cerulean-cascade/#route-25-the-cerulean-cape-battle-festival-quiz-and-placing)

**The Sea Cottage.** After the awards a shout comes from the house on the Cape. Bill's computer has a virus: go into cyberspace with Misty to clear it out. Bill thanks you with tickets for the S.S. Anne (you get the **S.S. Ticket**) and registers his number. Afterwards Bill's grandfather will trade items for Pokémon you show him.

**Opens up:**

- [Sea Cottage: Bill's grandfather (show him five Pokémon)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch03-cerulean-cascade/#sea-cottage-bills-grandfather-show-him-five-pok%C3%A9mon)

**Back to the Gym: the Cascade Badge.** Misty battles you as the acting Gym Leader and this time hands over the **Cascade Badge** and TM03. You can now use Cut. **This closes:** the Route 25 "tasty treat" man, the Pewter Trainer who brags about his Charmander (and the roadside Charmander), and the old painter's Ralts on Route 3 (he passes away; his Ralts waits at his house with a letter).

Quests in this chapter:

- Route 24 / Cerulean City: the burglary case → TM Case → TM28 Dig
- Route 25: Nugget Bridge's "tasty treat" (say No)
- Route 25: the Cerulean Cape Battle Festival (quiz and placing)
- Sea Cottage: Bill's grandfather (show him five Pokémon)

---

## Chapter 4: Past the Cascade Badge

Source: https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch04-underground-path/

With the Cascade Badge you can use Cut and the Route 5 raid is armed. Saffron City is on lockdown, so the only way on to Vermilion City is the **Underground Path** under Route 5 and Route 6.

**Main quest in this chapter:** go down the Underground Path (it needs the Cascade Badge) and come out on Route 6, the road to Vermilion City.

Do the Route 5 shelter raid before you go down: the raid is a one-time chance (it is also on a story deadline) and the Route 11 Swablu quest in Vermilion depends on it.

### Walkthrough

**Mt. Moon Square again.** The Square's visitors are back and Asher's gang blocks the spring (the shop stops selling Fresh Water meanwhile). Beat Asher and collect thank-you gifts: Destiny Knot, Everstone, and a Soothe Bell from the couple by the shop.

**Opens up:**

- [Mt. Moon Square: Asher's gang and the spring (after the Cascade Badge)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch04-underground-path/#mt-moon-square-ashers-gang-and-the-spring-after-the-cascade-badge)

**East of Cerulean: Routes 9 and 10.** Route 9 has the Squirtle Squad trap (Pikachu starters), a girl deciding whether to release her Butterfree and a man with a Paras who wants a Repel. The Pokémon Center at the north end of Route 10 has Cynthia, who offers one battle between the Cape festival and the day you beat Archie on the S.S. Anne. The tunnel door beside it (Rock Tunnel) is guarded for now.

**Opens up:**

- [Route 9: the Squirtle Squad steals your Pokédex (Pikachu starters only)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch04-underground-path/#route-9-the-squirtle-squad-steals-your-pok%C3%A9dex-pikachu-starters-only) Pikachu only Missable
- [Route 9: the Butterfree girl (release it or keep it)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch04-underground-path/#route-9-the-butterfree-girl-release-it-or-keep-it)
- [Route 9: the Paras mushroom picker (Repel → Zinc)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch04-underground-path/#route-9-the-paras-mushroom-picker-repel--zinc)
- [Optional strong Trainers (Route 9, Route 10, Route 11)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch04-underground-path/#optional-strong-trainers-route-9-route-10-route-11)

**Route 5.** Walk south down the middle of the path to the Pokémon shelter: a Team Rocket grunt is stealing the shelter girl's Pokémon. **Step in and help** (the Pokémon at risk is Bulbasaur for Pikachu starters, Growlithe for everyone else). Refusing loses it for good. Winning gets you the Pokémon, a Cleanse Tag from the grandfather and the Magical Leaf tutor. Her Swablu escapes to Route 11.

**Opens up:**

- [Route 5: the Pokémon shelter raid (after the Cascade Badge)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch04-underground-path/#route-5-the-pok%C3%A9mon-shelter-raid-after-the-cascade-badge) Missable

**Saffron's gates and the Underground Path.** The guards at the gatehouse refuse to let you into Saffron City ("lockdown"). Take the Underground Path from the Route 5 gatehouse instead. In the middle, a street fighting event runs: Blue's win streak, four challengers and then Green (Red for a girl). You don't have to win the last fight. Afterwards the MC hides on Route 6 and hands over your "prize money" (Fast Ball and Love Ball). **The Underground Path doorways close again when you rescue Prof. Hale in Rock Tunnel.**

**Opens up:**

- [Underground Path: the underground battle (story, Cascade Badge)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch04-underground-path/#underground-path-the-underground-battle-story-cascade-badge) Missable

Quests in this chapter:

- Mt. Moon Square: Asher's gang and the spring (after the Cascade Badge)
- Route 9: the Squirtle Squad steals your Pokédex (Pikachu starters only)
- Route 9: the Butterfree girl (release it or keep it)
- Route 9: the Paras mushroom picker (Repel → Zinc)
- Optional strong Trainers (Route 9, Route 10, Route 11)
- Route 5: the Pokémon shelter raid (after the Cascade Badge)
- Underground Path: the underground battle (story, Cascade Badge)

---

## Chapter 5: Vermilion City and the Thunder Badge

Source: https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch05-vermilion-thunder/

Vermilion City is on the edge of a fight: Granny Kin wants to build over the Diglett tunnels and Lt. Surge is meant to be blocking her. You arrive just as the argument boils over.

**Main quest in this chapter:** hear out the six townspeople, choose a side with Blue or with Green/Red (this choice **locks one partner out of the romance route** and changes two gifts), fight the clash the next morning, then beat Lt. Surge for the **Thunder Badge** (Strength).

Arriving in Vermilion also lifts the fake police on Route 2 near Viridian City. That opens a warehouse and a gatehouse there that were out of reach until now. Several side quests start here: the Good Rod, the Fan Club, Horsea and Wingull, the seaside cook, and Route 11.

### Walkthrough

**Arriving in Vermilion.** The first time you step into town, a street scene plays: Lt. Surge, Granny Kin and the townspeople argue over the construction site. Afterwards you can walk around town. Blue and Green (Red for a girl) wait in the Pokémon Center.

**Because you have now been to Vermilion, the fake police on Route 2 leave.** The Team Rocket warehouse on the eastern road north of Viridian City and the gatehouse with the Magcargo fan are open now (see the two quests; the warehouse ball is a **starter-dependent gift** and is lost when the Celadon hideout falls).

**Opens up:**

- [Route 2: the Rocket warehouse Poké Ball (starter-dependent gift)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch05-vermilion-thunder/#route-2-the-rocket-warehouse-pok%C3%A9-ball-starter-dependent-gift) Missable
- [Route 2: the Magcargo fan (show a Pokémon)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch05-vermilion-thunder/#route-2-the-magcargo-fan-show-a-pok%C3%A9mon)

**Things to do in town** (all open as soon as you can walk around): feed the Wingull and the Horsea by the water (Oran and Yache Berries), show the fisherman Ryochi a Horsea for the Good Rod, win over three Fan Club members for the Bike Voucher (you need a Poké Doll for one of them), and bring the seaside cook a Shoal Salt and a Big Mushroom. East of town, Route 11 has a Swablu girl and an argument over cutting the grass.

**Opens up:**

- [Vermilion City: feed the Wingull and the Horsea](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch05-vermilion-thunder/#vermilion-city-feed-the-wingull-and-the-horsea)
- [Vermilion City: the Good Rod (show Ryochi a Horsea)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch05-vermilion-thunder/#vermilion-city-the-good-rod-show-ryochi-a-horsea)
- [Vermilion City: the Pokémon Fan Club (three members → Bike Voucher)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch05-vermilion-thunder/#vermilion-city-the-pok%C3%A9mon-fan-club-three-members--bike-voucher)
- [Vermilion City: the seaside cook (Shoal Salt + Big Mushroom)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch05-vermilion-thunder/#vermilion-city-the-seaside-cook-shoal-salt--big-mushroom)
- [Route 11: the Swablu from the shelter](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch05-vermilion-thunder/#route-11-the-swablu-from-the-shelter) Missable
- [Route 11: cut the grass or save it (choose a side)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch05-vermilion-thunder/#route-11-cut-the-grass-or-save-it-choose-a-side)

**The dispute.** Talk to Blue or Green/Red, then listen to all six townspeople: Lt. Surge and Granny Kin at the fenced site, a resident near the Poké Mart, a sailor near the port, a man in the south-east corner and a woman west of the site. Go back and say Yes to the partner whose side you want. **Warning:** the next Yes locks out one romance partner (Green/Red if you back Blue, Blue if you back Green/Red) until the Six Island wish.

**Opens up:**

- [Vermilion City: the construction-site dispute (choose a side)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch05-vermilion-thunder/#vermilion-city-the-construction-site-dispute-choose-a-side)

**The clash.** The night passes and the clash starts the next morning (Lorelei announces the League's construction ban). The law side fights two Multi Battles, the townsfolk side one against Lt. Surge and Blue. Afterwards the town hands out thank-you gifts: Cheri Berries, a Magnet, and (townsfolk side only) a King's Rock from the sailor and Big Mushrooms from the woman.

**Opens up:**

- [Vermilion City: after the construction-site clash](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch05-vermilion-thunder/#vermilion-city-after-the-construction-site-clash)
- [Cerulean City: King's Rock for TM04](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch05-vermilion-thunder/#cerulean-city-kings-rock-for-tm04)

**Lt. Surge's Gym.** Battle Lt. Surge for the **Thunder Badge**. He gives you a Light Ball (a Thunder Stone if your starter is Pikachu), the Radio Card and his number. With the badge you can use Strength, the Vermilion sparring partner trains Speed, and the S.S. Anne is open to you.

**The Bike Voucher.** Once the Fan Club chairman gives you the Bike Voucher, the Cerulean Bike Shop trades it for a Bicycle. You can then lend the Bicycle to the kid in south Cerulean for an Amulet Coin later (the reward waits for the Rainbow Badge).

**Opens up:**

- [Cerulean City: lend the kid your Bicycle (→ Amulet Coin)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch05-vermilion-thunder/#cerulean-city-lend-the-kid-your-bicycle--amulet-coin) Missable

Quests in this chapter:

- Vermilion City: the construction-site dispute (choose a side)
- Vermilion City: after the construction-site clash
- Vermilion City: feed the Wingull and the Horsea
- Vermilion City: the Good Rod (show Ryochi a Horsea)
- Vermilion City: the Pokémon Fan Club (three members → Bike Voucher)
- Vermilion City: the seaside cook (Shoal Salt + Big Mushroom)
- Route 2: the Rocket warehouse Poké Ball (starter-dependent gift)
- Route 2: the Magcargo fan (show a Pokémon)
- Route 11: the Swablu from the shelter
- Route 11: cut the grass or save it (choose a side)
- Cerulean City: King's Rock for TM04
- Cerulean City: lend the kid your Bicycle (→ Amulet Coin)

---

## Chapter 6: The S.S. Anne

Source: https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch06-ss-anne/

The S.S. Anne leaves Vermilion Harbor on a cruise to Olivine City, and Team Rocket has other plans. You can only board with the **Thunder Badge** and the **S.S. Ticket** Bill gave you at the Sea Cottage.

**Main quest in this chapter:** survive the party, follow the Teddiursa trail, stop the hijack and **win the final fight against Archie with the bomb defused**. There is no retry once you have fought Archie. If the ship sinks, later NPCs in Johto speak as if passengers died, and the S.S. Anne passenger gift in Celadon never appears.

Beating Archie also opens Rock Tunnel's north entrance for the next chapter, and Cynthia leaves the Route 10 Pokémon Center.

### Walkthrough

**Boarding.** At Vermilion Harbor the clerk lets you through once you have the Thunder Badge and the S.S. Ticket (the ticket is Bill's thank-you from Chapter 3). **Save first**: two orders of events below can leave you stuck on the ship for good.

**The old man, then the girl's Honey.** From the moment you board, the party guests stand in the main hall and Blue offers a battle. Do it in this order: **beat the old man in the main hall first**, do **not** talk to Blue yet, then help the girl with the Teddiursa in the first north-west cabin. She wants Honey: give her yours, or swap one Shoal Salt with the cook in the B1F kitchen for Honey (a merchant in the hall sells Shoal Salt for $1,500). Her grandfather rewards you with a Water Stone. Giving the Honey before the old man's battle, or talking to Blue first, soft-locks the story.

**Opens up:**

- [S.S. Anne: Teddiursa's honey and the salt (starts the party)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch06-ss-anne/#ss-anne-teddiursas-honey-and-the-salt-starts-the-party)

**The party battles.** Win over the six guests in the main hall (Blue, the old boy, the Raticate Gentleman, the Trainer at the north, the Trainer on the west who "had my eye on you" and Sabrina's Psychic student). The waiter then wants to serve the food, but the Teddiursa has run off: go down to the B1F kitchen, where it is eating honey from the fridge. Back in the hall the Team Rocket hijack begins; you and Green/Red fight three Multi Battles in a row.

**Opens up:**

- [S.S. Anne: the party battles and the missing Teddiursa](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch06-ss-anne/#ss-anne-the-party-battles-and-the-missing-teddiursa)

**The bomb and Archie.** After the hijack, go down to the B1F engine room and beat the "maintenance" man to **defuse the bomb**. Then climb to the captain's cabin and fight Archie. You can lose his first battle, but **the last one must be won** or the ship sinks even with the bomb defused. With the bomb defused and Archie beaten, the Captain sails back to Vermilion and Lt. Surge gives you a Magnet outside.

**Opens up:**

- [S.S. Anne: defuse the bomb or the ship sinks (one chance)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch06-ss-anne/#ss-anne-defuse-the-bomb-or-the-ship-sinks-one-chance) Missable

**After the ship.** Blue says he is aiming for Kanto's eight Badges; Green/Red warns you about Team Rocket. The guard in front of Rock Tunnel's north door is gone, so the tunnel is open, and Cynthia has left the Route 10 Pokémon Center.

Quests in this chapter:

- S.S. Anne: Teddiursa's honey and the salt (starts the party)
- S.S. Anne: the party battles and the missing Teddiursa
- S.S. Anne: defuse the bomb or the ship sinks (one chance)

---

## Chapter 7: Rock Tunnel and Lavender Town

Source: https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch07-rock-tunnel-lavender/

With the S.S. Anne behind you, the road goes through Rock Tunnel to Lavender Town. Team Rocket is after Prof. Hale's research in the tunnel, and in Lavender it is after something in the Pokémon Tower.

**Main quest in this chapter:** rescue Prof. Hale in Rock Tunnel, climb Pokémon Tower (**twice**, with a trip back to Cubone in between), and reach the end of the tower story, when Agatha breaks up Team Rocket there. Afterwards the guard at the Route 8 gatehouse lets you into Saffron City.

Three things close as you go: the Underground Path (the Rock Tunnel rescue), the tower's optional Trainers if you skip them (they vanish after the two illusion grunts), and Cynthia's optional battle on Route 12 (she leaves when you first reach Saffron).

### Walkthrough

**Rock Tunnel.** Enter from the north door on Route 10 (a Pokémon that knows Flash lights the cave). Somewhere inside, Prof. Hale shouts that someone is stealing his research: Jessie, James and Meowth have him cornered. Beat them in a Double Battle. **The rescue closes the Underground Path doorways** (an invisible barrier stops you at each one).

**Opens up:**

- [Rock Tunnel: hide-and-seek (find four hidden kids)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch07-rock-tunnel-lavender/#rock-tunnel-hide-and-seek-find-four-hidden-kids)

**Rock Tunnel's hide-and-seek.** On the lower level a schoolkid "seeker" wants you to find four of his friends hidden in the tunnel: the corner kid (battle him *carefully*: losing freezes the game), the fake archaeologist, a "Pikachu" and a ninja disguised as a boulder. He pays you TM80 Rock Slide.

**Lavender Town.** Beyond the tunnel, a girl on Route 10 just south-east of the south exit asks you not to go. The Lavender fortune-teller can turn that into a curse that keeps pulling you back into town (Cleanse Tags break it, see the quest). The House of Memories trades one Big Pearl for one Heart Scale, as often as you like.

**Opens up:**

- [Route 10 / Lavender Town: the girl who waits (the Lavender curse)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch07-rock-tunnel-lavender/#route-10--lavender-town-the-girl-who-waits-the-lavender-curse)
- [Lavender Town: trade Big Pearls for Heart Scales](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch07-rock-tunnel-lavender/#lavender-town-trade-big-pearls-for-heart-scales)

**Pokémon Tower, first climb.** Beat Blue at the stairs and climb. At the upper staircase a voice sends you back: nothing lets you continue yet. Go to Mr. Fuji's Volunteer Pokémon House (door about eight steps south of the Pokémon Center door) and talk to Cubone, who now warms to you, cries and runs out of the house. Let the scene finish.

**Pokémon Tower, return climb.** The tower's Trainers and illusions now appear, including "Mom" (**answer No and win**; she blocks the only way on). After you beat the two illusion grunts, the Magcargo behind them can be caught (catch it before you take any stairs; a loss freezes the game). Grab the Silph Scope that appears, and fight the Trainers you skipped before you take a staircase: they vanish afterwards. Then Maxie, Team Rocket and Mr. Fuji, until Agatha breaks up the Team Rocket group in the tower.

**Opens up:**

- [Pokémon Tower: side battles and extras](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch07-rock-tunnel-lavender/#pok%C3%A9mon-tower-side-battles-and-extras)

**Mr. Fuji's house.** After Agatha, the Cubone is yours to take, Mr. Fuji gives you the Poké Flute and then the Mystery Stone (talk to him twice).

**Opens up:**

- [Lavender Town: Mr. Fuji's gifts (after the tower)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch07-rock-tunnel-lavender/#lavender-town-mr-fujis-gifts-after-the-tower)

**Route 8 and Saffron's east gate.** East of Lavender, Route 8 has a quarrelling Persian and Skitty owner pair that rewards you with TM40 Aerial Ace. At the Route 8 gatehouse the guard first says Saffron is under lockdown, then lets you through as one of the Trainers Lady Agatha mentioned. That opens Saffron City's gates for you. **Before you walk in,** battle Cynthia at the north end of Route 12 if you want to (next step): she leaves when you first reach Saffron.

**Opens up:**

- [Route 8: Persian and Skitty (the quarrelling owners)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch07-rock-tunnel-lavender/#route-8-persian-and-skitty-the-quarrelling-owners)

**Silence Bridge (Route 12) and Route 13.** South of Lavender, the long bridge on Route 12 is open once the tower story is over. A sleeping Snorlax blocks it halfway: wake it with the **Poké Flute** from Mr. Fuji. North of the Snorlax you meet the TM salesman, the fish-zapper and the Milotic, and the couple whose Pokémon Team Rocket killed; south of it are the Fishing Guru (Super Rod, needs the Good Rod from Vermilion), Bug Catcher Harlan (if the Route 9 girl let her Butterfree go), Picnicker Lily and Prof. Birch. Route 13 beyond is an amateur "Southeast League".

**Two of these end soon:** Cynthia's optional battle at the north end of Route 12 ends when you reach Saffron for the first time (Chapter 8), and **Prof. Birch's Torchic is lost for good when the Rainbow Badge scene plays** in Celadon (Chapter 8). So wake the Snorlax and talk to Birch before you win the Rainbow Badge. From Route 13 you cannot walk on to Route 14 and Fuchsia yet: a League member blocks the way until the Battle Marathon is over or cancelled (Chapter 9).

**Opens up:**

- [Route 12: wake the Snorlax (Poké Flute)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch07-rock-tunnel-lavender/#route-12-wake-the-snorlax-pok%C3%A9-flute)
- [Route 12: Prof. Birch's Torchic (missable)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch07-rock-tunnel-lavender/#route-12-prof-birchs-torchic-missable) Missable
- [Route 12: the fish-zapper and the shiny Milotic (choose how to stop him)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch07-rock-tunnel-lavender/#route-12-the-fish-zapper-and-the-shiny-milotic-choose-how-to-stop-him)
- [Route 12: the boyfriend who lost his Pokémon (you must lose)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch07-rock-tunnel-lavender/#route-12-the-boyfriend-who-lost-his-pok%C3%A9mon-you-must-lose)
- [Route 12: Bug Catcher Harlan's Butterfree](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch07-rock-tunnel-lavender/#route-12-bug-catcher-harlans-butterfree)
- [Route 12: the Fishing Guru's Super Rod](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch07-rock-tunnel-lavender/#route-12-the-fishing-gurus-super-rod)
- [Route 12: the TM salesman](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch07-rock-tunnel-lavender/#route-12-the-tm-salesman)
- [Route 12: other optional battles](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch07-rock-tunnel-lavender/#route-12-other-optional-battles) Missable
- [Route 13: the Southeast League (eight representatives and a Champion)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch07-rock-tunnel-lavender/#route-13-the-southeast-league-eight-representatives-and-a-champion)

Quests in this chapter:

- Rock Tunnel: hide-and-seek (find four hidden kids)
- Route 10 / Lavender Town: the girl who waits (the Lavender curse)
- Lavender Town: trade Big Pearls for Heart Scales
- Pokémon Tower: side battles and extras
- Lavender Town: Mr. Fuji's gifts (after the tower)
- Route 8: Persian and Skitty (the quarrelling owners)
- Route 12: wake the Snorlax (Poké Flute)
- Route 12: Prof. Birch's Torchic (missable)
- Route 12: the fish-zapper and the shiny Milotic (choose how to stop him)
- Route 12: the boyfriend who lost his Pokémon (you must lose)
- Route 12: Bug Catcher Harlan's Butterfree
- Route 12: the Fishing Guru's Super Rod
- Route 12: the TM salesman
- Route 12: other optional battles
- Route 13: the Southeast League (eight representatives and a Champion)

---

## Chapter 8: Saffron City and Celadon City

Source: https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch08-celadon/

Saffron City is open to you now, and its west gate leads out to Route 7 and Celadon City. Celadon is Erika's town, and Team Rocket's hideout lies beneath the Game Corner.

**Main quest in this chapter:** pass through Saffron City, fight alongside Misty on Route 7, help Erika find her stolen Gloom (the hunt sends you to the Condominiums roof and the Game Corner owner), get through the Rocket hideout (the Persian statue password is a day-and-hour puzzle) and win the **Rainbow Badge**. The badge lets you use Surf, but the Surf HM itself is not given here: it lies on the ground in Fuchsia Forest (next chapter).

Things that close in this chapter: Misty's sparring match on Route 7 ends the Bicycle-lending offer in Cerulean, and the Celadon hideout finale empties the Team Rocket warehouse on Route 2.

### Walkthrough

**Saffron City.** The first time you walk in, Lance brings you, Blue and Green (Red for a girl) to meet the Pokémon League President in the Silph Co. building (he gives you 3 Rare Candies). Once that scene is over, the guards on Route 7 open Saffron's west gate. **Cynthia leaves Route 12 at this point**, so battle her there first if you want her optional fight.

Saffron's own quests are open now, all of them before Team Rocket takes the city over later in the game. **Sabrina's willpower test at the Saffron Gym is part of the main story:** it sends Sabrina to Pokémon Tower, so you have to do it before you can go for the Marsh Badge. You can do it right now (pick up the Mind Plate in the pocket dimension before you leave it). Also here: Cynthia and Steven in the Gym and the Silph Co. lobby, the Copycat's transformation show, the dog lover (bring a Growlithe), the Hunyuan Dojo and a few small extras.

**Opens up:**

- [Saffron Gym: Sabrina's willpower test and the pocket dimension (before the takeover)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch08-celadon/#saffron-gym-sabrinas-willpower-test-and-the-pocket-dimension-before-the-takeover)
- [Saffron City: Cynthia and Steven (after the League President's meeting)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch08-celadon/#saffron-city-cynthia-and-steven-after-the-league-presidents-meeting)
- [Saffron City: the Copycat's transformation show](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch08-celadon/#saffron-city-the-copycats-transformation-show)
- [Saffron City: show the dog lover a Growlithe (unlocks Fire Punch)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch08-celadon/#saffron-city-show-the-dog-lover-a-growlithe-unlocks-fire-punch)
- [Saffron City: the Hunyuan Dojo (beat the disciples → Hitmonlee or Hitmonchan)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch08-celadon/#saffron-city-the-hunyuan-dojo-beat-the-disciples--hitmonlee-or-hitmonchan)
- [Saffron City: small extras](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch08-celadon/#saffron-city-small-extras)

**Route 7.** Leave Saffron by the west gate. Two steps north-west of the gatehouse door on the Route 7 side, Misty's sparring match starts: a fight against a Flareon trainer, then a Multi Battle beside Misty against two berserk Pokémon, an Aggron and a Cacturne, both **Lv. 45**. Erika arrives, calms them with Gloom's Sweet Scent and takes Misty off to her perfume shop. **This ends the Bicycle-lending offer in Cerulean.** It also empties the Celadon Condominiums massage parlour and starts the Tony and Mary scene on the Department Store roof (see the quest).

**Opens up:**

- [Route 7: Misty's sparring match (what closes the Bicycle offer)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch08-celadon/#route-7-mistys-sparring-match-what-closes-the-bicycle-offer)
- [Celadon Department Store roof: Tony and Mary's grooming (missable)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch08-celadon/#celadon-department-store-roof-tony-and-marys-grooming-missable) Missable

**Celadon Department Store, 5F.** Erika's perfume counter: Erika asks Misty, Blue and Green/Red what they think of her perfume. Male players choose: "It smells wonderful" keeps the Gym open to you; "Perfume is pointless" bans you from the Gym until you sneak in dressed as a girl. After the scene, battle Erika (normally, or in disguise).

**Opens up:**

- [Celadon Department Store 5F: Erika's perfume question (male players)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch08-celadon/#celadon-department-store-5f-erikas-perfume-question-male-players) Male players only
- [Celadon Gym: sneaking in dressed as a girl (if you insulted Erika)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch08-celadon/#celadon-gym-sneaking-in-dressed-as-a-girl-if-you-insulted-erika)

**Erika's Gloom is stolen.** Nobody tells you where to go. Talk to your friend in the Restaurant and Cynthia in the Department Store 1F; both give you a lead. The auction house is on the roof of the Condominiums (use the elevator in the top-left corner of the lobby); a waiter there fights you if you have both leads, and the boss only believes you if you carry $65,535 or one of the starter Pokémon in your party. The gambler in the middle of town sells you his Coin Case for $50,000 and then tells you the buyer is Lawrence, the Game Corner owner. Report to Erika. **Once you have told Erika that Lawrence is the Collector, Tony and Mary on the Department Store roof are gone for good.**

**Opens up:**

- [Celadon City: the stolen Gloom (story chain, easy to get stuck)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch08-celadon/#celadon-city-the-stolen-gloom-story-chain-easy-to-get-stuck)

**The Game Corner and the Rocket hideout.** Misty goes with you (she gives you HM07 Waterfall on the way, and her Gyarados if you are a male Bulbasaur player). Run the launcher program in the first basement, then crack the Persian statue's five-digit password (it changes with the weekday and the hour). Beat Jessie, James and the Executives. When it is over Erika gives you the **Rainbow Badge**, Misty leaves for Cerulean and **the Team Rocket warehouse on Route 2 is cleared out for good.** Professor Birch also leaves Route 12 for good (his Torchic).

**Opens up:**

- [Celadon Rocket warehouse: the secret passage and the Persian statue password](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch08-celadon/#celadon-rocket-warehouse-the-secret-passage-and-the-persian-statue-password)

**Around Celadon.** An old man and his granddaughter with the Teddiursa wait on the Department Store's 3F with a Max Revive for you, but only if the S.S. Anne did not sink. On the west side of town a child with a Skitty trades the Fake Out tutor for a Fluffy Tail (the prize quiz on the Department Store roof pays out the Fluffy Tails).

**Opens up:**

- [Celadon Department Store roof: the prize quiz](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch08-celadon/#celadon-department-store-roof-the-prize-quiz)
- [Celadon City: Fluffy Tail for the Skitty kid (unlocks Fake Out)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch08-celadon/#celadon-city-fluffy-tail-for-the-skitty-kid-unlocks-fake-out)
- [Celadon Department Store 3F: the S.S. Anne passenger's thanks](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch08-celadon/#celadon-department-store-3f-the-ss-anne-passengers-thanks)

**More in Celadon (all optional).** In the Restaurant you can enter the eating contest ($2,000 entry, repeatable). The Condominiums hold Grandma's treats errand on 2F (Master Ball; it ends when Saffron is freed later in the game) and the Game Freak Club on 3F (the GB Sounds need the Earth Badge). Once the Rocket hideout has fallen, the Condominiums roof room reopens: the Hypno there heals your party for free, and the insomniac from the Department Store's 4F pays you for it. The Game Corner also sells coins much cheaper after the hideout (see the quest).

**Opens up:**

- [Celadon Condominiums → Silph Co. 5F: Grandma's treats for Shota (Master Ball; missable)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch08-celadon/#celadon-condominiums--silph-co-5f-grandmas-treats-for-shota-master-ball-missable) Missable
- [Celadon Restaurant: the eating contest (repeatable)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch08-celadon/#celadon-restaurant-the-eating-contest-repeatable)
- [Celadon Condominiums roof: the insomniac and the Hypno (after the Rocket arc)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch08-celadon/#celadon-condominiums-roof-the-insomniac-and-the-hypno-after-the-rocket-arc)
- [Celadon Game Freak Club: GB Sounds and the diplomas](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch08-celadon/#celadon-game-freak-club-gb-sounds-and-the-diplomas)
- [Celadon Game Corner: cheaper coins after the Rocket arc](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch08-celadon/#celadon-game-corner-cheaper-coins-after-the-rocket-arc)

Quests in this chapter:

- Route 7: Misty's sparring match (what closes the Bicycle offer)
- Celadon Department Store 5F: Erika's perfume question (male players)
- Celadon Gym: sneaking in dressed as a girl (if you insulted Erika)
- Celadon City: the stolen Gloom (story chain, easy to get stuck)
- Celadon Rocket warehouse: the secret passage and the Persian statue password
- Celadon Department Store roof: the prize quiz
- Celadon City: Fluffy Tail for the Skitty kid (unlocks Fake Out)
- Celadon Department Store 3F: the S.S. Anne passenger's thanks
- Celadon Department Store roof: Tony and Mary's grooming (missable)
- Celadon Condominiums → Silph Co. 5F: Grandma's treats for Shota (Master Ball; missable)
- Celadon Restaurant: the eating contest (repeatable)
- Celadon Condominiums roof: the insomniac and the Hypno (after the Rocket arc)
- Celadon Game Freak Club: GB Sounds and the diplomas
- Celadon Game Corner: cheaper coins after the Rocket arc
- Saffron Gym: Sabrina's willpower test and the pocket dimension (before the takeover)
- Saffron City: Cynthia and Steven (after the League President's meeting)
- Saffron City: the Copycat's transformation show
- Saffron City: show the dog lover a Growlithe (unlocks Fire Punch)
- Saffron City: the Hunyuan Dojo (beat the disciples → Hitmonlee or Hitmonchan)
- Saffron City: small extras

## Chapter 9: Cycling Road, Fuchsia City and the Soul Badge

Source: https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch09-fuchsia-soul-badge/

With the Rainbow Badge in your pocket, the herbal shop on Route 16 has a job for you and Cycling Road leads south to Fuchsia City. You need a **Bicycle** for the road (the Bike Voucher from the Vermilion Fan Club gets you one in Cerulean).

**Main quest in this chapter:** deliver the Secret Potion to the Safari Zone Warden, then in Fuchsia City clear Koga's trial (the fake Kogas, the ninja bell in Fuchsia Forest, Blue and the Executives) and win the **Soul Badge**. The **Surf HM lies on the ground in Fuchsia Forest**, so you pick it up during Koga's trial. Winning the Soul Badge also reopens Route 19 (the sea road south) and puts Cynthia and Steven in Fuchsia.

Most side quests here are **optional, but several disappear for good when Sabrina laughs in Pokémon Tower (Chapter 11)**: the Battle Marathon and its White Flute, Cynthia's and Steven's Fuchsia battles and Goh at the Tropius display. Do them first. Two choices here cannot be redone: the potion's outcome decides whether Baoba's Dragonair lives, and the Taro rescue depends on a Yes.

### Walkthrough

**The Secret Potion.** Walk out of Celadon by the west gate to Route 16. The old lady in the herbal shop's gatehouse is there only since the Rainbow Badge scene; she gives you a **Secret Potion** for a sick Pokémon at the Fuchsia Safari Zone. You get one chance: the potion has to reach the Safari Zone Warden before the Dragonair is lost, and **beating two or more of the road bikers on the way makes you too late.**

**Opens up:**

- [Route 16 → Cycling Road → Route 18: the Secret Potion for the Warden's Dragonair](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch09-fuchsia-soul-badge/#route-16--cycling-road--route-18-the-secret-potion-for-the-wardens-dragonair)

**Cycling Road.** At the top of the road a Kanto Speed Alliance biker blocks you; with the potion in your Bag choose to force your way through and beat **Biker Eddie**. Then ride south and **avoid the other bikers** (one win is fine, two ruin the delivery). At the bottom, on Route 18, the gang boss Paxton stops you and battles you, then you walk into the Route 18 gatehouse where Baoba takes the potion. Afterwards Paxton asks you to join the gang or take it on: joining makes all twelve road bikers count as beaten, refusing three times means you have to beat all twelve and then fight Paxton again as a Double Battle.

**Opens up:**

- [Cycling Road: join the Kanto Speed Alliance or drive it out](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch09-fuchsia-soul-badge/#cycling-road-join-the-kanto-speed-alliance-or-drive-it-out)

**Route 18, east of the gatehouse.** A Tauros grazes just south of the gatehouse and charges you; Lara and her Ponyta calm it and invite you to a **Battle Marathon on Route 15**. Say Yes (she keeps asking). Until you do, the Route 15 entrance from Fuchsia stays closed.

**Opens up:**

- [Route 18: Lara and the Tauros (unlocks the battle marathon)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch09-fuchsia-soul-badge/#route-18-lara-and-the-tauros-unlocks-the-battle-marathon)

**Fuchsia City and Koga's Gym.** Fuchsia City has several small things to do from the moment you arrive: the Rock-type fan in the Pokémon Center, the Shard trader, the Safari Ball seller, Baoba's family house and **Goh by the Tropius display**. The main business is Koga's Gym in the south-west corner. A cutscene by the Gym shows Granny Kin buying off Koga. Inside, four fake Kogas (one is Janine) lead to the real Koga, who wants Blue and Green/Red with you before he explains his challenge: bring back the **ninja bell** from Fuchsia Forest, the preserve in the north-east corner of town. The guard lets you in after Koga explains.

**Opens up:**

- [Fuchsia Gym: the fake Kogas and the ninja bell (the Soul Badge trial)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch09-fuchsia-soul-badge/#fuchsia-gym-the-fake-kogas-and-the-ninja-bell-the-soul-badge-trial)
- [Fuchsia City: Goh and the Tropius on display (choice, no reward)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch09-fuchsia-soul-badge/#fuchsia-city-goh-and-the-tropius-on-display-choice-no-reward) Missable
- [Fuchsia City: small extras](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch09-fuchsia-soul-badge/#fuchsia-city-small-extras)

**Fuchsia Forest and the ninja bell.** Blue and your friend take two of the three paths; take the third. Beat the Fearow-mobbing "Mean Birds", then **Blue** for the bell, then **Koga's tired-out Venonat battle and the Executive Maxie fight** (losing to Maxie does not white you out). **HM03 Surf lies on the ground in the forest, a short way north-east of the entrance**: pick it up. Once the bell story is over, Koga's three disciples, the Kangaskhan and a Toxic Orb and Toxic Plate appear in the forest, and the rangers' house in the north-east of town has a ranger who wants to see a Golem.

**Opens up:**

- [Fuchsia Forest: Koga's disciples](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch09-fuchsia-soul-badge/#fuchsia-forest-kogas-disciples)
- [Fuchsia City: the lost boy Taro (Kangaskhan and the poachers)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch09-fuchsia-soul-badge/#fuchsia-city-the-lost-boy-taro-kangaskhan-and-the-poachers)
- [Fuchsia City: show the ranger a Golem](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch09-fuchsia-soul-badge/#fuchsia-city-show-the-ranger-a-golem)

**The Soul Badge.** Back in the Gym, battle **Koga** for the **Soul Badge**, **TM36 Sludge Bomb** and his number. The badge scene also **reopens Route 19** (the sea road to Cinnabar, shut by volcanic ash since the Rainbow Badge) and brings **Cynthia and Steven** out in Fuchsia for one battle each.

**Opens up:**

- [Fuchsia City: Cynthia and Steven (after the Soul Badge, before the Saffron takeover)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch09-fuchsia-soul-badge/#fuchsia-city-cynthia-and-steven-after-the-soul-badge-before-the-saffron-takeover) Missable

**The Battle Marathon (Routes 15 and 14).** After Lara's invitation, sign up with the receptionist just inside Route 15. Four stages (two wild Pokémon, four trainers in a row, Lass Kay, then Route 14 with Jessie and James and finally Bird Keeper Dudley). You win the Large Supplement Set by beating Dudley; losing to him is allowed and gives the smaller set. **If the marathon has not been run when Sabrina laughs in Pokémon Tower, it is cancelled and its prizes are gone.**

**Opens up:**

- [Route 15 → Route 14: the Cape Battle Marathon (missable)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch09-fuchsia-soul-badge/#route-15--route-14-the-cape-battle-marathon-missable) Missable

**After the marathon.** The Dodrio owner in Fuchsia now gives the **White Flute**; Mack the magician and the man with the empty wallet turn up at the ends of Route 15; the woman at the north end of Route 14 wants to see a Chansey leading your party; and the League member who blocked Route 13 -> Route 14 steps aside.

**Opens up:**

- [Fuchsia City: the Dodrio owner's White Flute (Battle Marathon; before the Saffron takeover)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch09-fuchsia-soul-badge/#fuchsia-city-the-dodrio-owners-white-flute-battle-marathon-before-the-saffron-takeover) Missable
- [Route 15: Mack the magician's "show" (talk to the empty-wallet man first)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch09-fuchsia-soul-badge/#route-15-mack-the-magicians-show-talk-to-the-empty-wallet-man-first)
- [Route 14: show her a Chansey](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch09-fuchsia-soul-badge/#route-14-show-her-a-chansey)

**With Surf in your Bag.** **Power Plant** on Route 10: the door lies across the water, so you need Surf (and the Rainbow Badge). Inside is Zapdos, a **Lv. 90 trainer-style fight** with TM25 Thunder as the only prize, and an ecologist. **Route 19**, now open: a kid with a Pikachu wants a Pidgeot to whip up waves on the south beach (needs a Pidgeot leading your party and Surf).

**Opens up:**

- [Power Plant: Zapdos and the ecologist](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch09-fuchsia-soul-badge/#power-plant-zapdos-and-the-ecologist)
- [Route 19: the surfing Pikachu (Pidgeot lead → Surf for Pikachu)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch09-fuchsia-soul-badge/#route-19-the-surfing-pikachu-pidgeot-lead--surf-for-pikachu)

Quests in this chapter:

- Route 16 → Cycling Road → Route 18: the Secret Potion for the Warden's Dragonair
- Cycling Road: join the Kanto Speed Alliance or drive it out
- Route 18: Lara and the Tauros (unlocks the battle marathon)
- Fuchsia Gym: the fake Kogas and the ninja bell (the Soul Badge trial)
- Fuchsia City: Goh and the Tropius on display (choice, no reward)
- Fuchsia City: small extras
- Fuchsia Forest: Koga's disciples
- Fuchsia City: the lost boy Taro (Kangaskhan and the poachers)
- Fuchsia City: show the ranger a Golem
- Fuchsia City: Cynthia and Steven (after the Soul Badge, before the Saffron takeover)
- Route 15 → Route 14: the Cape Battle Marathon (missable)
- Fuchsia City: the Dodrio owner's White Flute (Battle Marathon; before the Saffron takeover)
- Route 15: Mack the magician's "show" (talk to the empty-wallet man first)
- Route 14: show her a Chansey
- Power Plant: Zapdos and the ecologist
- Route 19: the surfing Pikachu (Pidgeot lead → Surf for Pikachu)

---

## Chapter 10: Surf to Cinnabar Island and the Volcano Badge

Source: https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch10-cinnabar-volcano-badge/

With Surf, the Soul Badge and Route 19 open again, the sea road leads south to **Cinnabar Island**. Its Gym is hidden in a restaurant and its lab is where the next story beat happens.

**Main quest in this chapter:** find Blaine's Gym (the riddle restaurant), win the **Volcano Badge**, then go into the **Detrick lab** and watch Mewtwo break out. **Do not skip the lab:** until that scene has played, Sabrina in Pokémon Tower only says she is "deep in her training", so the next chapter cannot start.

The Volcano Badge also changes the Viridian Forest: the flower woman's Spearow errand ends (it closes for good), and for **Pikachu starters** the Pidgeot loan appears instead. That loan closes again at the Earth Badge.

### Walkthrough

**Surfing south.** Between Fuchsia and Cinnabar the sea road runs over Route 19 and Route 20 and past the **Seafoam Islands**. Their deepest chamber has a researcher, ice walls and **Articuno**: a Magcargo or Moltres leading your party melts the ice; Articuno is a Lv. 90 fight where no Balls can be thrown (a catch is only possible after the last Hall of Fame), and beating it makes the researcher give you **TM14 Blizzard**, the only one in the game. Route 21 runs north from Cinnabar to Pallet Town's shore: a Trainer with a Lairon and a wild Lv. 60 Mr. Mime are waiting there for the Iron Head tutor.

**Opens up:**

- [Seafoam Islands: the ice walls, Articuno and the researcher (TM14 Blizzard)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch10-cinnabar-volcano-badge/#seafoam-islands-the-ice-walls-articuno-and-the-researcher-tm14-blizzard) Missable
- [Route 21: break the wild Mr. Mime's barrier (unlocks Iron Head)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch10-cinnabar-volcano-badge/#route-21-break-the-wild-mr-mimes-barrier-unlocks-iron-head)

**Cinnabar Island: the hidden Gym.** There is no Gym building: the restaurant on the east side that refuses outsiders is the Gym. Blue is arguing with the staff inside; the owner is out playing riddles with Amber in front of the lab. Fetch him, then answer the owner's three riddles (any answer works; Blue or Green/Red covers wrong ones). The owner is **Blaine**, and the secret door in the back opens.

**Opens up:**

- [Cinnabar Island: finding the hidden Gym (the riddle restaurant)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch10-cinnabar-volcano-badge/#cinnabar-island-finding-the-hidden-gym-the-riddle-restaurant)
- [Cinnabar Island: the Fire-type quiz (unlocks Heat Wave)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch10-cinnabar-volcano-badge/#cinnabar-island-the-fire-type-quiz-unlocks-heat-wave)
- [Cinnabar Island: small extras](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch10-cinnabar-volcano-badge/#cinnabar-island-small-extras)
- [Cinnabar Island: the Egg in the lava (Treecko Egg; missable)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch10-cinnabar-volcano-badge/#cinnabar-island-the-egg-in-the-lava-treecko-egg-missable) Missable

**The Volcano Badge.** Battle Blaine. He gives you the **Volcano Badge**, **TM38 Fire Blast** and his number. From now on the Viridian Forest flower woman says the Spearow are already gone, so **her Spearow errand is closed for good**, and Pikachu starters can lend her a Pidgeot instead.

**Opens up:**

- [Viridian Forest: lend her a Pidgeot (Pikachu starters only)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch10-cinnabar-volcano-badge/#viridian-forest-lend-her-a-pidgeot-pikachu-starters-only) Pikachu only Missable

**The Detrick lab.** With the Volcano Badge the guard lets you into the lab in the north of the island. A researcher says the monster has gone berserk and Dr. Fuji sealed the building behind emergency shutters: the computers inside toggle the doors in a puzzle (the quest lists the working route). At the back of the lab Mewtwo breaks out, Dr. Fuji dies and Blaine's staff mourn Amber. **This scene is required before Sabrina's tower trial.**

**Opens up:**

- [Cinnabar Island: the Detrick lab lockdown (door puzzle) and Mewtwo](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch10-cinnabar-volcano-badge/#cinnabar-island-the-detrick-lab-lockdown-door-puzzle-and-mewtwo)

Quests in this chapter:

- Seafoam Islands: the ice walls, Articuno and the researcher (TM14 Blizzard)
- Route 21: break the wild Mr. Mime's barrier (unlocks Iron Head)
- Cinnabar Island: finding the hidden Gym (the riddle restaurant)
- Cinnabar Island: the Fire-type quiz (unlocks Heat Wave)
- Cinnabar Island: small extras
- Cinnabar Island: the Egg in the lava (Treecko Egg; missable)
- Viridian Forest: lend her a Pidgeot (Pikachu starters only)
- Cinnabar Island: the Detrick lab lockdown (door puzzle) and Mewtwo

---

## Chapter 11: Pokémon Tower, the Saffron Takeover and the Marsh Badge

Source: https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch11-saffron-takeover-marsh-badge/

Everything is lined up for Sabrina's trial: you did her willpower test in the Saffron Gym (Chapter 8), you have the Volcano Badge and you saw Mewtwo break out in the Detrick lab (Chapter 10). If any of those is missing, Sabrina in Pokémon Tower sends you away.

**Main quest in this chapter:** make Sabrina laugh in Pokémon Tower (the call that ends the scene tells you Team Rocket has taken Saffron City), get into the sealed city through Sabrina's pocket dimension, fight through Silph Co. to the Rocket Boss, and then battle Sabrina for the **Marsh Badge** (Fly).

**Before you go to the tower, finish these, because the takeover closes them for good:** the Route 5 shelter raid, the Cerulean burglary case (if you have not beaten the Route 24 grunt), the Route 11 Swablu, the Route 9 Squirtle Squad (Pikachu starters), the Fuchsia Battle Marathon and its White Flute, Cynthia's and Steven's battles in Fuchsia and Goh at the Tropius display. The employee's Lapras and Grandma's treats for Shota end later in this chapter.

### Walkthrough

**Pokémon Tower, Sabrina's laughing test.** Sabrina waits on the tower's upper floors, with her Alakazam. Accept her willpower training ("Make me laugh"). Her menu starts with only "Tell a joke"; each ghost Pokémon in the tower (a Gastly, a Haunter and a Gengar) gives you one more idea once Sabrina has set the task. Try all four options once each. After the fourth, you say you will not give up and she laughs.

**Opens up:**

- [Pokémon Tower: make Sabrina laugh (the Marsh Badge trial)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch11-saffron-takeover-marsh-badge/#pok%C3%A9mon-tower-make-sabrina-laugh-the-marsh-badge-trial)

**The call: Team Rocket has taken over Saffron City.** The moment Sabrina laughs, the Saffron takeover starts. **This closes for good everything you have not done yet from this list:** the Route 5 shelter raid, the Cerulean burglary case, the Route 11 Swablu, the Squirtle Squad on Route 9, the Fuchsia Battle Marathon and the White Flute, Cynthia's and Steven's Fuchsia battles, and Goh at the Tropius display. The Saffron townsfolk and shops are gone until the city is freed, and Koga is away from the Fuchsia Gym.

**Opens up:**

- [Saffron City: the Team Rocket takeover (what it closes)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch11-saffron-takeover-marsh-badge/#saffron-city-the-team-rocket-takeover-what-it-closes)

**Getting into Saffron.** An invisible barrier seals all four gates. At the Route 8 gate (the Lavender side) Sabrina, Agatha and your friend explain it and send you to check the other three gates: talk to at least one **person** (not a Pokémon) at the north, south and west gates. Then go back to Sabrina and say Yes: she sends you through her pocket dimension. Inside, the caretaker in the house in the south-east gives you the **Sub. Doll** and sends you into the occupied Saffron Gym. Blue joins you there and you fight off the Rockets together; he suggests sneaking into Silph Co.

**Opens up:**

- [Saffron City (takeover): getting past the barrier into the city](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch11-saffron-takeover-marsh-badge/#saffron-city-takeover-getting-past-the-barrier-into-the-city)

**Silph Co.** Use the elevator to Rotom's Room (guarded by four Grunts and Executive Lawrence, who is Lv. 73-74: bring a healthy team). A glowing floor panel in the south-east corner leads to the hostages' floor. There, after Jessie, James and the Maxie fight, the employee in the hostages' room offers you a **Lv. 70 Lapras**: take it before you go up, because **the hostages leave when the Rocket Boss battle ends**. Outside the Hunyuan Dojo, a Rocket Grunt is bothering Master Ma (optional).

**Opens up:**

- [Rotom's Room (Silph Co.): change Rotom's form](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch11-saffron-takeover-marsh-badge/#rotoms-room-silph-co-change-rotoms-form)
- [Silph Co. (Saffron takeover): the employee's Lapras (missable)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch11-saffron-takeover-marsh-badge/#silph-co-saffron-takeover-the-employees-lapras-missable) Missable
- [Saffron City (takeover): help Ma Baoguo fight off Team Rocket](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch11-saffron-takeover-marsh-badge/#saffron-city-takeover-help-ma-baoguo-fight-off-team-rocket)

**The president's office.** Beat Ariana at the top of Silph Co. to reach the office, where the Rocket Boss presses the president to join Team Rocket. Choose how to act (it changes only a few lines), watch your Sub. Doll take the blow, then battle the **Rocket Boss** (Nidoqueen, Beedrill, Rhydon, Marowak, Swampert, Sandslash, all Lv. 100). **Losing does not white you out and the story goes on either way.** You wake up in the Pokémon Center and Lance gives you a Vs. Recorder: **Saffron is freed**, the hostages are gone and Grandma's treats errand in Celadon is over.

**Opens up:**

- [Silph Co. president's office: the Goodshow meeting and the Saffron takeover finale](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch11-saffron-takeover-marsh-badge/#silph-co-presidents-office-the-goodshow-meeting-and-the-saffron-takeover-finale)

**The Marsh Badge.** With Saffron free again, battle **Sabrina** in her Gym for the **Marsh Badge**, which lets your Pokémon use Fly outside battle. She registers her number and tells you to visit the **Alto Mare Islands**, where Granny Mae has mastered ultimate moves: **the Vermilion harbor has reopened**, so take your S.S. Ticket there. The Marsh Badge also unlocks two strong optional Trainers: Veteran Dawn on Route 9 now, and Ace Trainer Marisa on Route 11 once a later story scene in Johto has played. Koga is back in Fuchsia for anything left in that town.

Quests in this chapter:

- Pokémon Tower: make Sabrina laugh (the Marsh Badge trial)
- Saffron City: the Team Rocket takeover (what it closes)
- Saffron City (takeover): getting past the barrier into the city
- Rotom's Room (Silph Co.): change Rotom's form
- Silph Co. (Saffron takeover): the employee's Lapras (missable)
- Saffron City (takeover): help Ma Baoguo fight off Team Rocket
- Silph Co. president's office: the Goodshow meeting and the Saffron takeover finale

---

## Chapter 12: The Alto Mare Islands, Viridian Gym and the Earth Badge

Source: https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch12-alto-mare-viridian-earth-badge/

Sabrina has sent you to the Alto Mare Islands. The reason is simple: **the Viridian Gym stays closed until you pass Granny Mae's trial on Two Island**, and the Earth Badge is the last Kanto Badge you need for the Victory Road gate.

**Main quest in this chapter:** take the ship from Vermilion to the Alto Mare Islands, find a partner for Granny Mae's trial on Two Island (it turns out to be Blue) and pass her five-stage test, then go back to Viridian City and win the **Earth Badge** from Giovanni.

The Alto Mare travel agency, which sails to Four, Five, Six and Seven Island, is closed for "high-tide season" until Johto's sea route reopens, and Three Island's biker business starts then too. You do not have to wait for the ferries, though: One Island and Two Island are open, and with Surf you can sail to **every island** yourself (see the optional step on Four to Seven Island). The Island Pilgrimage, the Island Cave story and the biker business come much later.

The Earth Badge also ends the Pidgeot loan for Pikachu starters.

### Walkthrough

**The ship.** At Vermilion Harbor, show your S.S. Ticket and take the ship to the Alto Mare Islands. Sabrina told you the harbor is open again. **Save before you start Granny Mae's trial:** it cannot be paused.

**Two Island: a partner for Granny Mae.** Granny Mae's hall is behind the north-east door of Two Island. The receptionist only starts the trial for two challengers, so ask the Trainer from Johto standing a few steps south of the north-east Islander's House door to join you. He has lost his nerve, but **Blue** turns up ("Viridian Gym was closed...") and teams up with you.

**Opens up:**

- [Two Island: a partner for Granny Mae's trial](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch12-alto-mare-viridian-earth-badge/#two-island-a-partner-for-granny-maes-trial)

**Granny Mae's ultimate-move trial.** Talk to the receptionist with Blue at your side: a singles assessment, a five-question knowledge quiz, a doubles assessment, a single battle against **Blue** and a Multi Battle with Blue against Granny Mae and Dana. The last three run straight into each other with no healing in between, so **heal before you walk up to the doubles opponent**. Pass it and Blue says he is going to the Viridian Gym. Granny Mae now teaches Frenzy Plant, Blast Burn and Hydro Cannon to fully evolved starters, for free.

**Opens up:**

- [Two Island: Granny Mae's ultimate-move trial](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch12-alto-mare-viridian-earth-badge/#two-island-granny-maes-ultimate-move-trial)

**Also on the islands.** On **Two Island**, Fern's clinic has a "sick" Chatot (bring a Chatot as your first healthy Pokémon), and the market has a barter stall, a treasure seller and an S.S. Anne passenger who thanks you if the ship did not sink. On **One Island**, the Pokémon Center's composer wants a title for his piece, the Island Restaurant serves battle meals, and the Alto Mare Library has a legends quiz. With Surf you can also reach the **Alto Mare Waters**: a lifeguard and Charmander's owner, and a fan who battles you for a Heart Scale.

**Opens up:**

- [Two Island: Fern's "sick" Chatot (Chatot needed)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch12-alto-mare-viridian-earth-badge/#two-island-ferns-sick-chatot-chatot-needed)
- [Two Island: small extras](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch12-alto-mare-viridian-earth-badge/#two-island-small-extras)
- [One Island: the composer's title → Miracle Seed → TM86 Grass Knot](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch12-alto-mare-viridian-earth-badge/#one-island-the-composers-title--miracle-seed--tm86-grass-knot)
- [One Island: the Island Restaurant's battle meals (repeatable)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch12-alto-mare-viridian-earth-badge/#one-island-the-island-restaurants-battle-meals-repeatable)
- [Alto Mare Library (One Island): the legends quiz](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch12-alto-mare-viridian-earth-badge/#alto-mare-library-one-island-the-legends-quiz)
- [Alto Mare Waters: Charmander's owner and the lifeguard](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch12-alto-mare-viridian-earth-badge/#alto-mare-waters-charmanders-owner-and-the-lifeguard)
- [Alto Mare Waters / Mt. Mortar: small extras](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch12-alto-mare-viridian-earth-badge/#alto-mare-waters--mt-mortar-small-extras)

**Surf to Four, Five, Six and Seven Island.** The travel agency's ferries are closed, but you do not need them: with Surf (Rainbow Badge) the open sea of the Alto Mare Waters leads to the shore of every island, and from there into the towns. The extras that have no story condition can be done as soon as you are here: the **Manaphy Egg** girl in the Alto Mare Waters and her trail over Six, Five and Four Island; on **Four Island** the Mystery Stone buyer (do **not** sell Mr. Fuji's stone) and the Stone Workshop extras; on **Five Island** the four-leaf clover scene (only while a sick Trainer is there, i.e. **before** you meet the Virtue examiner in the Viridian Gym), the monk's hungry Snorlax and the Croagunk's mother; on **Six Island** the Island Forest jobs and the Crawdaunt wallet thief; on **Seven Island** the Clamperl pearl scam and the snack thief (an Alomomola first in your party); and a few small extras. The Island Pilgrimage, the Island Cave story and the Three Island bikers come much later.

**Opens up:**

- [Alto Mare Waters → islands → back: the Manaphy Egg](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch12-alto-mare-viridian-earth-badge/#alto-mare-waters--islands--back-the-manaphy-egg)
- [Four Island: the Mystery Stone buyer (don't sell it)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch12-alto-mare-viridian-earth-badge/#four-island-the-mystery-stone-buyer-dont-sell-it) Missable
- [Four Island: small extras (Stone Workshop)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch12-alto-mare-viridian-earth-badge/#four-island-small-extras-stone-workshop)
- [Five Island: the four-leaf clover (speak up for him)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch12-alto-mare-viridian-earth-badge/#five-island-the-four-leaf-clover-speak-up-for-him) Missable
- [Five Island: the monk's hungry Snorlax (→ Yellow Flute)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch12-alto-mare-viridian-earth-badge/#five-island-the-monks-hungry-snorlax--yellow-flute)
- [Five Island: water for Croagunk (→ PP Max)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch12-alto-mare-viridian-earth-badge/#five-island-water-for-croagunk--pp-max)
- [Island Forest (Six Island): before the Lucky Meowth God](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch12-alto-mare-viridian-earth-badge/#island-forest-six-island-before-the-lucky-meowth-god) Missable
- [Six Island: the Crawdaunt wallet thief (before the Lucky Meowth God)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch12-alto-mare-viridian-earth-badge/#six-island-the-crawdaunt-wallet-thief-before-the-lucky-meowth-god) Missable
- [Seven Island: the Clamperl pearl scam](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch12-alto-mare-viridian-earth-badge/#seven-island-the-clamperl-pearl-scam)
- [Seven Island: the snack thief (Kecleon)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch12-alto-mare-viridian-earth-badge/#seven-island-the-snack-thief-kecleon)
- [Sevii Islands: small extras](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch12-alto-mare-viridian-earth-badge/#sevii-islands-small-extras)

**Back to Viridian City: the Viridian Gym.** The Gym is open again. Talk to the man just inside the door (face him from directly in front): he is the **Virtue examiner**. Help Yellow, the girl standing with her uncle and his Doduo just south of the Mart, get her first Pokémon (you need a plain Poké Ball). Then answer the second examiner's Wisdom quiz, get through the Skill trainers and battle **Giovanni** for the **Earth Badge**. **The Earth Badge ends the Pidgeot loan** for Pikachu starters.

**Opens up:**

- [Viridian City: Yellow's first Pokémon (the Gym's Virtue trial)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch12-alto-mare-viridian-earth-badge/#viridian-city-yellows-first-pok%C3%A9mon-the-gyms-virtue-trial)
- [Viridian Gym: the Wisdom quiz (two ways to pass)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch12-alto-mare-viridian-earth-badge/#viridian-gym-the-wisdom-quiz-two-ways-to-pass)

Quests in this chapter:

- Two Island: a partner for Granny Mae's trial
- Two Island: Granny Mae's ultimate-move trial
- Two Island: Fern's "sick" Chatot (Chatot needed)
- Two Island: small extras
- One Island: the composer's title → Miracle Seed → TM86 Grass Knot
- One Island: the Island Restaurant's battle meals (repeatable)
- Alto Mare Library (One Island): the legends quiz
- Alto Mare Waters: Charmander's owner and the lifeguard
- Alto Mare Waters / Mt. Mortar: small extras
- Alto Mare Waters → islands → back: the Manaphy Egg
- Four Island: the Mystery Stone buyer (don't sell it)
- Four Island: small extras (Stone Workshop)
- Five Island: the four-leaf clover (speak up for him)
- Five Island: the monk's hungry Snorlax (→ Yellow Flute)
- Five Island: water for Croagunk (→ PP Max)
- Island Forest (Six Island): before the Lucky Meowth God
- Six Island: the Crawdaunt wallet thief (before the Lucky Meowth God)
- Seven Island: the Clamperl pearl scam
- Seven Island: the snack thief (Kecleon)
- Sevii Islands: small extras
- Viridian City: Yellow's first Pokémon (the Gym's Virtue trial)
- Viridian Gym: the Wisdom quiz (two ways to pass)

---

## Chapter 13: Victory Road and the Indigo Conference

Source: https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch13-victory-road-indigo-conference/

With eight Kanto Badges you can enter the Victory Road gate and take part in the **Indigo Conference**. This is the end of the Kanto story: after your first Hall of Fame entry the game moves on to Johto.
