**Main quest in this chapter:** pass the qualifiers on Victory Road (uncover the League staff member disguised as a competitor and learn the password), win the tournament matches on the Indigo Plateau and the League HQ plaza, beat the Elite Four and the final against Blue, and enter the **Hall of Fame**.

You need the **Earth Badge** to get in (the gate guard only checks that one), and you must have sold or tossed all **Escape Ropes** before the receptionist lets you into the cave.

### Walkthrough

**The Victory Road gate and the qualifiers.** Walk into the middle of the hall: at the opening ceremony the MC explains the rules. A League staff member is disguised as one of the competitors, and you must find out who to learn the password. The receptionist at the cave door in the north of the hall turns you back if you still carry Escape Ropes (sell them to the clerk beside her). Beat Ninja Girl **Janine** on Victory Road 2F first: only then does the right Trainer on 3F, chosen by your gender, starter and Route 11 choice (see the quest's table), reveal the password. Give the password to the staff member at the exit on 3F after beating the two guards in a Double Battle.

On **Victory Road 1F**, on the west side, an item ball is actually a wild **Lv. 70 Electrode**.

**Opens up:**

- [Victory Road: the Indigo Conference qualifiers (find the hidden staff member)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch13-victory-road-indigo-conference/#victory-road-the-indigo-conference-qualifiers-find-the-hidden-staff-member)
- [Victory Road 1F: the fake item ball (Lv. 70 Electrode)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch13-victory-road-indigo-conference/#victory-road-1f-the-fake-item-ball-lv-70-electrode)

**The main tournament.** Your friends gather one by one on the slope above the Victory Road exit; talk to Blue, Green/Red, Misty, Cynthia and Steven, then to the MC at the top. Round one is a fight against Goh on the Water Field (Lv. 80). Blue then asks whether you will cheer for Misty or Steven: **this choice matters for the romance route** (cheering for one closes the other's route; skipping both closes both). The tournament then moves to the League HQ plaza: a battle against **Steven** and a semifinal against **Karen**.

**Opens up:**

- [Indigo Plateau: the Indigo Conference main tournament and the "who do you cheer for?" choice (romance)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch13-victory-road-indigo-conference/#indigo-plateau-the-indigo-conference-main-tournament-and-the-who-do-you-cheer-for-choice-romance)

**The final: the Elite Four and Blue.** President Goodshow congratulates the last two finalists (you and Blue): the final is decided by how many of the Elite Four each of you beats, and tied scores are settled by a battle against each other. The final is held in the Elite Four's rooms inside the League HQ building (a trip to HQ first lets you heal and change your team). Beat the Elite Four and then **Blue**, who is already League Champion and demands to be beaten first; each of them lets you choose Singles or Doubles. Goodshow declares you both outstanding Champions, and Lance leads you to the **Hall of Fame**.

**Opens up:**

- [Cinnabar Gym: Blaine rematch (after your first Hall of Fame)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch13-victory-road-indigo-conference/#cinnabar-gym-blaine-rematch-after-your-first-hall-of-fame)

**End of the Kanto story.** The Hall of Fame entry marks the game as cleared. Several repeatable extras open: the Elite Four's and Blue's practice battles, Sabrina's and Blaine's rematches, and for Pikachu starters the Pidgeot you lent in the Viridian Forest can now be collected. Giovanni's duel in Cerulean Cave comes next, then Mt. Silver, New Bark Town and Johto (the next chapters).

Quests in this chapter:

- Victory Road: the Indigo Conference qualifiers (find the hidden staff member)
- Victory Road 1F: the fake item ball (Lv. 70 Electrode)
- Indigo Plateau: the Indigo Conference main tournament and the "who do you cheer for?" choice (romance)
- Cinnabar Gym: Blaine rematch (after your first Hall of Fame)

---

## Chapter 14: Cerulean Cave and the Mt. Silver Lodge

Source: https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch14-cerulean-cave-mt-silver-lodge/

Your first Hall of Fame entry ends the Kanto story. The way on is a chain of three scenes: a duel with Giovanni in Cerulean Cave, a long rest at the hot-spring lodge on Mt. Silver, and a visit to Prof. Oak, who sends you to New Bark Town with three Pokédexes. Only after that does the guard on Route 26 let you into Johto.

**Main quest in this chapter:** win the duel against Giovanni and Mewtwo in Cerulean Cave, go through the rehabilitation at the Mt. Silver lodge (talk to Sabrina, battle, soak in the hot spring, repeat), then go home to Pallet Town and thank Prof. Oak.

**Do not confuse the conferences.** The Indigo Conference ended with your Hall of Fame entry. The **Silver Conference** that people mention from now on is a separate event on top of Mt. Silver. It starts much later, after you have the Johto Badges, and it is what starts the League HQ investigations. You cannot take part in it yet.

### Walkthrough

**What the first Hall of Fame entry opens.** The game counts as cleared. The Elite Four now offer repeatable Singles or Doubles practice battles, and in the Champion's room the attendant can call Blue to battle (Yellow and Gold join the list later). The extras the guide calls "after your first Hall of Fame" open too, for example Sabrina's and Blaine's rematches. These are **not** post-game: post-game only starts with the final Hall of Fame entry at the very end of the story.

**Opens up:**

- [The Hall of Fame: what your two entries unlock](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch14-cerulean-cave-mt-silver-lodge/#the-hall-of-fame-what-your-two-entries-unlock)

**Cerulean Cave: Giovanni's duel.** Cerulean Cave lies behind the fence on the west side of Cerulean City. Misty and Brock are invited too: a mysterious letter from Nurse Joy asks you to the hidden arena at the bottom of the cave. Cross the cave (its Pokémon are very strong) and talk to Nurse Joy, who leads the guests to Giovanni.

Giovanni fights with his full **Lv. 100** team. Losing does not white you out, and if you **win**, Mewtwo uses Recover and the same battle starts again: the duel only moves on when you lose. You wake up "at the bottom of the lake" and challenge Giovanni again in a **Double Battle** (**a loss here does white you out**, and you replay the whole scene). If you chose Charmander and still carry Mr. Fuji's Mystery Stone, the stone turns into a Charizardite. After the win you free Mewtwo, Giovanni escapes and you wake up at home.

**Opens up:**

- [Cerulean Cave: Giovanni's duel and the Charizardite](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch14-cerulean-cave-mt-silver-lodge/#cerulean-cave-giovannis-duel-and-the-charizardite)
- [Small extras](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch14-cerulean-cave-mt-silver-lodge/#small-extras)

**Mt. Silver: the rehabilitation.** Back home, Prof. Oak says the Pokémon League will let you onto Mt. Silver to recover. At the reception gate on Route 26 (the building between Route 22 and the Indigo Plateau) the guard now sends you west to Route 28, through Mt. Silver Cave and out of its north-west corner, where the hot-spring lodge stands. Sabrina runs the treatment: **talk to Sabrina, battle, soak in the hot spring, talk to Sabrina again.** The opponents are Brock, then Misty, then Blue, then Sabrina herself, and in the same visit Yellow walks in and finishes the cure. Every battle that you lose whites you out; talk to Sabrina to retry the round. After Yellow, soak once more; Sabrina joins you in the spring, and you go home to Pallet Town.

Mt. Silver itself stays closed beyond the lodge: the mountain path is shut by order of President Goodshow until you hold the Rising Badge.

**Opens up:**

- [Mt. Silver lodge: the rehabilitation (how to move it along)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch14-cerulean-cave-mt-silver-lodge/#mt-silver-lodge-the-rehabilitation-how-to-move-it-along)
- [League gate, Mt. Silver, Route 29 and Cherrygrove: small extras](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch14-cerulean-cave-mt-silver-lodge/#league-gate-mt-silver-route-29-and-cherrygrove-small-extras)

**Home and Prof. Oak.** You wake up in your house in Pallet Town. Your mother tells you to thank Prof. Oak before you go. In Oak's lab President Goodshow is waiting: while you were fighting Giovanni, Team Rocket in Johto attacked several cities, and the League wants you to follow them there. Oak gives you **three Pokédexes for Prof. Elm** in New Bark Town. Walk to the Indigo Plateau gate and follow Route 26 south: the Johto border guard now lets you pass.

Quests in this chapter:

- The Hall of Fame: what your two entries unlock
- Cerulean Cave: Giovanni's duel and the Charizardite
- Mt. Silver lodge: the rehabilitation (how to move it along)
- League gate, Mt. Silver, Route 29 and Cherrygrove: small extras
- Small extras

---

## Chapter 15: Into Johto: Route 26, Route 27 and New Bark Town

Source: https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch15-route-26-new-bark-town/

Johto begins. The guard at the north end of Route 26 no longer turns you back, and the road leads south and then east to New Bark Town, where Prof. Elm waits for the Pokédexes you carry.

**Main quest in this chapter:** follow Route 26 and Route 27 to New Bark Town and give the Pokédexes to Prof. Elm in his lab. Gold, the boy who is just setting out, challenges you to a race for the eight Johto Badges.

**Before you go further:** Johto has its own Badge order (Zephyr, Hive, Plain, Fog, Storm, Mineral, Glacier, Rising). Your eight Kanto Badges are enough for Surf, Cut, Strength, Fly, Whirlpool and Waterfall; Rock Climb needs the Rising Badge.

### Walkthrough

**Route 26.** Walk out of the reception gate to the south. The guard at the north end of Route 26 ("Up ahead is the Johto region...") only stops you until Oak's errand has started. Two houses stand by the road: the **weekday siblings' house** (the item quiz) with a man and his Phanpy a little way south-east of its door, and the house at the **north end** of the route (the old man who sells rest).

**Opens up:**

- [Route 26: the Phanpy trainer's Nugget (sell for $30,000 or give for TM41)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch15-route-26-new-bark-town/#route-26-the-phanpy-trainers-nugget-sell-for-30000-or-give-for-tm41)
- [Route 26: the item quiz in the weekday siblings' house (→ TM43)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch15-route-26-new-bark-town/#route-26-the-item-quiz-in-the-weekday-siblings-house--tm43)
- [Route 26: the old man's paid rest (unlocks Focus Sash sales)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch15-route-26-new-bark-town/#route-26-the-old-mans-paid-rest-unlocks-focus-sash-sales)

**Route 27 and Tohjo Falls.** On Route 27 a short scene plays: a Mew nuzzles you, Goh barges in and fights you for it, and Eusine realises that the "Suicune" he was chasing was not the real one. Near the west end, the **guard post** just south of the two Tohjo Falls entrances registers you as the Champion; the guard there has a letter for a girl in Ecruteak. A **musician** stands about 40 steps east of the guard post. With the Earth Badge (Waterfall) and Surf you can also reach the **hidden room in Tohjo Falls**, where a Black Belt waits for a battle.

**Opens up:**

- [Route 27 → Ecruteak City: the outpost guard's letter to Momo (before the Mineral Badge)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch15-route-26-new-bark-town/#route-27--ecruteak-city-the-outpost-guards-letter-to-momo-before-the-mineral-badge) Missable
- [Route 27: the musician's song or battle (→ Soothe Bell)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch15-route-26-new-bark-town/#route-27-the-musicians-song-or-battle--soothe-bell)
- [Tohjo Falls: the hermit in the hidden room (→ TM52)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch15-route-26-new-bark-town/#tohjo-falls-the-hermit-in-the-hidden-room--tm52)

**New Bark Town and Prof. Elm.** At the east end of Route 27 you reach New Bark Town. Gold is about to set out with his Cyndaquil. Go into **Prof. Elm's lab** and hand over the Pokédex: Elm is amazed that the Champion delivered it in person, gives Gold his Pokédex (the other two are kept for promising new Trainers), registers his phone number in your Pokégear and thanks you with a gift. Gold challenges you to see who collects all eight Johto Badges first.

In the **New Bark Town Guesthouse**, a woman with a Luxray asks a three-question quiz about the Pokémon next to her.

**Opens up:**

- [New Bark Town Guesthouse: the Sinnoh traveller's quiz (→ Shinx)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch15-route-26-new-bark-town/#new-bark-town-guesthouse-the-sinnoh-travellers-quiz--shinx)

Quests in this chapter:

- Route 26: the Phanpy trainer's Nugget (sell for $30,000 or give for TM41)
- Route 26: the item quiz in the weekday siblings' house (→ TM43)
- Route 26: the old man's paid rest (unlocks Focus Sash sales)
- Route 27 → Ecruteak City: the outpost guard's letter to Momo (before the Mineral Badge)
- Route 27: the musician's song or battle (→ Soothe Bell)
- Tohjo Falls: the hermit in the hidden room (→ TM52)
- New Bark Town Guesthouse: the Sinnoh traveller's quiz (→ Shinx)

---

## Chapter 16: Route 29, Cherrygrove City and the Dark Cave

Source: https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch16-cherrygrove-dark-cave/

From New Bark Town the road runs west along Route 29 to Cherrygrove City, then north along Routes 30 and 31 towards Violet City. On the way you meet **Crystal**, a local girl who is about to become a Pokédex holder, and you run into the first Team Rocket trouble of Johto at Dark Cave.

**Main quest in this chapter:** follow Crystal's tour of Cherrygrove City to the orphanage, go on north to the Dark Cave entrance on Route 31, and then stop Team Rocket's dig on **Route 46**. You must play the Route 46 scene: the memorial ceremony in Violet City's Sprout Tower only starts after it.

**Deadlines:** the dig scene removes the Stantler herd on Route 30, so do the Noctowl trick first if you want the Stantler. Mr. Pokémon only asks his quiz after the Dark Cave trouble is over, and **before you own HM08 Rock Climb**.

### Walkthrough

**Route 29.** Walk west from New Bark Town. A man by the Apricorn tree wants to buy Kurt's Apricorn Box, a girl with an Elekid asks you about a Pokéathlon athlete (one chance either way for both), and a die-hard fan challenges you to a battle near the New Bark end of the route (he offers sparring any time afterwards). A side gatehouse leads north to Route 46 and the Dark Cave exit; you will use it later in this chapter.

**Opens up:**

- [Route 29: Casey's Pokéathlon question (→ Electirizer)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch16-cherrygrove-dark-cave/#route-29-caseys-pok%C3%A9athlon-question--electirizer) Missable
- [Route 29: Uncle Apricorn wants Kurt's Apricorn Box (say No twice)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch16-cherrygrove-dark-cave/#route-29-uncle-apricorn-wants-kurts-apricorn-box-say-no-twice) Missable

**Cherrygrove City: Crystal's tour.** At the east edge of town Crystal calls you over and shows you the city: she sells 10 Poké Balls for $800 during the tour (one free if you cannot pay) and ends at the **orphanage**. In the orphanage let the children play with your Pokémon; Rhett runs off after a Slugma, and you help Crystal hold the Slugma back at the north edge of town (a battle against three Slugma that earns 5 Heal Balls). Silver also shows up here and drops his Trainer Card. Besides the story you can do in town: the **Berry Pots girl** in the south-east flowers (needs the Squirt Bottle), the **Wooper and the lost Poké Ball** on the west shore, and a fighter's house in the south-west row.

**Opens up:**

- [Cherrygrove City: Crystal, the orphanage and Rhett's Slugma (story chain; where to go next)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch16-cherrygrove-dark-cave/#cherrygrove-city-crystal-the-orphanage-and-rhetts-slugma-story-chain-where-to-go-next)
- [Cherrygrove City: the Berry Pots girl (→ 6 PP Up; one chance)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch16-cherrygrove-dark-cave/#cherrygrove-city-the-berry-pots-girl--6-pp-up-one-chance) Missable
- [Cherrygrove City: the Wooper and the lost Poké Ball (→ Focus Band)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch16-cherrygrove-dark-cave/#cherrygrove-city-the-wooper-and-the-lost-pok%C3%A9-ball--focus-band)
- [Cherrygrove City: small extras](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch16-cherrygrove-dark-cave/#cherrygrove-city-small-extras)

**Elm and Crystal's Pokédex.** Crystal's skill impresses you. Later, back in Prof. Elm's lab with Gold (the talk is about a stolen Totodile and the Trainer Card Silver dropped), you recommend Crystal as a Pokédex holder. Elm goes to the orphanage and gives Crystal a Pokédex and a Chikorita. That releases the wild **Chikorita** on Routes 30 and 31.

**Opens up:**

- [Route 30 → Route 31: the wild Chikorita that challenges Trainers (catch it; one chance)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch16-cherrygrove-dark-cave/#route-30--route-31-the-wild-chikorita-that-challenges-trainers-catch-it-one-chance) Missable

**Route 30.** North of Cherrygrove the road leads past a fishing pond to **Mr. Pokémon's house** at the north end. A herd of **Stantler** blocks one of the two paths: lead with a **Noctowl** (it need not know Foresight) and talk to a Stantler to dispel the illusion; one real Stantler is left to catch. A Youngster with a Rattata starts the wild Chikorita's rampage, which continues on Route 31. Mr. Pokémon first only worries about Dark Cave; once the trouble is over he asks his five-question quiz (Exp. Share).

**Opens up:**

- [Route 30: the Stantler roadblock (Noctowl's Foresight)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch16-cherrygrove-dark-cave/#route-30-the-stantler-roadblock-noctowls-foresight) Missable
- [Route 30: Mr. Pokémon's quiz (→ Exp. Share)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch16-cherrygrove-dark-cave/#route-30-mr-pok%C3%A9mons-quiz--exp-share) Missable

**Route 31 and the Dark Cave entrance.** On Route 31 the wild Chikorita beats an Oddish and meets a Bug Catcher with a Yanma near the west end (catch the Chikorita there). In front of the Dark Cave entrance Gold and Crystal argue: Gold wants to rush in, Crystal says that nobody has **Flash**. Give Crystal your **TM70 Flash** so her Chikorita can light the way (TM70 costs $8,000 in the Route 10 Pokémon Center in Kanto if you do not have one).

**Opens up:**

- [Route 31: give Crystal your Flash TM (the way into Dark Cave)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch16-cherrygrove-dark-cave/#route-31-give-crystal-your-flash-tm-the-way-into-dark-cave)

**Route 46: Team Rocket's dig.** Walk to the north end of Route 46, two steps south of the Dark Cave door (from the Route 29 gatehouse or through Dark Cave). Crystal has cornered Cassidy and Butch while they dig: you fight them in a Multi Battle with Crystal as partner, then **Charon and Lawrence** in a Double Battle with no healing in between. Charon's Dugtrio grabs Crystal; when Charon orders you to put your Pokémon away, answer **Yes** if you want Crystal as your romance partner. Afterwards the dig site clears, the herd of Stantler on Route 30 is gone for good, and the dig man's "rolling" item shop stops selling.

**Opens up:**

- [Route 46: Team Rocket's dig and Crystal taken hostage (story; romance choice; continues Ilex Forest and Goldenrod City's romance entry)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch16-cherrygrove-dark-cave/#route-46-team-rockets-dig-and-crystal-taken-hostage-story-romance-choice-continues-ilex-forest-and-goldenrod-citys-romance-entry)

Quests in this chapter:

- Route 29: Casey's Pokéathlon question (→ Electirizer)
- Route 29: Uncle Apricorn wants Kurt's Apricorn Box (say No twice)
- Cherrygrove City: Crystal, the orphanage and Rhett's Slugma (story chain; where to go next)
- Cherrygrove City: the Berry Pots girl (→ 6 PP Up; one chance)
- Cherrygrove City: the Wooper and the lost Poké Ball (→ Focus Band)
- Cherrygrove City: small extras
- Route 30 → Route 31: the wild Chikorita that challenges Trainers (catch it; one chance)
- Route 30: the Stantler roadblock (Noctowl's Foresight)
- Route 30: Mr. Pokémon's quiz (→ Exp. Share)
- Route 31: give Crystal your Flash TM (the way into Dark Cave)
- Route 46: Team Rocket's dig and Crystal taken hostage (story; romance choice; continues Ilex Forest and Goldenrod City's romance entry)

---

## Chapter 17: Violet City, Sprout Tower and the Zephyr Badge

Source: https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch17-violet-city-sprout-tower/

Violet City is the first Johto city with a Gym, but the Gym is closed: **Falkner is at Sprout Tower**, where a memorial ceremony is about to start. Several local quests are tied to that ceremony and disappear when it has played.

**Main quest in this chapter:** climb Sprout Tower (past the monks who ask for a toll), take part in the memorial ceremony on the third floor, then win the **Zephyr Badge** from Falkner. The ceremony only starts once you have played the Route 46 dig scene from Chapter 16.

**Before the ceremony** (it closes them for good): Kimono Girl Tamao's and Crystal's battles, the repentant thief, and Gold's warm-up battle in Sprout Tower. **Before you leave Violet for the south:** the Marill quest and the Goh battle also run out later (see their notes).

### Walkthrough

**Violet City.** Walk north from Route 31 into Violet City. In the north part of town **Tamao** (a Kimono Girl) and **Crystal** each ask for a battle, a man south-east of the Sprout Tower entrance has a confession to make, the **Marill's owner** is looking for her runaway Marill on the west side, **Goh** is bullying a boy near the Poké Mart, the **Pokémon Academy** (east house on the Gym's street) holds a class Q&A, and a runner's house at the south end of town wants to see a Rapidash. A couple stands south of the Academy door (the boyfriend only if the S.S. Anne did not sink). The Pokémon Center has Primo's password man and a shard trader.

At the very north end of **Route 32**, just south of Violet City and north of the railway crew, a wandering seller offers Skull and Armor Fossils.

**Opens up:**

- [Violet City: Tamao and Crystal (before the Sprout Tower ceremony)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch17-violet-city-sprout-tower/#violet-city-tamao-and-crystal-before-the-sprout-tower-ceremony) Missable
- [Violet City: the S.S. Anne passenger and his girlfriend (only if you saved the S.S. Anne)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch17-violet-city-sprout-tower/#violet-city-the-ss-anne-passenger-and-his-girlfriend-only-if-you-saved-the-ss-anne)
- [Violet City: the repentant thief (choice, no reward)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch17-violet-city-sprout-tower/#violet-city-the-repentant-thief-choice-no-reward) Missable
- [Violet City: the runaway Marill (→ Heart Scale, 2 PP Max)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch17-violet-city-sprout-tower/#violet-city-the-runaway-marill--heart-scale-2-pp-max) Missable
- [Violet City: teach Goh a lesson (before the Ruins of Alph chapter ends)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch17-violet-city-sprout-tower/#violet-city-teach-goh-a-lesson-before-the-ruins-of-alph-chapter-ends) Missable
- [Violet City: the Pokémon Academy class Q&amp;A (→ TM67 Recycle or 2 Big Pearls)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch17-violet-city-sprout-tower/#violet-city-the-pok%C3%A9mon-academy-class-qa--tm67-recycle-or-2-big-pearls)
- [Violet City: show the runner a Rapidash (→ Magmarizer)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch17-violet-city-sprout-tower/#violet-city-show-the-runner-a-rapidash--magmarizer)
- [Violet City: small extras](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch17-violet-city-sprout-tower/#violet-city-small-extras)
- [Route 32: small extras](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch17-violet-city-sprout-tower/#route-32-small-extras)

**Sprout Tower: the monks' toll.** On the first floor three monks block the way up to the third floor with their Bellsprout and ask for an offering: **$3,000, $5,000 and $10,000**, or you battle them (Lv. 62-65 each). Either answer moves that monk's Bellsprout aside for good; the game does not check that you have the money. Optional extras: **Gold** wants a warm-up battle on the first floor (only before the ceremony), the **S.S. Anne monk** (only if you saved the ship) gives a Chesto Berry, and the **Elder** on the third floor accepts training battles.

**Opens up:**

- [Sprout Tower: the monks' toll (pay or fight)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch17-violet-city-sprout-tower/#sprout-tower-the-monks-toll-pay-or-fight)
- [Sprout Tower: optional battles (Gold, the S.S. Anne monk, the Elder)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch17-violet-city-sprout-tower/#sprout-tower-optional-battles-gold-the-ss-anne-monk-the-elder)

**The memorial ceremony.** On the third floor Falkner asks you to say a few words (all three answers lead to the same scene). **This closes for good:** Tamao's and Crystal's battles and the repentant thief in Violet City, and Gold's warm-up battle in Sprout Tower; Crystal moves on to the Ruins of Alph. Afterwards a **Youngster with a Forretress** appears at the west edge of Violet, who teaches Shell Smash if you show him TM74 Gyro Ball.

**Opens up:**

- [Violet City: Gyro Ball TM for the Forretress kid (unlocks Shell Smash)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch17-violet-city-sprout-tower/#violet-city-gyro-ball-tm-for-the-forretress-kid-unlocks-shell-smash)

**Violet Gym: Falkner.** The Gym is open now. Falkner only accepts the challenge if you carry **four Pokémon or fewer and every one is a Flying type** (the game checks a fixed list of non-Flying species; Eggs are skipped). Win the **Zephyr Badge**, **TM51 Roost** and Falkner's number. The Gym's tutor then teaches Sky Attack.

**Opens up:**

- [Violet Gym: Falkner's rules (Flying types only, 4 Pokémon max)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch17-violet-city-sprout-tower/#violet-gym-falkners-rules-flying-types-only-4-pok%C3%A9mon-max)

Quests in this chapter:

- Violet City: Tamao and Crystal (before the Sprout Tower ceremony)
- Violet City: the S.S. Anne passenger and his girlfriend (only if you saved the S.S. Anne)
- Violet City: the repentant thief (choice, no reward)
- Violet City: the runaway Marill (→ Heart Scale, 2 PP Max)
- Violet City: teach Goh a lesson (before the Ruins of Alph chapter ends)
- Violet City: the Pokémon Academy class Q&A (→ TM67 Recycle or 2 Big Pearls)
- Violet City: show the runner a Rapidash (→ Magmarizer)
- Violet City: small extras
- Route 32: small extras
- Sprout Tower: the monks' toll (pay or fight)
- Sprout Tower: optional battles (Gold, the S.S. Anne monk, the Elder)
- Violet City: Gyro Ball TM for the Forretress kid (unlocks Shell Smash)
- Violet Gym: Falkner's rules (Flying types only, 4 Pokémon max)

---

## Chapter 18: The Ruins of Alph, Route 32 and Union Cave

Source: https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch18-ruins-of-alph-union-cave/

With the Sprout Tower ceremony over, Gold and Crystal turn up at the **Ruins of Alph**, where a researcher's daughter has vanished. The ruins are also the key to the road south: a **railway crew** blocks Route 32 just south of Violet City, and it only leaves when the Molly story is over. Behind it lie Route 32, Union Cave and Route 33.

**Main quest in this chapter:** find Molly in the Ruins of Alph, bring her back, and walk south through Route 32 and Union Cave. On Route 33 a scene with Gold, Crystal, Silver and two Team Rocket Executives sends you on to Azalea Town.

**Deadlines:** the **Route 32 Pokémon Center storm patients** (Nurse Joy, the Cubone, the Bonsly and the Igglybuff) must be finished before you walk out of Union Cave onto Route 33. Bring **Moomoo Milk** and a **Hard Stone** with you.

### Walkthrough

**The Ruins of Alph.** In the Research Center the assistant tells you that **Molly**, Prof. Hale's six-year-old daughter, is missing. Ask **both Gold** (just north-west of the Research Center door) **and Crystal** (south of the small building in the middle of the ruins) about Molly and answer Yes each time: only then does **Silver** appear in the Kabuto chamber in the north-east. If the grass beside the chamber blocks you, it is solid scenery: walk around the large ruin to the south and approach the door from the east.

Battle Silver; the Unown then drop everyone into a dead end. Keep choosing until the new option **"I don't know either"** appears, face **Entei**, touch the statue on the right and fight your way through the dream world: Molly's clone, three Multi Battles with Silver, Gold and Crystal, and two Double Battles against Entei's team on the stairs. Back at the Research Center you receive the **Unown Report**.

Also in the ruins: a girl who saw her own face on a statue (bring a Potion), an Infernape's owner outside the Route 36 gatehouse, a tutor for Ancient Power (1 Rare Bone) and the four stone panels with their back walls.

**Opens up:**

- [Ruins of Alph: blocked grass — how to reach Silver and the Kabuto chamber](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch18-ruins-of-alph-union-cave/#ruins-of-alph-blocked-grass--how-to-reach-silver-and-the-kabuto-chamber)
- [Ruins of Alph: the missing Molly (story chapter; how to move it along)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch18-ruins-of-alph-union-cave/#ruins-of-alph-the-missing-molly-story-chapter-how-to-move-it-along)
- [Ruins of Alph: the four stone panels and the chamber walls (continues Cherrygrove City to Azalea Town's Ruins of Alph entries)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch18-ruins-of-alph-union-cave/#ruins-of-alph-the-four-stone-panels-and-the-chamber-walls-continues-cherrygrove-city-to-azalea-towns-ruins-of-alph-entries)
- [Ruins of Alph: the girl who saw her own face (→ Rock Incense)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch18-ruins-of-alph-union-cave/#ruins-of-alph-the-girl-who-saw-her-own-face--rock-incense)
- [Ruins of Alph: small extras](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch18-ruins-of-alph-union-cave/#ruins-of-alph-small-extras)

**The Molly chapter ends.** **This closes for good:** Goh's challenge in Violet City ("Teach Goh a lesson"). The **railway crew** on Route 32 leaves, and the Kabuto wall closes again. If you took the Wooper's Poké Ball by force in Cherrygrove City, a Quagsire ambushes you the next time you walk along the Route 32 riverbank (one battle, then 10 each of your Ultra Balls, Great Balls and Poké Balls are taken).

**Opens up:**

- [Route 32: the Quagsire's revenge (only if you took the Wooper's Poké Ball by force)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch18-ruins-of-alph-union-cave/#route-32-the-quagsires-revenge-only-if-you-took-the-woopers-pok%C3%A9-ball-by-force)

**Route 32.** South of the crew's old spot the route is full of small jobs: a **fire-breather** who only battles Fire types (TM50 Overheat), a girl whose **Mareep** keeps running off (give her a Magnet), a man who asks whether people should eat Pokémon, and a **storm-damaged Hoppip** owner who wants her three Hoppip brought back (the Hurricane tutor). At the south end the **Route 32 Pokémon Center** is full of storm patients: talk to **Nurse Joy** first, give the Cubone **Moomoo Milk** and patch the Bonsly with a **Hard Stone** (a PP Max each), and fetch Joy for the injured Igglybuff outside (a Life Orb).

**Opens up:**

- [Route 32: the Hoppip blown away by the storm (→ Hurricane tutor)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch18-ruins-of-alph-union-cave/#route-32-the-hoppip-blown-away-by-the-storm--hurricane-tutor)
- [Route 32: the fire-breather's Fire-only battle (→ TM50 Overheat)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch18-ruins-of-alph-union-cave/#route-32-the-fire-breathers-fire-only-battle--tm50-overheat)
- [Route 32: give the Mareep girl a Magnet (→ Max Revive)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch18-ruins-of-alph-union-cave/#route-32-give-the-mareep-girl-a-magnet--max-revive)
- [Route 32: "Should people eat Pokémon?" (Leftovers or Sharp Beak)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch18-ruins-of-alph-union-cave/#route-32-should-people-eat-pok%C3%A9mon-leftovers-or-sharp-beak)
- [Route 32 Pokémon Center: the storm patients and the injured Igglybuff (missable; before Route 33)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch18-ruins-of-alph-union-cave/#route-32-pok%C3%A9mon-center-the-storm-patients-and-the-injured-igglybuff-missable-before-route-33) Missable

**Union Cave.** Union Cave 1F has Goh and a wild Cyndaquil on a ledge in the west, a boy with a Zubat in the east, and Hiker Jeb with his Tyranitar in the south-west. On B1F a weekday item seller, a psychic healer and the old woman who asks for $2,000 to lead you past the lava heat wait further in. (The Cyndaquil quest closes when you finish Bugsy's hunt in Ilex Forest.)

**Opens up:**

- [Union Cave 1F: Goh and the wild Cyndaquil (before you finish the Ilex Forest story)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch18-ruins-of-alph-union-cave/#union-cave-1f-goh-and-the-wild-cyndaquil-before-you-finish-the-ilex-forest-story) Missable
- [Union Cave 1F: the Zubat boy's evolution question (one gift)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch18-ruins-of-alph-union-cave/#union-cave-1f-the-zubat-boys-evolution-question-one-gift)
- [Union Cave: small extras](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch18-ruins-of-alph-union-cave/#union-cave-small-extras)

**Route 33: Gold, Crystal, Silver and Team Rocket.** As you step out of Union Cave Gold tells you about the lower level, Crystal arrives with new catches, and Silver is cornered by Proton and Archie. Gold chases Silver away; Silver says Team Rocket is planning something around Azalea Town. **This closes for good:** the Route 32 Pokémon Center storm event (any unfinished PP Max or the Life Orb is lost). A rain-team Ace Trainer waits a few steps south-west of the cave exit.

**Opens up:**

- [Route 33: the rain-team Ace Trainer (→ 5 Dive Balls)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch18-ruins-of-alph-union-cave/#route-33-the-rain-team-ace-trainer--5-dive-balls)

Quests in this chapter:

- Ruins of Alph: blocked grass — how to reach Silver and the Kabuto chamber
- Ruins of Alph: the missing Molly (story chapter; how to move it along)
- Ruins of Alph: the four stone panels and the chamber walls (continues Cherrygrove City to Azalea Town's Ruins of Alph entries)
- Ruins of Alph: the girl who saw her own face (→ Rock Incense)
- Ruins of Alph: small extras
- Route 32: the Quagsire's revenge (only if you took the Wooper's Poké Ball by force)
- Route 32: the Hoppip blown away by the storm (→ Hurricane tutor)
- Route 32: the fire-breather's Fire-only battle (→ TM50 Overheat)
- Route 32: give the Mareep girl a Magnet (→ Max Revive)
- Route 32: "Should people eat Pokémon?" (Leftovers or Sharp Beak)
- Route 32 Pokémon Center: the storm patients and the injured Igglybuff (missable; before Route 33)
- Union Cave 1F: Goh and the wild Cyndaquil (before you finish the Ilex Forest story)
- Union Cave 1F: the Zubat boy's evolution question (one gift)
- Union Cave: small extras
- Route 33: the rain-team Ace Trainer (→ 5 Dive Balls)

---

## Chapter 19: Azalea Town, Slowpoke Well and Ilex Forest

Source: https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch19-azalea-slowpoke-well-ilex-forest/

Silver's warning on Route 33 was right: Team Rocket is in **Azalea Town** and heads for **Slowpoke Well**. After the well, Ilex Forest is next: Bugsy is away on a bug hunt, so the Azalea Gym stays empty until you have helped him.

**Main quest in this chapter:** stop Team Rocket in Slowpoke Well, take part in Bugsy's Honey hunt in Ilex Forest, win the **Hive Badge** at the Azalea Gym (no Pokémon strong against Bug), and lead the lost Kimono Girl Koume out of the forest, which opens the road to Route 34 and Goldenrod City.

**Order tips:** finish Bugsy's hunt **before** you talk to Koume, Sakura or the fire ranger (they share the hunt's progress), and take the **Rocky Helmet** only after the hunt. Koume's rescue ends the Union Cave Cyndaquil and the Violet City Marill for good.

### Walkthrough

**Azalea Town: the Slowpoke trouble.** Azalea has a **Slowpoke quiz** (a few steps south of the Pokémon Center), a data-obsessed **Super Nerd** with a Porygon-Z next to the Gym, and the **Charcoal Kiln** in the south, where the apprentice's Farfetch'd cannot learn Cut. Go to **Kurt's house** in the north-west: his Slowpoke suddenly runs off and Kurt asks you and Crystal to find out why. Outside, a Rocket grunt blocks Slowpoke Well; Gold beats his Steelix and the grunt invites you to the well.

**Opens up:**

- [Azalea Town: the Slowpoke quiz (→ King's Rock)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch19-azalea-slowpoke-well-ilex-forest/#azalea-town-the-slowpoke-quiz--kings-rock)
- [Azalea Town: the data-obsessed Super Nerd (→ TM77 Psych Up)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch19-azalea-slowpoke-well-ilex-forest/#azalea-town-the-data-obsessed-super-nerd--tm77-psych-up)
- [Azalea Town: the Charcoal Kiln's Farfetch'd (Cut → Leek → battle → Solar Blade tutor)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch19-azalea-slowpoke-well-ilex-forest/#azalea-town-the-charcoal-kilns-farfetchd-cut--leek--battle--solar-blade-tutor)
- [Azalea Town: small extras](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch19-azalea-slowpoke-well-ilex-forest/#azalea-town-small-extras)

**Slowpoke Well.** Kurt, Gold and Crystal go in with you. On the first level Jessie, James and Meowth offer to let you pass (take it or fight them; they attack from behind if you trust them), and the Executives **Proton** and **Archie** are after the **Tidal Bell**, which a Slowking guards. Silver snatches the bell in the middle of the fight; Gold takes it back from him. Kurt thanks you at his house with Apricorn Balls and his phone number and asks you to keep the secret of the bell. **This ends for good** the Apricorn Ball service of the Pewter City maker (he says he will make no more balls).

**Ilex Forest: Bugsy's bug hunt.** Enter Ilex Forest from the south gate. About a dozen steps up the path Bugsy and his team wait with a plan: spread **Honey** on four rocks to lure four Bug Pokémon (Kricketune, Ariados, Burmy, Skorupi). **Where you stand decides the result:** if you are on a bug's path, it runs away. Do the Ariados rock before the Skorupi rock, and finish the hunt before you talk to Koume, Sakura or the fire ranger. Handling at most three bugs yourself earns the top reward (3 Energy Powder, PP Max and a Heart Scale). Bugsy then goes back to the Azalea Gym.

Do not take the **Rocky Helmet** from the man with the sore head before the hunt ends; the other forest extras (Leaf Storm tutor, rangers, Bug Catcher Andy) are listed in the quest.

**Opens up:**

- [Ilex Forest: Bugsy's bug hunt with Honey (story; the more you catch, the better the reward)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch19-azalea-slowpoke-well-ilex-forest/#ilex-forest-bugsys-bug-hunt-with-honey-story-the-more-you-catch-the-better-the-reward)
- [Ilex Forest: small extras](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch19-azalea-slowpoke-well-ilex-forest/#ilex-forest-small-extras)

**Azalea Gym: Bugsy.** With the hunt finished, Bugsy is back in his Gym. He asks you to bring **no Pokémon that is strong against Bug** (a fixed list of 203 species: every Fire, Flying and Rock type and a few more, Eggs skipped). Win the **Hive Badge**, **TM81 X-Scissor** and his number. You can also do this after Koume's rescue.

**Opens up:**

- [Azalea Gym: Bugsy's no-type-advantage battle (the Hive Badge)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch19-azalea-slowpoke-well-ilex-forest/#azalea-gym-bugsys-no-type-advantage-battle-the-hive-badge)

**Koume, the lost Kimono Girl.** Koume stands in the middle of the forest and cannot find her way; whatever you answer, she wanders off. Talk to her sister **Sakura** in the north gatehouse (she blocks the Route 34 door until Koume is safe), then go back and choose **"Your sister sent me for you"**: Koume follows you to the exit and thanks you with a Sun Stone. Straight afterwards Gold and Crystal talk to you. **This closes for good:** the wild Cyndaquil in Union Cave (and Goh there) and the runaway Marill in Violet City. The forest rangers appear. The fire ranger's **stray Houndour** (10 Safari Balls) can be started once the hunt is over.

**Opens up:**

- [Ilex Forest: Koume, the Kimono Girl who lost her way (blocks the exit to Route 34)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch19-azalea-slowpoke-well-ilex-forest/#ilex-forest-koume-the-kimono-girl-who-lost-her-way-blocks-the-exit-to-route-34)
- [Ilex Forest: the fire ranger's stray Houndour (→ 10 Safari Balls)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch19-azalea-slowpoke-well-ilex-forest/#ilex-forest-the-fire-rangers-stray-houndour--10-safari-balls)

Quests in this chapter:

- Azalea Town: the Slowpoke quiz (→ King's Rock)
- Azalea Town: the data-obsessed Super Nerd (→ TM77 Psych Up)
- Azalea Town: the Charcoal Kiln's Farfetch'd (Cut → Leek → battle → Solar Blade tutor)
- Azalea Town: small extras
- Ilex Forest: Bugsy's bug hunt with Honey (story; the more you catch, the better the reward)
- Ilex Forest: small extras
- Azalea Gym: Bugsy's no-type-advantage battle (the Hive Badge)
- Ilex Forest: Koume, the Kimono Girl who lost her way (blocks the exit to Route 34)
- Ilex Forest: the fire ranger's stray Houndour (→ 10 Safari Balls)

---

## Chapter 20: Route 34, Goldenrod City and the Plain Badge

Source: https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch20-route-34-goldenrod-city/

Goldenrod City is the biggest town so far, with a Department Store, an underground shopping street, a Game Corner, a Radio Tower and a Gym. **Whitney** is not in her Gym when you arrive: she is at the Radio Tower, where a radio show called "The Strongest Trainer" is about to record its first guest. How you answer the director decides how you earn the **Plain Badge**.

**Main quest in this chapter:** reach Goldenrod City through Route 34, record the show on Radio Tower 4F (let Whitney do it, or do it yourself) and win the **Plain Badge** at the Goldenrod Gym.

**Before the Plain Badge:** Prof. Rowan's Chimchar (he leaves with the Gym win) and the underground battlers. **Before Silver's scene on Route 37 (Chapter 21 onwards):** Goh and the Lopunny owner, the Purugly girl's "act" and Mary's secret photos. **Before the Glacier Badge:** the Game Corner magnet cheater. The **love reading** at the fortune-teller must be done before the League HQ's round-3 order (see the romance entry).

### Walkthrough

**Route 34.** North of Ilex Forest's gatehouse the **Day-Care** stands by the road with a police officer and his Arcanine a few steps north-west of its door; a Youngster with a Sunkern in the north-west is still smarting from Whitney (he only helps you after the Plain Badge, and only until the Rising Badge). A **dancer with a twisted ankle** north of the gatehouse tells you about the dance master in a hidden grove at the very south end of the route (bring a Potion). The north end of Route 34, close to Goldenrod, is where the Salamence scene will play later.

**Opens up:**

- [Route 34: Totodile, the dance master (one chance)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch20-route-34-goldenrod-city/#route-34-totodile-the-dance-master-one-chance) Missable
- [Route 34: advice for Whitney's victim (→ Razor Claw)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch20-route-34-goldenrod-city/#route-34-advice-for-whitneys-victim--razor-claw) Missable
- [Route 34: small extras](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch20-route-34-goldenrod-city/#route-34-small-extras)

**Goldenrod City.** Things to know in town before the Gym:

- **Magnet Train Station** (east of the Radio Tower): **Prof. Rowan** and his assistant offer a Sinnoh Chimchar (Lv. 5).
- **West plaza:** Goh and the Lopunny owner (a Normal-types-only battle).
- **Purugly girl and the clinic:** a choice with two endings (spare Jessie, James and Meowth first).
- **Department Store:** the Air Balloon girl outside, the blind man with a Poochyena on 6F, the Machop moving company in the basement.
- **Goldenrod Tunnel (underground):** brawlers drive the shops away; walk in from either end.
- **Radio Tower:** Mary on 4F suspects someone of photographing her, the quiz attendant is on 1F and Buena's Password on 2F.
- **Game Corner:** a Pokéfan wins too much; lead with a Magnemite.
- **North of town:** the fortune-teller's house and the Flower Shop.

**Opens up:**

- [Goldenrod Magnet Train Station: Prof. Rowan's Chimchar (missable; before the Plain Badge)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch20-route-34-goldenrod-city/#goldenrod-magnet-train-station-prof-rowans-chimchar-missable-before-the-plain-badge) Missable
- [Goldenrod City: Goh and the Lopunny owner (win with Normal types only)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch20-route-34-goldenrod-city/#goldenrod-city-goh-and-the-lopunny-owner-win-with-normal-types-only) Missable
- [Goldenrod City: the Purugly girl and Team Rocket's "act" (choice with two endings)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch20-route-34-goldenrod-city/#goldenrod-city-the-purugly-girl-and-team-rockets-act-choice-with-two-endings) Missable
- [Goldenrod City: the popped Air Balloon (→ Fashion Case)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch20-route-34-goldenrod-city/#goldenrod-city-the-popped-air-balloon--fashion-case)
- [Goldenrod Dept. Store 6F: the blind man's Poochyena (one chance)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch20-route-34-goldenrod-city/#goldenrod-dept-store-6f-the-blind-mans-poochyena-one-chance) Missable
- [Radio Tower → Goldenrod Tunnel: Mary's secret photos (→ Cherish Ball; missable)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch20-route-34-goldenrod-city/#radio-tower--goldenrod-tunnel-marys-secret-photos--cherish-ball-missable) Missable
- [Goldenrod Underground: drive out the underground battlers (optional; before the Plain Badge)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch20-route-34-goldenrod-city/#goldenrod-underground-drive-out-the-underground-battlers-optional-before-the-plain-badge) Missable
- [Goldenrod Department Store basement: the Machop moving company (→ three items)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch20-route-34-goldenrod-city/#goldenrod-department-store-basement-the-machop-moving-company--three-items)
- [Radio Tower 1F: the radio quiz (→ radio upgrade)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch20-route-34-goldenrod-city/#radio-tower-1f-the-radio-quiz--radio-upgrade)
- [Radio Tower 2F: Buena's Password (daily; Blue Card points → prizes and her phone number)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch20-route-34-goldenrod-city/#radio-tower-2f-buenas-password-daily-blue-card-points--prizes-and-her-phone-number)
- [Goldenrod Game Corner: the magnet cheater (before the Glacier Badge)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch20-route-34-goldenrod-city/#goldenrod-game-corner-the-magnet-cheater-before-the-glacier-badge) Missable
- [Goldenrod City: the fortune-teller's "ideal Pokémon" reading (one per game)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch20-route-34-goldenrod-city/#goldenrod-city-the-fortune-tellers-ideal-pok%C3%A9mon-reading-one-per-game)
- [Romance route: how it's unlocked, how your partner is chosen, and what locks a partner out (central entry)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch20-route-34-goldenrod-city/#romance-route-how-its-unlocked-how-your-partner-is-chosen-and-what-locks-a-partner-out-central-entry) Missable
- [Goldenrod City: small extras](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch20-route-34-goldenrod-city/#goldenrod-city-small-extras)
- [Goldenrod Underground: small extras](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch20-route-34-goldenrod-city/#goldenrod-underground-small-extras)

**The recording and the Plain Badge.** At the top of the Radio Tower the studio director drops Whitney as the first guest in favour of you. Answer **"Let Whitney do it"** and she calls you to the Gym for a plain one-on-one battle (Plain Badge, 10 Air Balloons and her number). Answer **"I'll do the show"** and Whitney storms off; at the Gym she demands a **Multi Battle** with **Gold** against Whitney and **Norman**, and you first have to bring Norman: find his son Ruby and Sapphire in trouble on the north end of Route 34 (a wild **Lv. 60 Salamence** you can catch, one chance), then invite Norman at his Friendship Checker house or at the Magnet Train Station. Either way the recording gives you 3 Max Elixirs and 2 Heart Scales. **This closes for good** (the Gym win): Prof. Rowan's Chimchar and the underground battlers (who leave anyway).

**Opens up:**

- [Radio Tower 4F → Goldenrod Gym: the Plain Badge, two ways](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch20-route-34-goldenrod-city/#radio-tower-4f--goldenrod-gym-the-plain-badge-two-ways)
- [Route 34: Ruby, Sapphire and the wild Salamence (part of the Goldenrod Gym chain)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch20-route-34-goldenrod-city/#route-34-ruby-sapphire-and-the-wild-salamence-part-of-the-goldenrod-gym-chain) Missable

Quests in this chapter:

- Route 34: Totodile, the dance master (one chance)
- Route 34: advice for Whitney's victim (→ Razor Claw)
- Route 34: small extras
- Goldenrod Magnet Train Station: Prof. Rowan's Chimchar (missable; before the Plain Badge)
- Goldenrod City: Goh and the Lopunny owner (win with Normal types only)
- Goldenrod City: the Purugly girl and Team Rocket's "act" (choice with two endings)
- Goldenrod City: the popped Air Balloon (→ Fashion Case)
- Goldenrod Dept. Store 6F: the blind man's Poochyena (one chance)
- Radio Tower → Goldenrod Tunnel: Mary's secret photos (→ Cherish Ball; missable)
- Goldenrod Underground: drive out the underground battlers (optional; before the Plain Badge)
- Goldenrod Department Store basement: the Machop moving company (→ three items)
- Radio Tower 1F: the radio quiz (→ radio upgrade)
- Radio Tower 2F: Buena's Password (daily; Blue Card points → prizes and her phone number)
- Goldenrod Game Corner: the magnet cheater (before the Glacier Badge)

- Romance route: how it's unlocked, how your partner is chosen, and what locks a partner out (central entry)
- Goldenrod City: small extras
- Goldenrod Underground: small extras
- Radio Tower 4F → Goldenrod Gym: the Plain Badge, two ways
- Route 34: Ruby, Sapphire and the wild Salamence (part of the Goldenrod Gym chain)

## Chapter 21: Routes 35 to 37, the National Park and Silver on Route 37

Source: https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch21-routes-35-37-national-park/

With the Plain Badge in your case the roads north of Goldenrod open: Route 35 and the National Park, then Route 36 with its odd tree. Once the tree is gone you walk on to Route 37, where **Silver** is waiting. That scene is the end of this chapter, and it closes several Goldenrod jobs for good.

**Main quest in this chapter:** get past the odd tree on Route 36 (Crystal waters it), then walk north on Route 37 and meet Silver.

**Do these first, they close at Silver's scene:** Goh and the Lopunny owner, the Purugly girl's "act" and Mary's secret photos (all in Goldenrod), plus the National Park offer from Will and Karen to teach them a lesson. The Plain Badge also removes Prof. Rowan's Chimchar (Chapter 20).

### Walkthrough

**Route 35 and the National Park.** Take the north gatehouse out of Goldenrod. Route 35 has several small errands: the **Shuckle juice-maker** wants a Jigglypuff, a **hungry Pidgey** carries a letter that is finished in Ecruteak City later, a Battle Girl's Granbull learns "Dog Fangs", and a heartbroken boy sends you to a couple in the National Park. In the National Park itself, the **mother and the puppy-love kids** have a two-ending story, and on Tuesdays, Thursdays and Saturdays the officer in either gatehouse runs the **Bug-Catching Contest**. Will and Karen (the ex-Elite Four) stand on the west side of the park until Silver's scene on Route 37 and offer a Double Battle at Lv. 90.

**Opens up:**

- [Route 35: the Shuckle juice-maker wants a Jigglypuff (→ 2 Lum Berries)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch21-routes-35-37-national-park/#route-35-the-shuckle-juice-maker-wants-a-jigglypuff--2-lum-berries)
- [Route 35: the Pidgey with a letter (starts a chain in Ecruteak City)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch21-routes-35-37-national-park/#route-35-the-pidgey-with-a-letter-starts-a-chain-in-ecruteak-city)
- [Route 35: Granbull kid "Dog Fangs" (→ Dragon Scale)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch21-routes-35-37-national-park/#route-35-granbull-kid-dog-fangs--dragon-scale)
- [National Park → Route 35: "the girl on a date with an old man" (→ 3 Heart Mail)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch21-routes-35-37-national-park/#national-park--route-35-the-girl-on-a-date-with-an-old-man--3-heart-mail)
- [Route 36 gatehouse → National Park: the mother and the "puppy love" (two endings)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch21-routes-35-37-national-park/#route-36-gatehouse--national-park-the-mother-and-the-puppy-love-two-endings)
- [National Park: the Bug-Catching Contest](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch21-routes-35-37-national-park/#national-park-the-bug-catching-contest)
- [Route 35 / Route 36 / National Park: small extras](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch21-routes-35-37-national-park/#route-35--route-36--national-park-small-extras)

**Route 36 and the odd tree.** The tree at the junction west of the Violet City gatehouse blocks the road to Ecruteak. After the Plain Badge **Crystal and Gold** wait just south of it: talk to Crystal, she waters the tree with the Squirt Bottle and it turns into a **Sudowoodo** that runs off. Do this **before your first visit inside the Pokéathlon Dome**. If you carry a **Rock Incense**, the little girl Lily and her uncle ask about it later, which also deals with the second, unmasked Sudowoodo on the route. An Ace Trainer in the Violet City gatehouse has a runaway Dragonair story that you can only finish in Blackthorn City.

**Opens up:**

- [Route 36: the odd tree (after the Plain Badge)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch21-routes-35-37-national-park/#route-36-the-odd-tree-after-the-plain-badge)
- [Route 36: Lily's uncle and the Sudowoodo (Rock Incense → $10,000 + Power Lens)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch21-routes-35-37-national-park/#route-36-lilys-uncle-and-the-sudowoodo-rock-incense--10000--power-lens)
- [Route 36 gatehouse → Blackthorn City: the runaway Dragonair Trainer (→ Play Rough tutor)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch21-routes-35-37-national-park/#route-36-gatehouse--blackthorn-city-the-runaway-dragonair-trainer--play-rough-tutor)

**Route 37: Silver.** North of the tree Route 37 leads towards Ecruteak City. Silver is waiting on the road; after the scene the way on is open. **This closes for good:** Goh and the Lopunny owner, the Purugly girl's "act" and Mary's secret photos in Goldenrod, and the National Park offer from Will and Karen. If you still have to deliver a letter or take a berry in the Momo/Yuichi story (Chapter 15), note that this scene also resets Momo's "letter received" state, so deliver the guard's letter to Momo in Ecruteak **after** this scene.

Quests in this chapter:

- Route 35: the Shuckle juice-maker wants a Jigglypuff (→ 2 Lum Berries)
- Route 35: the Pidgey with a letter (starts a chain in Ecruteak City)
- Route 35: Granbull kid "Dog Fangs" (→ Dragon Scale)
- National Park → Route 35: "the girl on a date with an old man" (→ 3 Heart Mail)
- Route 36 gatehouse → National Park: the mother and the "puppy love" (two endings)
- National Park: the Bug-Catching Contest
- Route 35 / Route 36 / National Park: small extras
- Route 36: the odd tree (after the Plain Badge)
- Route 36: Lily's uncle and the Sudowoodo (Rock Incense → $10,000 + Power Lens)
- Route 36 gatehouse → Blackthorn City: the runaway Dragonair Trainer (→ Play Rough tutor)

---

## Chapter 22: Ecruteak City, the Burned Tower and the Fog Badge

Source: https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch22-ecruteak-burned-tower-fog-badge/

Ecruteak City is a quiet old town with a Dance Theater, the Burned Tower in the north-west and the Bell Tower behind a gatehouse in the north. Team Rocket turns up here too: a man in a red cape, the **Marauder**, is about to smash the Sealing Mirror in the Burned Tower, and he will only listen to **Morty**, who is away at the Bell Tower.

**Main quest in this chapter:** stop the Marauder in the Burned Tower basement, pass the Bell Tower gate quiz to reach Morty, fight the Marauder and Maxie in the Burned Tower, then win the **Fog Badge** from Morty (Chapter 23 starts at the road west to Olivine).

**Before the Rising Badge** (Chapter 27): Sakura's Water Stone request in the Dance Theater. **Before the Route 39 scene with Gold** (next chapter): Gold's training battles in the Pokémon Center.

### Walkthrough

**The Burned Tower and the Bell Tower gate.** In the Burned Tower basement the Marauder is at the Sealing Mirror: pick the option that stops him. He says he will only listen to Morty. Go to the Bell Tower gatehouse in the north of town and tell the guard **"I'm the Champion. I need Morty."** Then answer his six questions, all in one go (a wrong answer starts you over). Walk up Bellchime Trail to Morty and Eusine, then go back to the Burned Tower: Gold and Silver wait at the entrance, and in the basement the Marauder breaks the seal and Team Rocket attacks. You fight the **Marauder and Maxie** together in a Double Battle on your own.

**Opens up:**

- [Burned Tower → Bell Tower gate: bring Morty to the Marauder (story; the gate quiz)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch22-ecruteak-burned-tower-fog-badge/#burned-tower--bell-tower-gate-bring-morty-to-the-marauder-story-the-gate-quiz)

**What the Burned Tower story opens in Ecruteak.** Morty's Gym is open now, and **Gold** appears at the left of the Pokémon Center entrance for a series of training battles (three in a row, 12 Soda Pop in the end). The Bell Tower gatehouse guard now teaches **Aura Sphere**. Around town:

- Two kids argue about the strongest legendary beast (one answer per game).
- A girl at the west end wants to see a Pokémon as stunning as Ho-Oh (Shed Shell).
- An old man on the east side asks five lantern riddles (2 Power Bands).
- The wheelchair-bound writer in the house east of the Pokémon Center is waiting for her Pidgey; if you carried the letter from Route 35, she rewards your stories (Wise Glasses).
- The boy with a Shellos in the right-hand of the two houses below the Burned Tower (a one-time choice).
- **Sakura**, the Kimono Girl at the right end of the row in the Dance Theater, wants a **Water Stone** for a Spell Tag.
- Route 37 and the rest of town have small extras (Sunny the Sunday sibling, the S.S. Anne fan, the Eruption tutor and more).

**Opens up:**

- [Ecruteak Pokémon Center: Gold's training battles (→ 12 Soda Pop; missable)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch22-ecruteak-burned-tower-fog-badge/#ecruteak-pok%C3%A9mon-center-golds-training-battles--12-soda-pop-missable) Missable
- [Ecruteak City: which legendary beast is strongest? (one-time)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch22-ecruteak-burned-tower-fog-badge/#ecruteak-city-which-legendary-beast-is-strongest-one-time)
- [Ecruteak City: show the girl a Pokémon like Ho-Oh (→ Shed Shell)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch22-ecruteak-burned-tower-fog-badge/#ecruteak-city-show-the-girl-a-pok%C3%A9mon-like-ho-oh--shed-shell)
- [Ecruteak City: Grandpa's Pokémon lantern riddles (→ 2 Power Bands)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch22-ecruteak-burned-tower-fog-badge/#ecruteak-city-grandpas-pok%C3%A9mon-lantern-riddles--2-power-bands)
- [Ecruteak City: the wheelchair-bound writer's Pidgey letter (→ Wise Glasses; continues Route 35's hungry Pidgey)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch22-ecruteak-burned-tower-fog-badge/#ecruteak-city-the-wheelchair-bound-writers-pidgey-letter--wise-glasses-continues-route-35s-hungry-pidgey)
- [Ecruteak City: Shellos for the boy without Badges (choice; one chance)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch22-ecruteak-burned-tower-fog-badge/#ecruteak-city-shellos-for-the-boy-without-badges-choice-one-chance) Missable
- [Ecruteak City (Dance Theater): Sakura wants a Water Stone (→ Spell Tag; before the Rising Badge)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch22-ecruteak-burned-tower-fog-badge/#ecruteak-city-dance-theater-sakura-wants-a-water-stone--spell-tag-before-the-rising-badge) Missable
- [Ecruteak City: small extras](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch22-ecruteak-burned-tower-fog-badge/#ecruteak-city-small-extras)

**Morty's Ghost Gym.** Morty only battles a **full party of six**, and the game checks each Pokémon against a fixed list of Psychic and Ghost species, not their actual types. It is a **Double Battle** and he sends out his six two at a time. Win for the **Fog Badge** and TM30 Shadow Ball. **Get the Fog Badge before the League HQ's round 4:** after Ho-Oh is stolen at the Bell Tower Morty will not battle you until your final Hall of Fame entry.

**Opens up:**

- [Ecruteak Gym: Morty's Ghost challenge (the Fog Badge)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch22-ecruteak-burned-tower-fog-badge/#ecruteak-gym-mortys-ghost-challenge-the-fog-badge)

Quests in this chapter:

- Burned Tower → Bell Tower gate: bring Morty to the Marauder (story; the gate quiz)
- Ecruteak Gym: Morty's Ghost challenge (the Fog Badge)
- Ecruteak City: which legendary beast is strongest? (one-time)
- Ecruteak City: show the girl a Pokémon like Ho-Oh (→ Shed Shell)
- Ecruteak City: Grandpa's Pokémon lantern riddles (→ 2 Power Bands)
- Ecruteak Pokémon Center: Gold's training battles (→ 12 Soda Pop; missable)
- Ecruteak City (Dance Theater): Sakura wants a Water Stone (→ Spell Tag; before the Rising Badge)
- Ecruteak City: Shellos for the boy without Badges (choice; one chance)
- Ecruteak City: the wheelchair-bound writer's Pidgey letter (→ Wise Glasses; continues Route 35's hungry Pidgey)
- Ecruteak City: small extras

---

## Chapter 23: Routes 38 and 39, Olivine City and the Mineral Badge

Source: https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch23-route-39-olivine-mineral-badge/

Route 38 and Route 39 lead from Ecruteak City to Olivine City, a harbour town with a Gym, a Café and a Lighthouse. At the south end of Route 39 **Gold and Crystal** stop you for the scene that opens the sea routes: from then on the ferries run and several errands on the Sevii Islands wake up. In Olivine you win the **Mineral Badge**, and Team Rocket takes over the Lighthouse straight afterwards.

**Main quest in this chapter:** cross Routes 38 and 39, battle Gold at the south end of Route 39, win the **Mineral Badge** from Jasmine and drive Team Rocket out of the Lighthouse. Amphy, the Lighthouse Pokémon, is poisoned: the medicine comes from Cianwood City (next chapter) and the reward waits at the top of the Lighthouse.

**Before the Mineral Badge:** the guard's letter to Momo (Chapter 15) and giving Crystal your Super Rod. **Before the Rising Badge (Chapter 27):** the Three Island bikers' errands.

### Walkthrough

**Route 38.** West of Ecruteak the road is short: a kid with a Murkrow that stole a coin ("Nugget trap") hides behind the fence at the east end, a Magician trains Apricorns in the west part and a merchant sells TM78 Captivate at the west end. Route 38 to Olivine City also has a handful of small extras (Route 39's Hiker, the Café's drunk veteran, the Aron kid's Endeavor lesson).

**Opens up:**

- [Route 38: the Murkrow that stole a coin (Nugget trap; → 2 Rare Candies, 2 Lava Cookies or keep the Amulet Coin)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch23-route-39-olivine-mineral-badge/#route-38-the-murkrow-that-stole-a-coin-nugget-trap--2-rare-candies-2-lava-cookies-or-keep-the-amulet-coin)
- [Route 38 → Olivine City: small extras](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch23-route-39-olivine-mineral-badge/#route-38--olivine-city-small-extras)

**MooMoo Farm (Route 39).** The Miltank are healthy now. The farmer sells Moomoo Milk, a "Team Rocket grunt" east of the stable wants $10,000 (an optional Lv. 62-65 battle), the old lady among the Sunflora tells her story for a **Seal Case**, and a Donphan owner wants a **Protector** (he gives a Power Weight). Buy **10 Moomoo Milk** for the baby Pichu's mother in Ecruteak, who then teaches Volt Tackle.

**Opens up:**

- [Route 39: the "Team Rocket grunt" who wants $10,000 (optional Lv. 62–65 battle)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch23-route-39-olivine-mineral-badge/#route-39-the-team-rocket-grunt-who-wants-10000-optional-lv-6265-battle)
- [Route 39: the Donphan owner who needs a Protector (→ Power Weight)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch23-route-39-olivine-mineral-badge/#route-39-the-donphan-owner-who-needs-a-protector--power-weight)
- [Route 39: the old lady's Sunflora story (→ Seal Case)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch23-route-39-olivine-mineral-badge/#route-39-the-old-ladys-sunflora-story--seal-case)
- [Ecruteak City: milk for the baby Pichu (→ unlocks Volt Tackle)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch23-route-39-olivine-mineral-badge/#ecruteak-city-milk-for-the-baby-pichu--unlocks-volt-tackle)

**Route 39: Gold and Crystal.** At the south end of Route 39 the two friends stop you. Gold has the Fog Badge and wants a battle with his partners right now. **This closes for good:** Gold's training battles in the Ecruteak Pokémon Center (he leaves for good, finished or not). The scene also **opens the sea routes**: the new S.S. Anne offers Olivine City, the One Island ferryman and the Alto Mare travel agency boat run, a man in the One Island Pokémon Center starts asking you to drive off the bikers on Three Island, and the Island Cave on Four Island wakes up. (Yellow and Misty are hidden from now on; see the Battle Tower partner room entry in Chapter 24.)

**Opens up:**

- [Three Island: the Alto Mare Bikers (save the Meowth?)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch23-route-39-olivine-mineral-badge/#three-island-the-alto-mare-bikers-save-the-meowth) Missable
- [Three Island: the biker Big Sis who can't ride](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch23-route-39-olivine-mineral-badge/#three-island-the-biker-big-sis-who-cant-ride) Missable
- [Shipyard Ruins (Three Island): the bikers' Chief, a bribe or a fight](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch23-route-39-olivine-mineral-badge/#shipyard-ruins-three-island-the-bikers-chief-a-bribe-or-a-fight) Missable
- [Island Cave (Four Island): Crystal Onix and Granny Lisa](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch23-route-39-olivine-mineral-badge/#island-cave-four-island-crystal-onix-and-granny-lisa)
- [Island Cave: small extras](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch23-route-39-olivine-mineral-badge/#island-cave-small-extras)

**Olivine City, before the Gym.** Around town: three **Star-Chaser Sisters** (talk to them from the middle), the Café with its **three dishes for the fisherman's Super Rod**, the drunk veteran in the Café, the Sitrus Berry chain towards **HM05 Whirlpool** (Café, Lighthouse engineer, then a boy in the north-east house who needs a Tentacool), and a salesman with a "gold-laying Magikarp" if the S.S. Anne was saved. Down at the harbour entrance **Crystal** is still in town: if you carry a Super Rod she would love one for her Kingler.

**Opens up:**

- [Olivine City: the Star-Chaser Sisters (talk to them from the middle)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch23-route-39-olivine-mineral-badge/#olivine-city-the-star-chaser-sisters-talk-to-them-from-the-middle)
- [Olivine City: Sitrus Berries → Machine Part → Diving Suit → HM05 Whirlpool (with a Tentacool)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch23-route-39-olivine-mineral-badge/#olivine-city-sitrus-berries--machine-part--diving-suit--hm05-whirlpool-with-a-tentacool)
- [Olivine Café → fisherman: the three dishes and the Super Rod](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch23-route-39-olivine-mineral-badge/#olivine-caf%C3%A9--fisherman-the-three-dishes-and-the-super-rod)
- [Olivine City: give Crystal your Super Rod (before the Mineral Badge; romance)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch23-route-39-olivine-mineral-badge/#olivine-city-give-crystal-your-super-rod-before-the-mineral-badge-romance) Missable
- [Olivine City: the "gold-laying Magikarp" con man (only if the S.S. Anne was saved)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch23-route-39-olivine-mineral-badge/#olivine-city-the-gold-laying-magikarp-con-man-only-if-the-ss-anne-was-saved)

**The Olivine Gym.** Jasmine fights a **3-on-3 Single Battle** with only Pokémon on her list of base Defense 130 or higher (carry three or fewer). Win for the **Mineral Badge**. She starts to hand over a TM, but a Gym Trainer bursts in: Team Rocket is at the Lighthouse. **This closes for good:** Crystal at the harbour (the Team Rocket alarm removes her), so give her the Super Rod before the fight, and the Momo letter (deliver it before this badge, Chapter 15). The Mineral Badge also opens the **Two Island** Water-type quiz.

**Opens up:**

- [Olivine Gym: Jasmine's rule (three Pokémon with base Defense 130+)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch23-route-39-olivine-mineral-badge/#olivine-gym-jasmines-rule-three-pok%C3%A9mon-with-base-defense-130)
- [Two Island: the old captain's Water-type quiz (→ Piplup)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch23-route-39-olivine-mineral-badge/#two-island-the-old-captains-water-type-quiz--piplup)

**The Olivine Lighthouse.** Team Rocket holds the Lighthouse: the stairs are closed and you go up by elevator. Drive them out. At the top **Amphy** has been poisoned and Jasmine asks you to fetch medicine from Cianwood City. That is the next chapter; the **Secret Potion** brings you back here for TM91 Flash Cannon and Jasmine's number.

**Opens up:**

- [Olivine Lighthouse: medicine for Amphy (→ TM91 Flash Cannon)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch23-route-39-olivine-mineral-badge/#olivine-lighthouse-medicine-for-amphy--tm91-flash-cannon)

Quests in this chapter:

- Route 38: the Murkrow that stole a coin (Nugget trap; → 2 Rare Candies, 2 Lava Cookies or keep the Amulet Coin)
- Route 38 → Olivine City: small extras
- Route 39: the "Team Rocket grunt" who wants $10,000 (optional Lv. 62–65 battle)
- Route 39: the Donphan owner who needs a Protector (→ Power Weight)
- Route 39: the old lady's Sunflora story (→ Seal Case)
- Ecruteak City: milk for the baby Pichu (→ unlocks Volt Tackle)
- Three Island: the Alto Mare Bikers (save the Meowth?)
- Three Island: the biker Big Sis who can't ride
- Shipyard Ruins (Three Island): the bikers' Chief, a bribe or a fight
- Island Cave (Four Island): Crystal Onix and Granny Lisa
- Island Cave: small extras
- Olivine City: the Star-Chaser Sisters (talk to them from the middle)
- Olivine City: Sitrus Berries → Machine Part → Diving Suit → HM05 Whirlpool (with a Tentacool)
- Olivine Café → fisherman: the three dishes and the Super Rod
- Olivine City: give Crystal your Super Rod (before the Mineral Badge; romance)
- Olivine City: the "gold-laying Magikarp" con man (only if the S.S. Anne was saved)
- Olivine Gym: Jasmine's rule (three Pokémon with base Defense 130+)
- Two Island: the old captain's Water-type quiz (→ Piplup)
- Olivine Lighthouse: medicine for Amphy (→ TM91 Flash Cannon)

---

## Chapter 24: Cianwood City, Cianwood Cave and the Storm Badge

Source: https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch24-cianwood-city-storm-badge/

Cianwood City lies across the water south-west of Olivine, past Routes 40 and 41. The Pharmacy there has the medicine for **Amphy**, and its Gym is closed until she is cured. Once the Gym reopens its Leader, **Chuck**, is training in Cianwood Cave, and a scene on Route 47 on the far side of the cave has you fight Team Rocket with Gold.

**Main quest in this chapter:** get the Secret Potion from the Cianwood Pharmacy, take it to Jasmine at the top of the Olivine Lighthouse, find and beat Chuck in Cianwood Cave, fight Will, Karen and the Raikou device with Gold on Route 47, and win the **Storm Badge** at the Cianwood Gym.

**Before you leave for Route 42 (Chapter 25):** the Eusine, Suicune and Goh scene on the Cianwood beach (it disappears for good once Silver's scene on Route 42 plays).

### Walkthrough

**Cianwood City and the Pharmacy.** Reach Cianwood by water (Surf, from the Rainbow Badge). Go to the Pharmacy just west of the Pokémon Center: **Gold and Crystal** are inside, arguing with the pharmacist. Talk to Gold or Crystal, not the man behind the counter; they show your Trainer Card as League Champion and you get the **Secret Potion**. Fly back to Jasmine at the top of the Olivine Lighthouse and talk to her at Amphy's side for **TM91 Flash Cannon** and her number (Chapter 23).

While you are here: a Rhydon that can Surf on Route 40, the **Whirl Islands Challenge** host north of the Pokémon Center (four quiz-and-battle islands on Route 41), Ace Trainer Hans (Close Combat), a girl fishing on the east shore (a Lure Ball for a Max Elixir), houses with a Happiny girl, a Breloom and a Gligar, a woman at the Pokémon Center with a spare Tentacool, and small extras on Routes 40 and 41. In the Battle Frontier to the north you get a free Vs. Recorder.

**Opens up:**

- [Cianwood Pharmacy: getting the Secret Potion (continues Radio Tower, Ecruteak City and Olivine City's "Olivine Lighthouse: medicine for Amphy")](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch24-cianwood-city-storm-badge/#cianwood-pharmacy-getting-the-secret-potion-continues-radio-tower-ecruteak-city-and-olivine-citys-olivine-lighthouse-medicine-for-amphy)
- [Route 40: the Rhydon that can Surf (→ 2 Heavy Balls)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch24-cianwood-city-storm-badge/#route-40-the-rhydon-that-can-surf--2-heavy-balls)
- [Route 41 → Cianwood City: the Whirl Islands Challenge (quiz and battle on four islands)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch24-cianwood-city-storm-badge/#route-41--cianwood-city-the-whirl-islands-challenge-quiz-and-battle-on-four-islands)
- [Cianwood City: Ace Trainer Hans unlocks Close Combat](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch24-cianwood-city-storm-badge/#cianwood-city-ace-trainer-hans-unlocks-close-combat)
- [Cianwood City: a Lure Ball for the Corsola girl (→ Max Elixir)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch24-cianwood-city-storm-badge/#cianwood-city-a-lure-ball-for-the-corsola-girl--max-elixir)
- [Cianwood City houses: Happiny, Gligar, and the Eevee brothers](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch24-cianwood-city-storm-badge/#cianwood-city-houses-happiny-gligar-and-the-eevee-brothers)
- [Cianwood City: small extras](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch24-cianwood-city-storm-badge/#cianwood-city-small-extras)
- [Route 40 / Route 41: small extras](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch24-cianwood-city-storm-badge/#route-40--route-41-small-extras)
- [Battle Frontier: small extras](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch24-cianwood-city-storm-badge/#battle-frontier-small-extras)
- [Battle Tower partner room: teaming up with Yellow or Misty (continuation of Ilex Forest and Goldenrod City's romance entry; in practice unavailable)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch24-cianwood-city-storm-badge/#battle-tower-partner-room-teaming-up-with-yellow-or-misty-continuation-of-ilex-forest-and-goldenrod-citys-romance-entry-in-practice-unavailable)

**Amphy is cured.** With Amphy cured, Gold and Crystal leave the Pharmacy (its herbal-medicine counter sells again) and the Cianwood Gym door is free: Chuck's wife no longer stands in front of it. On the beach at the north end of town **Eusine** battles Suicune and loses, and Goh turns up to catch it: "Stop Goh?" decides whether you fight him (Lv. 85). Do this scene now; it disappears for good in the next chapter. Inside the Gym Chuck's wife tells you he is training in the cave west of town.

**Opens up:**

- [Cianwood City: Eusine, Suicune and Goh (optional; before the Route 42 story)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch24-cianwood-city-storm-badge/#cianwood-city-eusine-suicune-and-goh-optional-before-the-route-42-story) Missable
- [Cianwood Gym is closed: find Chuck in Cianwood Cave (story)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch24-cianwood-city-storm-badge/#cianwood-gym-is-closed-find-chuck-in-cianwood-cave-story)

**Cianwood Cave: Chuck.** Go through the gate at the west end of town and follow the cave path past two of Chuck's students. In the training area his footwork lesson plays, and then you battle **Chuck** (six Pokémon, Lv. 88-89). Win and he goes back to the Gym, and the **Resort Zone** on Route 48 opens.

**Opens up:**

- [Resort Zone (Johto): the broke backpacker](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch24-cianwood-city-storm-badge/#resort-zone-johto-the-broke-backpacker)
- [Resort Zone: the Pal Park's Fixed Catch mode (wild Pokémon by weekday)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch24-cianwood-city-storm-badge/#resort-zone-the-pal-parks-fixed-catch-mode-wild-pok%C3%A9mon-by-weekday)
- [Route 48 → Route 47: Gallade, the hurt Buneary and the man afraid of heights (→ Shoal Shell)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch24-cianwood-city-storm-badge/#route-48--route-47-gallade-the-hurt-buneary-and-the-man-afraid-of-heights--shoal-shell)

**Route 47: Will, Karen and the Raikou device.** Stepping out onto Route 47 on the far side of the cave, Gold calls you over: Will and Karen have built a device that lures Raikou. You and Gold fight five battles in a row with **no healing in between**: two Grunt Multi Battles, then Will and Karen (Lv. 90), then **Raikou** under their control twice. Gold's Togetic smashes the device and Raikou runs off. **Heal fully and bring plenty of restoring items first.** The scene also clears the tourist crowd from the **Route 42 gatehouse** on the Ecruteak side, so the road east is open. A man at the foot of the waterfall on Route 47 has a Qwilfish poacher story (you need Waterfall).

**Opens up:**

- [Route 47: Will, Karen and the Raikou device (story; five battles in a row)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch24-cianwood-city-storm-badge/#route-47-will-karen-and-the-raikou-device-story-five-battles-in-a-row)
- [Route 42 gatehouse (Ecruteak side): the tourist crowd](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch24-cianwood-city-storm-badge/#route-42-gatehouse-ecruteak-side-the-tourist-crowd)
- [Route 47: the Qwilfish poacher (→ Heart Scale)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch24-cianwood-city-storm-badge/#route-47-the-qwilfish-poacher--heart-scale)
- [Route 45 to Route 48 and Dragon's Den: small extras](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch24-cianwood-city-storm-badge/#route-45-to-route-48-and-dragons-den-small-extras)

**The Cianwood Gym.** Chuck trains under the waterfall: turn the **large winch** on the back wall to stop it (every visit), then pick "I'm here for the Badge". It is a **Double Battle**, 4-on-4, with 2 to 4 Pokémon in your party. He asks for Fighting types; the game checks a fixed list of banned species. Win for the **Storm Badge**, Macho Brace and his number. His wife then teaches Heal Bell.

**Opens up:**

- [Cianwood Gym: the winch and Chuck's Fighting-type Double Battle (the Storm Badge)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch24-cianwood-city-storm-badge/#cianwood-gym-the-winch-and-chucks-fighting-type-double-battle-the-storm-badge)

Quests in this chapter:
