- Cianwood Pharmacy: getting the Secret Potion (continues Radio Tower, Ecruteak City and Olivine City's "Olivine Lighthouse: medicine for Amphy")
- Route 40: the Rhydon that can Surf (→ 2 Heavy Balls)
- Route 41 → Cianwood City: the Whirl Islands Challenge (quiz and battle on four islands)
- Cianwood City: Ace Trainer Hans unlocks Close Combat
- Cianwood City: a Lure Ball for the Corsola girl (→ Max Elixir)
- Cianwood City houses: Happiny, Gligar, and the Eevee brothers
- Cianwood City: small extras
- Route 40 / Route 41: small extras
- Battle Frontier: small extras
- Battle Tower partner room: teaming up with Yellow or Misty (continuation of Ilex Forest and Goldenrod City's romance entry; in practice unavailable)
- Cianwood City: Eusine, Suicune and Goh (optional; before the Route 42 story)
- Cianwood Gym is closed: find Chuck in Cianwood Cave (story)
- Resort Zone (Johto): the broke backpacker
- Resort Zone: the Pal Park's Fixed Catch mode (wild Pokémon by weekday)
- Route 48 → Route 47: Gallade, the hurt Buneary and the man afraid of heights (→ Shoal Shell)
- Route 47: Will, Karen and the Raikou device (story; five battles in a row)
- Route 42 gatehouse (Ecruteak side): the tourist crowd
- Route 47: the Qwilfish poacher (→ Heart Scale)
- Route 45 to Route 48 and Dragon's Den: small extras
- Cianwood Gym: the winch and Chuck's Fighting-type Double Battle (the Storm Badge)

---

## Chapter 25: Route 42, Mt. Mortar and the Lake of Rage

Source: https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch25-route-42-mt-mortar-lake-of-rage/

With the Route 42 gatehouse open, Route 42 leads east past three entrances of **Mt. Mortar** to Mahogany Town and, beyond it, to Route 43 and the **Lake of Rage**. The road has a story scene at its east end: **Silver** and Ariana with a brainwashed **Entei**. At the lake a red Gyarados attacks a tourist and **Lance** is there with his Dragonite.

**Main quest in this chapter:** walk Route 42 to its east end and fight with Silver against Ariana's Entei, then (after Mahogany Town and Route 43) talk to Lance at the Lake of Rage, fight the red Gyarados and the "researcher" who runs the radio transmitter, and report to Pryce.

**Before you leave Route 42:** the Eusine, Suicune and Goh scene in Cianwood (Chapter 24) closes at Silver's scene. **Before you win the Mahogany Rocket HQ (Chapter 26):** the girl with the listless Sentret on Route 43. **Before you take HM08 Rock Climb:** Mr. Pokémon's quiz on Route 30 (Chapter 16).

### Walkthrough

**Route 42 and the Entei scene.** Smeargle's Sketch (west end), Blissey's Egg, Fisherman Manzo and Hiker Dolan are on the way; at the east end the story scene plays: **Silver and Ariana with a brainwashed Entei**, three Multi Battles at Silver's side and then Ariana's Entei. **This closes for good:** the Eusine, Suicune and Goh scene on the Cianwood beach.

**Opens up:**

- [Route 42: small extras](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch25-route-42-mt-mortar-lake-of-rage/#route-42-small-extras)

**Mt. Mortar.** Three entrances on Route 42 lead into the cave. A **Hiker** in the north of the front cave has lost his map to a runaway Hitmontop; chase it to Karate King **Kiyo** in the back cave and bring the **Map** back for **HM08 Rock Climb**. **Taking HM08 closes for good** Mr. Pokémon's Exp. Share quiz on Route 30, so do the quiz first if you want it. A Psychic with a Diglett leads a **five-member expedition** (Battle Girl, a kid who wants a Focus Sash and a quiz man): you can finish it any time, and you need it in League HQ round 4 (Chapter 30) to reach Ariana and the statue.

**Opens up:**

- [Mt. Mortar: the runaway Hitmontop and the Hiker's map (→ HM08 Rock Climb)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch25-route-42-mt-mortar-lake-of-rage/#mt-mortar-the-runaway-hitmontop-and-the-hikers-map--hm08-rock-climb)
- [Mt. Mortar: the five-member expedition (the way to the altar; needed in the final chapter)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch25-route-42-mt-mortar-lake-of-rage/#mt-mortar-the-five-member-expedition-the-way-to-the-altar-needed-in-the-final-chapter)

**Mahogany Town and Route 43.** Passing through Mahogany: **Magician Colum** and his Girafarig north of the town (a Shell Bell), the souvenir shop annex with the Jigglypuff girl, the Red Scale boy and more. On Route 43 a **girl with a listless Sentret** wants a Chesto Berry. The Mahogany Gym is closed (Pryce is retiring) and the Rocket story only starts after the lake.

**Opens up:**

- [Mahogany Town: the Girafarig meditator (→ Shell Bell)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch25-route-42-mt-mortar-lake-of-rage/#mahogany-town-the-girafarig-meditator--shell-bell)
- [Mahogany Town: small extras](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch25-route-42-mt-mortar-lake-of-rage/#mahogany-town-small-extras)
- [Route 43: a Chesto Berry for the listless Sentret (→ 2 Lum Berries; before the Rocket HQ is cleared)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch25-route-42-mt-mortar-lake-of-rage/#route-43-a-chesto-berry-for-the-listless-sentret--2-lum-berries-before-the-rocket-hq-is-cleared) Missable

**Lake of Rage.** Walk north from Route 43 to the south shore and **talk to Lance** (the scene does not start by itself). A wild **red Gyarados** (Lv. 30) attacks a tourist; more follow and Lance and Gold catch two. Pryce's radio is being jammed: three people in lab coats have set up a transmitter. Yours is the "researcher" on the north shore: pick "Neat gadget there" and answer Yes to "Investigate the device by force?" to fight **Scientist Yamada**. Then tell Pryce on the south shore. He concludes that the real source is in Mahogany Town. Once that is done, the fossil man in the Route 43 gatehouse gives you **TM25 Thunder**.

**Opens up:**

- [Lake of Rage: the red Gyarados and the radio transmitters (story; how to move on)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch25-route-42-mt-mortar-lake-of-rage/#lake-of-rage-the-red-gyarados-and-the-radio-transmitters-story-how-to-move-on)
- [Lake of Rage → Route 44: small extras](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch25-route-42-mt-mortar-lake-of-rage/#lake-of-rage--route-44-small-extras)

Quests in this chapter:

- Route 42: small extras
- Mt. Mortar: the runaway Hitmontop and the Hiker's map (→ HM08 Rock Climb)
- Mt. Mortar: the five-member expedition (the way to the altar; needed in the final chapter)
- Mahogany Town: the Girafarig meditator (→ Shell Bell)
- Mahogany Town: small extras
- Route 43: a Chesto Berry for the listless Sentret (→ 2 Lum Berries; before the Rocket HQ is cleared)
- Lake of Rage → Route 44: small extras
- Lake of Rage: the red Gyarados and the radio transmitters (story; how to move on)

---

## Chapter 26: Mahogany Town, the Team Rocket HQ and the Glacier Badge

Source: https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch26-mahogany-rocket-hq-glacier-badge/

The jamming radio waves at the Lake of Rage come from a **Team Rocket base under the Mahogany Town souvenir shop**. **Lance, Pryce, Gold and Crystal** go in with you, but the shop clerk denies everything: Pryce sends you to search outside. The old Rocket training camp, the **Boot Camp Ruins** at the east end of Mt. Mortar B1F, hides the secret passage into the base. When the base falls, Pryce cancels his retirement and the Gym reopens.

**Main quest in this chapter:** search the shop with Pryce, crack the password in the Boot Camp Ruins, fight through the HQ's B1F, B2F and B3F to Archer's room and the radio room, then win the **Glacier Badge**.

**Before the Glacier Badge:** the Game Corner magnet cheater in Goldenrod. **Don't miss the Rainbow Wing:** it is an item ball in Archer's room and you need it for the Bell Tower in Chapter 30 (the shop guard lets you back into the base afterwards).

### Walkthrough

**The souvenir shop and the Boot Camp Ruins.** Walk up to the shop door: Gold, Crystal, Lance and Pryce go in with you. Talk to **Pryce** inside; he sends you to search outside. Go to the Boot Camp Ruins (the door is at the far east end of Mt. Mortar B1F, Chapter 25). Your friend (Green for male players, Red for female players) and Silver wait there. Check the **PC in the office** (it needs a five-digit password), read **Archer's notebook** in the big hall and work out the digits from the Pokédex numbers on the crumpled note: the code is **1 4 2 4 6**. The passage into the base opens in the room to the south.

**Opens up:**

- [Boot Camp Ruins: the Team Rocket PC password (story; Mahogany Rocket base chapter)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch26-mahogany-rocket-hq-glacier-badge/#boot-camp-ruins-the-team-rocket-pc-password-story-mahogany-rocket-base-chapter)

**The Team Rocket HQ.** The base has three floors and Archer's room. B1F: Persian statues are cameras that call Grunts; the control room opens every passage and a **Sun Stone** lies on this floor. B2F: Butch and Cassidy, Scientist Fujimoto (beat him for the **Secret Key**) and Karen, who is beating Silver. B3F: the Executives' room door needs the Secret Key and two passwords ("Slowpoke Tail" and "Raticate Tail"); behind it "Giovanni" is Petrel in disguise. Archer's room is a Double Battle followed straight by Archer himself, **with no healing in between**. The last fight is the radio room, where you stop the Electrode. **Talk to Petrel's Chatot on B2F before you leave** (one chance). **This closes for good:** the girl with the listless Sentret on Route 43 no longer asks for the berry once the HQ is cleared.

**Opens up:**

- [Mahogany Town → Team Rocket HQ: the radio-wave investigation (story; where to go next)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch26-mahogany-rocket-hq-glacier-badge/#mahogany-town--team-rocket-hq-the-radio-wave-investigation-story-where-to-go-next)
- [Team Rocket HQ B3F: the two passwords and the Secret Key door (continues Battle Frontier, Cianwood City and Mahogany Town's "Mahogany Town → Team Rocket HQ")](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch26-mahogany-rocket-hq-glacier-badge/#team-rocket-hq-b3f-the-two-passwords-and-the-secret-key-door-continues-battle-frontier-cianwood-city-and-mahogany-towns-mahogany-town--team-rocket-hq)

**The Mahogany Gym.** The Gym reopens because Pryce cancels his retirement. It is a **Double Battle** (you need at least 2 Pokémon) and Pryce refuses anyone carrying a Pokémon whose Ability changes the weather (the check is by species). Win for the **Glacier Badge**. **This closes for good:** the Game Corner magnet cheater in Goldenrod. After the HQ the nurse-assistant in the Mahogany Pokémon Center gives you Durin Berries for the Ice Path, and a flock of Pidgeot and Noctowl squabbles on Route 43.

**Opens up:**

- [Mahogany Gym: Pryce's no-weather Double Battle (the Glacier Badge)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch26-mahogany-rocket-hq-glacier-badge/#mahogany-gym-pryces-no-weather-double-battle-the-glacier-badge)
- [Mahogany Pokémon Center: Durin Berries for the Ice Path (→ 15 Durin Berries)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch26-mahogany-rocket-hq-glacier-badge/#mahogany-pok%C3%A9mon-center-durin-berries-for-the-ice-path--15-durin-berries)
- [Route 43: break up the Pidgeot and Noctowl flock (→ Sharp Beak; after the Rocket HQ)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch26-mahogany-rocket-hq-glacier-badge/#route-43-break-up-the-pidgeot-and-noctowl-flock--sharp-beak-after-the-rocket-hq)

Quests in this chapter:

- Boot Camp Ruins: the Team Rocket PC password (story; Mahogany Rocket base chapter)
- Mahogany Town → Team Rocket HQ: the radio-wave investigation (story; where to go next)
- Team Rocket HQ B3F: the two passwords and the Secret Key door (continues Battle Frontier, Cianwood City and Mahogany Town's "Mahogany Town → Team Rocket HQ")
- Mahogany Gym: Pryce's no-weather Double Battle (the Glacier Badge)
- Mahogany Pokémon Center: Durin Berries for the Ice Path (→ 15 Durin Berries)
- Route 43: break up the Pidgeot and Noctowl flock (→ Sharp Beak; after the Rocket HQ)

---

## Chapter 27: Route 44, the Ice Path, Blackthorn City and the Rising Badge

Source: https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch27-ice-path-blackthorn-rising-badge/

East of Mahogany Town the road runs along Route 44 and through the **Ice Path** to **Blackthorn City**, the home of the Dragon-type Gym. **Clair** doubts your Champion title and sets terms, and the real test is waiting in the **Dragon's Den**, where the Elder gives the **Rising Badge**. That is the eighth Johto Badge and it ends a lot of Johto errands for good.

**Main quest in this chapter:** cross Route 44 and the Ice Path (with Crystal, and a Team Rocket trap for Suicune on B2F), beat Clair with a party of dragons or dragon-shaped Pokémon, and pass the Elder's trial in the Dragon's Den for the **Rising Badge**.

**Before the Rising Badge, these close for good:** coaching Crystal outside the Blackthorn Gym, Sakura's Water Stone request in Ecruteak, the Three Island bikers' errands (Chapter 23), the Razor Claw reward on Route 34 and the Four Island Mystery Stone buyer (Chapter 20 and Chapter 12). Make the Ice Path's **Anti-Age Spray** in this chapter too: you need it in the final chapter.

### Walkthrough

**Route 44.** On the way to the Ice Path you meet a girl with a **Cleffa** (her con men wait on Ice Path 1F) and a boy whose brother has a **Heracross** at the east end.

**Opens up:**

- [Route 44 → Ice Path: the Cleffa con man (→ Dawn Stone)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch27-ice-path-blackthorn-rising-badge/#route-44--ice-path-the-cleffa-con-man--dawn-stone)
- [Route 44: the kid with his brother's Heracross (→ Never-Melt Ice)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch27-ice-path-blackthorn-rising-badge/#route-44-the-kid-with-his-brothers-heracross--never-melt-ice)

**The Ice Path.** Crystal studies the "damp soil" that Suicune leaves behind. On 1F two Trainers duel over an **Icy Rock** (north part of the floor) and there are tutors and extras. On B2F you meet Eusine, and then the "Joy from Blackthorn City": she says Suicune is hurt and sets up a "treatment device". It is a brainwashing trap. You fight two Grunts in a row, then **Rocket Elite Joy**, and Crystal's Meganium destroys the device. In the east part of B2F, reached from B3F, a Swinub Trainer wants **10 Durin Berries** (the Mahogany nurse gives 15) and an old man can make the **Anti-Age Spray**. **You need the spray in the final chapter.**

**Opens up:**

- [Ice Path 1F: the Icy Rock duel (→ Icy Rock)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch27-ice-path-blackthorn-rising-badge/#ice-path-1f-the-icy-rock-duel--icy-rock)
- [Ice Path B2F: Nurse Joy's Suicune trap (story)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch27-ice-path-blackthorn-rising-badge/#ice-path-b2f-nurse-joys-suicune-trap-story)
- [Ice Path B2F: the cursed tunnel, Swinub and the Anti-Age Spray (needed in the final chapter)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch27-ice-path-blackthorn-rising-badge/#ice-path-b2f-the-cursed-tunnel-swinub-and-the-anti-age-spray-needed-in-the-final-chapter)
- [Ice Path / Blackthorn City: small extras](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch27-ice-path-blackthorn-rising-badge/#ice-path--blackthorn-city-small-extras)

**Blackthorn City.** The town has a few errands before you take on the Gym. **Crystal** stands just outside the Gym with her Meganium and offers a practice battle for a **PP Max**: do it before the Dragon's Den. A Blackthorn Trainer has lost his seven Johto Badges; the "Senior Trainer" on Route 45 with the kids only brags about them until you talk to the Blackthorn man (3 Energy Powder). On Route 45 a man looks after hurt wild Pokémon, and his rampaging Dragonite teaches **Outrage**.

**Opens up:**

- [Blackthorn City: coaching Crystal (before the Rising Badge; missable)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch27-ice-path-blackthorn-rising-badge/#blackthorn-city-coaching-crystal-before-the-rising-badge-missable) Missable
- [Blackthorn City → Route 45: the stolen Badges (→ 3 Energy Powder)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch27-ice-path-blackthorn-rising-badge/#blackthorn-city--route-45-the-stolen-badges--3-energy-powder)
- [Route 45: the rampaging Dragonite (→ Outrage tutor)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch27-ice-path-blackthorn-rising-badge/#route-45-the-rampaging-dragonite--outrage-tutor)

**Clair's Gym.** The Gym floor has holes: the wrong tile drops you back to the entrance. Clair will only face you in a **Single Battle** with Dragon-type or dragon-shaped Pokémon and checks your **whole party** against a fixed list (Gyarados, Charizard, Rhydon, Kingdra and so on; Horsea, Onix, Tyranitar and most other Gen 1-4 Pokémon are refused). Beat her (Lv. 85) and she still withholds the Badge: she sends you to the Elder in the Dragon's Den.

**Opens up:**

- [Blackthorn Gym: Clair's dragons-only rule (story; the Rising Badge)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch27-ice-path-blackthorn-rising-badge/#blackthorn-gym-clairs-dragons-only-rule-story-the-rising-badge)

**The Dragon's Den and the Rising Badge.** North of town, **Ace Trainer Ao Run** stops you four steps in. The Dragon Shrine sits behind a whirlpool: examine it with the Volcano Badge to cross. Entering the shrine starts the **Elder's battle** (six Lv. 90 dragons). Then five questions (you cannot fail them), and Clair arrives to give you the **Rising Badge**, TM59 Dragon Pulse and her number. The Elder is also where **Mr. Fuji's Mystery Stone** becomes a **Charizardite**, and without the stone he teaches **Dragon Rush**. **This closes for good** (the Rising Badge): Crystal's coaching outside the Gym, Sakura's Water Stone request, the **Three Island bikers** (and the Protector reward from the Chief), the Razor Claw reward on Route 34 and the Four Island Mystery Stone buyer. Rock Climb works now.

**Opens up:**

- [Dragon's Den: the Elder's trial (the Rising Badge)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch27-ice-path-blackthorn-rising-badge/#dragons-den-the-elders-trial-the-rising-badge)
- [Dragon Shrine: the Mystery Stone becomes a Charizardite, and the Dragon Rush tutor](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch27-ice-path-blackthorn-rising-badge/#dragon-shrine-the-mystery-stone-becomes-a-charizardite-and-the-dragon-rush-tutor)

**Back in Blackthorn City.** Gold and Crystal meet you in front of the Gym: Gold has just won his eighth Badge and asks if you have all eight Johto Badges. With all eight (Zephyr to Rising) he admits he lost the race and gives **5 PP Max**; with any missing he gives **1 PP Up**, and Crystal adds 3 Max Revives either way. **One chance.** Elm in New Bark Town also has a present for all eight Badges: 5 Rare Candy and 5 PP Max.

**Opens up:**

- [Blackthorn City: Gold's Badge race (→ PP Max ×5 or PP Up)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch27-ice-path-blackthorn-rising-badge/#blackthorn-city-golds-badge-race--pp-max-5-or-pp-up)
- [New Bark Town: show Prof. Elm all eight Johto Badges (→ Rare Candy, PP Max)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch27-ice-path-blackthorn-rising-badge/#new-bark-town-show-prof-elm-all-eight-johto-badges--rare-candy-pp-max)

Quests in this chapter:

- Route 44 → Ice Path: the Cleffa con man (→ Dawn Stone)
- Route 44: the kid with his brother's Heracross (→ Never-Melt Ice)
- Ice Path 1F: the Icy Rock duel (→ Icy Rock)
- Ice Path B2F: Nurse Joy's Suicune trap (story)
- Ice Path B2F: the cursed tunnel, Swinub and the Anti-Age Spray (needed in the final chapter)
- Ice Path / Blackthorn City: small extras
- Blackthorn City: coaching Crystal (before the Rising Badge; missable)
- Blackthorn City → Route 45: the stolen Badges (→ 3 Energy Powder)
- Route 45: the rampaging Dragonite (→ Outrage tutor)
- Blackthorn Gym: Clair's dragons-only rule (story; the Rising Badge)
- Dragon's Den: the Elder's trial (the Rising Badge)
- Dragon Shrine: the Mystery Stone becomes a Charizardite, and the Dragon Rush tutor
- Blackthorn City: Gold's Badge race (→ PP Max ×5 or PP Up)
- New Bark Town: show Prof. Elm all eight Johto Badges (→ Rare Candy, PP Max)

---

## Chapter 28: The Silver Conference and the League HQ's First Round

Source: https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch28-silver-conference-hq-round-1/

With the Rising Badge in your case the story returns to the Pokémon League. **President Goodshow** announces the **Silver Conference**, a tournament on Mt. Silver whose best eight Trainers each get one battle against the League Champion: you. That is not the Indigo Conference you already won. At the summit **Giovanni** shows up first; the conference follows; and Goodshow's closing speech starts the **League HQ investigation**, a long series of "rounds" in which the Trainer Affairs desk sends you to places around Kanto and Johto.

**Main quest in this chapter:** hear Goodshow out at League HQ, go up Mt. Silver (the path opens with the Rising Badge), stop Giovanni, battle the eight finalists, then report to Goodshow and take the first order from the Trainer Affairs desk. Round 1 sends you to the Power Plant, Cinnabar Island and Rock Tunnel.

**What opens after the closing ceremony:** the warm stone in the Diglett's Cave statue (the Magma Stone) and, with it, Heatran in Union Cave (Tuesdays). **While the conference runs** the photographer at the foot of Mt. Silver stays away.

### Walkthrough

**League HQ and Mt. Silver.** Go to the Pokémon League administration hall on the Indigo Plateau. Goodshow explains the Silver Conference: Lance and Lorelei will examine the competitors on the mountain, and you will battle the first eight Trainers to reach the summit, one Pokémon battle each. Walk to Mt. Silver (the way beyond the hot-spring lodge is shut until you hold the Rising Badge). On the way up **Giovanni** attacks Lance and Lorelei; step in and **battle Giovanni** yourself. Then at the summit you are the Champion on the stage: the eight finalists (among them a Hoenn Trainer, Yellow, Green or Red, Karate King Kiyo, Silver and Gold) challenge you one at a time, as Singles or Doubles, with a chance to restore your Pokémon between fights.

**The closing ceremony.** After the last battle Goodshow takes the stage, declares the first Silver Conference closed and warns that Team Rocket is hiding. From this moment the **warm stone** in the broken statue in the north-east of the lower Diglett's Cave can be taken (a **Magma Stone**, once only). In Union Cave, **Heatran** sleeps in the lava pool on B1F: put the Magma Stone on the pedestal on a **Tuesday**.

**Opens up:**

- [Diglett's Cave: the warm stone in the statue (after the Silver Conference)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch28-silver-conference-hq-round-1/#digletts-cave-the-warm-stone-in-the-statue-after-the-silver-conference)
- [Union Cave: Heatran in the lava pool (Tuesdays, Magma Stone)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch28-silver-conference-hq-round-1/#union-cave-heatran-in-the-lava-pool-tuesdays-magma-stone)

**The Trainer Affairs desk.** Goodshow's briefing at HQ explains that Team Rocket is after legendary Pokémon and that the League has collected leads from all over the region. Walk north from the Trainer Affairs signs by the hall entrance to the desk at the back: it gives the leads of each **round**, and you must come back and report after finishing **every** lead of a round. If a report is incomplete, the desk just repeats the current leads. **Round 1** sends you to suspicious people at the **Power Plant** (Chapter 9) and then **Cinnabar Island**, and to a secret group in **Rock Tunnel**.

**Opens up:**

- [League HQ: the Trainer Affairs Department's investigations (where to go next)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch28-silver-conference-hq-round-1/#league-hq-the-trainer-affairs-departments-investigations-where-to-go-next)

**Round 1: the Power Plant and Cinnabar.** At the Power Plant (reached over water with Surf) the ecologist warns you and Lawrence's Grunts attack deeper in. On Cinnabar Island, walk up towards the lava in the north-east: **Executive Lawrence** (Lv. 87-88) burns a Paras to lure Moltres, and his Grunts catch it and escape. **This closes for good:** the Egg man and his Egg on Cinnabar.

**Opens up:**

- [Cinnabar Island: Lawrence and Moltres (League HQ investigation), and catching Moltres](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch28-silver-conference-hq-round-1/#cinnabar-island-lawrence-and-moltres-league-hq-investigation-and-catching-moltres)

**Round 1: Rock Tunnel.** In the memorial chamber at the far south end of Rock Tunnel's lower level Goh has joined Team Rocket and is reading the stone with a Rocket "Joy". Win two Double Battles. Then read the stone with a **Wailord in the first party slot and a Relicanth in the sixth** and answer four questions (Yes, No, Yes, "Be ready to fight"): Regirock, Regice and Registeel appear and each joins you as a gift at **Lv. 90**. Report back to the desk when every lead is done.

**Opens up:**

- [Rock Tunnel: Regirock, Regice and Registeel (League HQ investigation)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch28-silver-conference-hq-round-1/#rock-tunnel-regirock-regice-and-registeel-league-hq-investigation)

Quests in this chapter:

- Diglett's Cave: the warm stone in the statue (after the Silver Conference)
- Union Cave: Heatran in the lava pool (Tuesdays, Magma Stone)
- League HQ: the Trainer Affairs Department's investigations (where to go next)
- Cinnabar Island: Lawrence and Moltres (League HQ investigation), and catching Moltres
- Rock Tunnel: Regirock, Regice and Registeel (League HQ investigation)

---

## Chapter 29: League HQ Rounds 2 and 3

Source: https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch29-hq-rounds-2-and-3/

Report round 1 to the Trainer Affairs desk and it hands out **round 2**, then **round 3**. Round 2 stays in Kanto: a museum exhibition in Pewter City and the water ballet at the Cerulean Gym, which leads to the Seafoam Islands. Round 3 sends you all over Johto: the Jade Orb in Violet City, legendary tracks near New Bark Town and Cherrygrove City, people in black in Ilex Forest and ghostly rumours at MooMoo Farm.

**Main quest in this chapter:** finish every lead of round 2, report, then finish every lead of round 3 and report again.

**Temporary effects to know about:** taking the round-3 order makes the MooMoo Farm Miltank fall sick (the Sunflora old lady stops talking until you cure them), and while the golden trophy is missing in Violet City the runner will not do his Rapidash request. **If you want the romance route, do the Goldenrod love reading before the Dream World** (Chapter 20).

### Walkthrough

**Round 2: Pewter Museum and the Cerulean Gym.** The desk sends you to suspicious people at the **Pewter Museum** exhibition and to strangers at the **Cerulean Gym** water ballet. At the Gym, Archie steals Misty's **Blue Orb** and sends it to the Seafoam Islands. In the deep chamber at the Seafoam Islands, Misty joins you for a **Multi Battle** against two Grunts (Lv. 63-65). Then Lawrence has Moltres melt the ice and **Articuno is taken**: a second Multi Battle against Executive Lawrence (Lv. 87-90) and a Grunt. Archie summons **Kyogre** with the Blue Orb and escapes with it. **This closes for good:** the Articuno battle and its TM14 Blizzard (Chapter 10); Articuno itself returns after Lance's visit (Chapter 33). The melted ice walls come back, so melt them yourself to reach the Blue Orb pedestal at the north end.

**Opens up:**

- [Seafoam Islands: Team Rocket and Kyogre (League HQ investigation), and catching Kyogre](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch29-hq-rounds-2-and-3/#seafoam-islands-team-rocket-and-kyogre-league-hq-investigation-and-catching-kyogre)

**Round 3: the Violet Gym and the Jade Orb.** Talk to Falkner in the Violet Gym: a guard reports that the marathon runner's golden trophy was stolen. The runner's house is at the south end of town; a scene plays there and word arrives that former Leader Verdell has taken something from the Gym. Back in the Gym, Falkner tells you the **Jade Orb** is gone. That counts as the Violet lead.

**Opens up:**

- [Violet City: the stolen trophy and the Jade Orb (League HQ round 3)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch29-hq-rounds-2-and-3/#violet-city-the-stolen-trophy-and-the-jade-orb-league-hq-round-3)

**Round 3: legendary tracks at New Bark Town and Cherrygrove City.** Ask Gold and Crystal. In New Bark Town you and Gold fight Cassidy and Butch in a Multi Battle before **Raikou** picks Gold as its Trainer; in Cherrygrove, **Suicune** picks Crystal after her duel with Eusine. These scenes have no quest of their own.

**Round 3: Ilex Forest and the Forest of Time.** The old ranger by the path into the Forest of Time now plays the scene: a boy, **Sammy**, falls out of the past and the injured **Celebi** needs 10 Fresh Water, 10 Sitrus Berries and a lead Pokémon that can make light (Staryu, Starmie, Chinchou, Lanturn, Ampharos, Volbeat or Clamperl). Heal Celebi, hold off two Grunts and follow the five-exit route through the forest (top-middle, top-middle, top-right, top-left, top-middle). At the end Executive Marauder (Lv. 89-90) attacks twice. The reward is a Leaf Stone, a Max Elixir and a PP Max. Afterwards the shrine at the north end of the forest lets you receive **Shaymin** (Gracidea and a Leafeon lead, between 8:00 and 19:59) and then **Celebi** (Shaymin lead, between 20:00 and 7:59).

**Opens up:**

- [Ilex Forest / Forest of Time: Sammy and the injured Celebi (League HQ round 3)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch29-hq-rounds-2-and-3/#ilex-forest--forest-of-time-sammy-and-the-injured-celebi-league-hq-round-3)
- [Forest of Time: the maze of clearings (continues Ilex Forest and Goldenrod City's Forest of Time entries)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch29-hq-rounds-2-and-3/#forest-of-time-the-maze-of-clearings-continues-ilex-forest-and-goldenrod-citys-forest-of-time-entries)
- [Forest of Time: the shrine, Shaymin and Celebi (Gracidea; time of day)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch29-hq-rounds-2-and-3/#forest-of-time-the-shrine-shaymin-and-celebi-gracidea-time-of-day)

**Round 3: MooMoo Farm.** The round-3 order made the Miltank sick: the farmer now asks for help. Say Yes, go into the west stable room and walk to the back wall. Will and Karen open a rift and you are pulled into the **Dream World** (partner choice, a Double Battle against Will and Karen, then the way back). Talk to the farmer again afterwards: he gives you one Moomoo Milk, and the farm is back to normal for good. Report round 3 to the desk when all four leads are done.

**Opens up:**

- [MooMoo Farm: the sick Miltank investigation (League HQ round 3; leads to the Dream World)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch29-hq-rounds-2-and-3/#moomoo-farm-the-sick-miltank-investigation-league-hq-round-3-leads-to-the-dream-world)

Quests in this chapter:

- Seafoam Islands: Team Rocket and Kyogre (League HQ investigation), and catching Kyogre
- Violet City: the stolen trophy and the Jade Orb (League HQ round 3)
- Ilex Forest / Forest of Time: Sammy and the injured Celebi (League HQ round 3)
- Forest of Time: the maze of clearings (continues Ilex Forest and Goldenrod City's Forest of Time entries)
- Forest of Time: the shrine, Shaymin and Celebi (Gracidea; time of day)
- MooMoo Farm: the sick Miltank investigation (League HQ round 3; leads to the Dream World)

---

## Chapter 30: League HQ Round 4

Source: https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch30-hq-round-4/

**Round 4** is the big one. Team Rocket is stealing legendary Pokémon one by one, and the desk sends you to four places: the **Bell Tower** in Ecruteak City, the **Whirl Islands**, **Dark Cave** and the **Lake of Rage**. The Dark Cave lead is a long chain: Giovanni's group takes the Griseous Orb, you chase them through the Distortion World in Reversal Cave, up the Ice Path's cursed tunnel and into the sealed spaces of Dialga and Palkia. (The guide's quest titles call these scenes "final chapter"; the game counts them as part of this round: the desk only accepts your report after the whole chain is done.)

**Main quest in this chapter:** finish every lead of round 4 and report to the Trainer Affairs desk. Round 4 ends with the order to sign up for the Island Pilgrimage (next chapter).

**Get these ready first:** the **Fog Badge** (Morty will not battle you from the moment Ho-Oh is stolen until your final Hall of Fame entry), the **Rainbow Wing** from Archer's room in the Mahogany HQ (Chapter 26), the **Mt. Mortar expedition** finished (Chapter 25) and the **Anti-Age Spray** from the Ice Path (Chapter 27).

### Walkthrough

**The Bell Tower.** Talk to **Morty** in the Gym: he needs a **Rainbow Wing**. With one, he leaves to prepare and the monk at the back of Bell Tower 1F lets you climb the tower. On the roof the "Kimono Girls" dance the Prayer Dance. They are Team Rocket's Joy and her Ditto: fight **Executive Archer and a Grunt** in a Double Battle. Then Goh catches **Ho-Oh** with one ball and they escape. From here until your final Hall of Fame entry Morty will not battle you for the Fog Badge, the Kimono Girls only talk about Team Rocket and Momo's letter cannot be handed over.

**Opens up:**

- [Bell Tower: Ho-Oh is stolen (League HQ round 4; continues Pokémon League, Mt. Silver and New Bark Town's League HQ entry)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch30-hq-round-4/#bell-tower-ho-oh-is-stolen-league-hq-round-4-continues-pok%C3%A9mon-league-mt-silver-and-new-bark-towns-league-hq-entry)

**The Whirl Islands.** Crossing the whirlpools needs the Volcano Badge. Executive Lawrence uses the legendary birds to wake **Lugia**: you battle a Rocket pair, Lawrence and then Lugia itself, but he catches it anyway. (Lugia comes back after the final Hall of Fame.)

**Dark Cave and Reversal Cave.** In Dark Cave, Charon takes the **Griseous Orb** from the shrine in the south-west of the deepest part (it returns after the final Hall of Fame). Giovanni, Charon and three Grunts then wait in front of the ancient statue in **Reversal Cave** on the west side of Route 47. The statue sends you into the **Distortion World**, a maze of warp pads where Escape Ropes do not work. At the end Charon holds you off (Lv. 87-88), Giovanni summons **Giratina** with the orb and leaves, saying he is heading for the deepest part of the Ice Path.

**Opens up:**

- [Reversal Cave: chase Giovanni through the Distortion World (story; warp-pad maze)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch30-hq-round-4/#reversal-cave-chase-giovanni-through-the-distortion-world-story-warp-pad-maze)

**The Ice Path tunnel and the sealed spaces.** On Ice Path B2F, show the boy who guards the tunnel your **Anti-Age Spray** (Chapter 27) and walk to the ancient statue at its end: it sends you to **Dialga's space**. Giovanni is forcing Dialga into a Special Ball and Executive Cyrus (Lv. 89-90) holds you off. Then take the statue on Mt. Mortar B1F (the expedition, Chapter 25) to **Palkia's space**: after Executive Ariana (Lv. 90) the statue sends you on after Giovanni, whose Beedrill finishes Palkia off. He catches it and leaves holding all three keys to "the ultimate power". The Dialga fight keeps the Ice Path tunnel open from then on.

**Opens up:**

- [Dialga's and Palkia's spaces: Team Rocket catches Dialga and Palkia (story)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch30-hq-round-4/#dialgas-and-palkias-spaces-team-rocket-catches-dialga-and-palkia-story)

**The Lake of Rage.** In the house in the north-west corner of the lake, Petrel threatens the man who lives there about "the Pokémon in the lake". Step in and fight **Petrel and a Grunt** (Petrel is Lv. 86-87). He runs away, and the man thanks you and tells you about the three legendary Pokémon of the lake. **After this scene, on Wednesdays** (by the DS clock, once the Mahogany HQ is cleared), the calm-day visitors appear at the lake: Fisherman Carson, Wesley the Wednesday sibling and an item on the ground. The man's three trials (a quiz for **Uxie**, a bond of maximum friendship for **Mesprit** and a battle for **Azelf**) must be done in order, and each Pokémon then waits at the lake on Wednesdays.

When all four leads are done, report to the Trainer Affairs desk.

**Opens up:**

- [Lake of Rage: Petrel at the lake guardian's house (League HQ round 4; continues Pokémon League, Mt. Silver and New Bark Town's League HQ entry)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch30-hq-round-4/#lake-of-rage-petrel-at-the-lake-guardians-house-league-hq-round-4-continues-pok%C3%A9mon-league-mt-silver-and-new-bark-towns-league-hq-entry)
- [Lake of Rage: Uxie, Mesprit and Azelf (knowledge, emotion and willpower; after the Petrel scene)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch30-hq-round-4/#lake-of-rage-uxie-mesprit-and-azelf-knowledge-emotion-and-willpower-after-the-petrel-scene)
- [Lake of Rage: the calm-day visitors (Wednesdays, after the Petrel scene)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch30-hq-round-4/#lake-of-rage-the-calm-day-visitors-wednesdays-after-the-petrel-scene)
- [Lake of Rage: when the "calm day" happens (continues Lake of Rage, Blackthorn City and beyond's lake trio and calm-day visitors)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch30-hq-round-4/#lake-of-rage-when-the-calm-day-happens-continues-lake-of-rage-blackthorn-city-and-beyonds-lake-trio-and-calm-day-visitors)

Quests in this chapter:

- Bell Tower: Ho-Oh is stolen (League HQ round 4; continues Pokémon League, Mt. Silver and New Bark Town's League HQ entry)
- Reversal Cave: chase Giovanni through the Distortion World (story; warp-pad maze)
- Dialga's and Palkia's spaces: Team Rocket catches Dialga and Palkia (story)
- Lake of Rage: Petrel at the lake guardian's house (League HQ round 4; continues Pokémon League, Mt. Silver and New Bark Town's League HQ entry)
- Lake of Rage: Uxie, Mesprit and Azelf (knowledge, emotion and willpower; after the Petrel scene)
- Lake of Rage: the calm-day visitors (Wednesdays, after the Petrel scene)
- Lake of Rage: when the "calm day" happens (continues Lake of Rage, Blackthorn City and beyond's lake trio and calm-day visitors)

---

## Chapter 31: The Island Pilgrimage

Source: https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch31-island-pilgrimage/

After round 4 President Goodshow sends you to the Alto Mare (Sevii) Islands: sign up for the **Island Pilgrimage** on Seven Island as cover, and watch for Team Rocket. The pilgrimage is a trial on each island, in any order. When it is done, the Ritual Shrine on Seven Island opens, **Giovanni takes the Azure Flute** there, and the trail leads on to the Ruins of Alph.

**Main quest in this chapter:** report round 4, sign up with the Seven Island chief, clear the trials of One to Six Island, face the audience battle on Seven Island, follow Team Rocket from the Ritual Shrine to the Ruins of Alph and report to Goodshow.

**Before your final Hall of Fame entry (Chapter 32):** the Six Island chief's trial. The ferries to Four to Seven Island run from the One Island travel agency ($500).

### Walkthrough

**Report round 4 and sign up.** Report round 4 at the Trainer Affairs desk for the pilgrimage order. On Seven Island, the chief (an old man in the middle of the village, a few steps west of the Blissey nurse) lists the chiefs: One Island's library director, Granny Mae on Two Island, the League's engineer on Three Island, the straw-hatted man on Four Island, the monks' Elder on Five Island and the oldest Trainer on Six Island. Say you will take part. Bianca now stands in the Alto Mare Library as well.

**Opens up:**

- [Seven Island: the Island Pilgrimage (start and final trial)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch31-island-pilgrimage/#seven-island-the-island-pilgrimage-start-and-final-trial)

**One Island: the Secret Forest.** Talk to Bianca in the Alto Mare Library first; she then appears on One Island. Follow "Bianca" (really **Latias**) through an illusory tree into the hidden garden. At the fountain Latios appears, then the One Island chief and the real Bianca arrive and Latias reveals herself. Will, Karen and Goh burst in: a Double Battle against Will and Karen (Lv. 90), then Goh. Say yes when the chief offers you **Latios and Latias** (Lv. 80) and take the **Soul Dew**: you need two free party slots. That counts as the One Island trial. With Latios or Latias in your party, a tourist south of the Pokémon Center gives you a photo and **Black Glasses**.

**Opens up:**

- [Secret Forest (One Island): Latios, Latias and the Soul Dew](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch31-island-pilgrimage/#secret-forest-one-island-latios-latias-and-the-soul-dew)
- [One Island: a photo with Latios or Latias (→ Black Glasses)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch31-island-pilgrimage/#one-island-a-photo-with-latios-or-latias--black-glasses)

**Two Island and Three Island.** On Two Island, Granny Mae and Dana fight you one against two in a Double Battle (Lv. 81-82). On Three Island the League's engineer (the northern of the two house doors) sets you the trial of helping a tourist: the father on the south side of the island (a few steps south-east of the Shipyard Ruins entrance) says his daughter is in the **Island Forest** on Six Island. Find her in the north-west of the forest, deal with the wild **Hypno** (Lv. 30; catching it counts as a win), take her home and report back to the engineer. The father only stands there once you have cleared the Dragon's Den (the Rising Badge).

**Opens up:**

- [Two Island: Granny Mae's pilgrimage trial](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch31-island-pilgrimage/#two-island-granny-maes-pilgrimage-trial)
- [Three Island: the engineer's trial](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch31-island-pilgrimage/#three-island-the-engineers-trial)
- [Three Island → Six Island: the lost daughter (Three Island's pilgrimage trial)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch31-island-pilgrimage/#three-island--six-island-the-lost-daughter-three-islands-pilgrimage-trial)

**Four Island and Sky Pillar Peak.** A guard stands next to the northernmost cave entrance at the top of the town: beat **Guitarist Brian** (Lv. 81-82), then climb **Sky Pillar Peak** through the Island Cave. At the top a Team Rocket scene replaces the chief's trial: two Grunts, then **Executive Proton** and a Grunt together. **Ariana catches Rayquaza** with the Jade Orb and escapes anyway. The scene counts as your Four Island pass.

**Opens up:**

- [Four Island: the guard at the Sky Pillar Peak path](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch31-island-pilgrimage/#four-island-the-guard-at-the-sky-pillar-peak-path)
- [Sky Pillar Peak: the Four Island trial (Team Rocket takes Rayquaza)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch31-island-pilgrimage/#sky-pillar-peak-the-four-island-trial-team-rocket-takes-rayquaza)

**Five Island: the monks.** Beat the monk at the south entrance, show another monk a **Cherubi** you caught on the island, push up the snowy mountain past two more sages and talk to the **freezing disciple** at the top. In the monks' hut the Elder asks five questions (the answers are in the quest) and then fights you (Lv. 81-82). After the win, talk to him again and pick "The man on the snowy mountain?": he forgives the disciple, and you climb back up to tell him he may come down. Freeing the disciple is optional for the pilgrimage but starts the long **Mew hunt**: read the four logs on the desk in the Cinnabar lab, then Mew shows itself on Route 1, in Mt. Moon Square, on Route 27 and finally on Five Island, where you battle it at Lv. 90. If you answered No to the Turtwig owner's four-leaf clover on Five Island, he moves to the foot of Mt. Silver: bring Mew there for 3 Revival Herbs.

**Opens up:**

- [Five Island: the Island Pilgrimage leg (Five Island trials)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch31-island-pilgrimage/#five-island-the-island-pilgrimage-leg-five-island-trials)
- [Five Island: the Elder's quiz and battle](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch31-island-pilgrimage/#five-island-the-elders-quiz-and-battle)
- [Mew: the long hunt (Five Island finale)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch31-island-pilgrimage/#mew-the-long-hunt-five-island-finale)
- [Mt. Silver: the Turtwig owner's four-leaf clover](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch31-island-pilgrimage/#mt-silver-the-turtwig-owners-four-leaf-clover)

**Six Island.** Behind the east house door the chief sets his rule: beat him using exactly **Sharpedo, Whiscash and Crawdaunt**, or pay **$50,000**. Either way a man bursts in: a gang is stealing the **Fallen Red Star** north of the door. Executive Marauder and Executive Petrel fight you in a Double Battle while Maxie and Archie shine the Red and Blue Orbs on the stone, and the stone wakes **Deoxys**; Petrel catches it and they escape. **Only before your final Hall of Fame entry** does the chief still offer this trial.

**Opens up:**

- [Six Island: the chief's trial and the Fallen Red Star](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch31-island-pilgrimage/#six-island-the-chiefs-trial-and-the-fallen-red-star) Missable

**Seven Island, the Ritual Shrine and the Ruins of Alph.** Back on Seven Island the chief gathers an audience: a **Double Battle** against **Elder Donglai and Camper Penn** (Lv. 81-82; bring at least two Pokémon). The pilgrimage is complete. In the shrine at the north edge of the village, talk to the shrine keeper (with her Vaporeon): Giovanni, Cyrus and Archer appear, you fight **Executive Archer** (Ho-Oh Lv. 95), and Charon picks up the **Azure Flute**. Team Rocket teleports to the **Ruins of Alph**: reopen the back wall of any of the four chambers, walk to the stone replica statues west of the temple door and fight three battles with no healing in between (Cyrus, Charon, then Archer in a Double Battle). Giovanni calls out Dialga, Palkia and Giratina and catches **Arceus**. Walk out of the temple and report to Goodshow at League HQ.

**Opens up:**

- [Ritual Shrine (Seven Island): Giovanni takes the Azure Flute](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch31-island-pilgrimage/#ritual-shrine-seven-island-giovanni-takes-the-azure-flute)
- [Ruins of Alph: Giovanni catches Arceus (League HQ lead)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch31-island-pilgrimage/#ruins-of-alph-giovanni-catches-arceus-league-hq-lead)

Quests in this chapter:

- Seven Island: the Island Pilgrimage (start and final trial)
- Secret Forest (One Island): Latios, Latias and the Soul Dew
- One Island: a photo with Latios or Latias (→ Black Glasses)
- Two Island: Granny Mae's pilgrimage trial
- Three Island: the engineer's trial
- Three Island → Six Island: the lost daughter (Three Island's pilgrimage trial)
- Four Island: the guard at the Sky Pillar Peak path
- Sky Pillar Peak: the Four Island trial (Team Rocket takes Rayquaza)
- Five Island: the Island Pilgrimage leg (Five Island trials)
- Five Island: the Elder's quiz and battle
- Mew: the long hunt (Five Island finale)
- Mt. Silver: the Turtwig owner's four-leaf clover
- Six Island: the chief's trial and the Fallen Red Star
- Ritual Shrine (Seven Island): Giovanni takes the Azure Flute
- Ruins of Alph: Giovanni catches Arceus (League HQ lead)

---

## Chapter 32: The Final March and the Final Hall of Fame

Source: https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch32-final-march-hall-of-fame/

Goodshow sends you home to rest. While you rest, Team Rocket launches an all-out war: it attacks the Goldenrod Radio Tower and then Pokémon League HQ. As the Hero Champion you broadcast a call to arms from the Radio Tower and then march on the Indigo Plateau through Victory Road, the plateau slope and the Elite Four's rooms, now held by Team Rocket Executives, to Giovanni in the Hall of Fame. Your **final Hall of Fame entry** ends the story. Everything after it is postgame.

**Main quest in this chapter:** broadcast from the Radio Tower, fight through Victory Road (Blue's fake, your companions), win the Multi Battle with Mewtwo's help, beat the four Elite Four rooms, Archer and Ariana, and then Giovanni's three battles in a row.

**Things you can still lose here:** every romance confession (one per game), Mewtwo (take it before the Elite Four), and the Six Island chief's trial (Chapter 31). All of these close with the final Hall of Fame entry. **There is no healing inside the Elite Four's rooms.**

### Walkthrough

**Home and the Radio Tower.** Goodshow tells you to go home and rest while Team Rocket has not yet launched its all-out war. Rest at home in Pallet Town; then Team Rocket attacks the Radio Tower in Goldenrod City and League HQ. Go to the Observation Deck at the top of the Radio Tower: the director lets you broadcast live to the whole region, a call to arms that has the Gym Leaders ship supplies to Goldenrod and Saffron. The broadcast switches on the Victory Road scenes, and it also opens **Misty's confession** in the Cerulean Gym for male players (she asks why you are not at the Indigo Plateau).

**Opens up:**

- [Cerulean Gym / Cerulean Cape: Misty's romance](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch32-final-march-hall-of-fame/#cerulean-gym--cerulean-cape-mistys-romance) Missable

**Victory Road.** On 1F **Blue** is stuck in a stalemate against a Team Rocket fake of himself, and you must say which Blue is real. **"The right one is the real Blue"** is correct; the wrong answer cannot be undone, makes you fight the real Blue as well and closes Blue's romance route for female players. Your companions fight Team Rocket on Victory Road and stay behind to heal: **talk again only to the partner you chose** to get a confession (one per game). On **3F**, after the barrier at the gate is broken, Silver and Crystal have two more scenes, and the side that lost the Vermilion construction-site dispute (Chapter 5) comes back there.

**Opens up:**

- [Victory Road: "Which one is the real Blue?"](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch32-final-march-hall-of-fame/#victory-road-which-one-is-the-real-blue)
- [Romance route: Victory Road confessions, Yellow's dates and your house](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch32-final-march-hall-of-fame/#romance-route-victory-road-confessions-yellows-dates-and-your-house) Missable
- [Victory Road 3F (final chapter): Silver's and Crystal's confessions](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch32-final-march-hall-of-fame/#victory-road-3f-final-chapter-silvers-and-crystals-confessions) Missable

**The Indigo Plateau slope and Mewtwo.** At the top of Victory Road Cyrus and Charon raise a spatial barrier. **Mewtwo** breaks Palkia's barrier and you win a **Multi Battle** at its side. Afterwards Mewtwo waits in the middle of the path, about 28 steps north of the Victory Road exit, and says: "Once you have sorted out your team... come find me here." **Take it before you enter the Elite Four** (it closes for good). About nine steps north of Mewtwo, **Steven** (female players) and **Cynthia** (male players) rest by the path: talk to your chosen partner for a confession if the romance route is on and nobody else has been confessed to.

**Opens up:**

- [Indigo Plateau (final chapter): Mewtwo joins you (take it before the Elite Four)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch32-final-march-hall-of-fame/#indigo-plateau-final-chapter-mewtwo-joins-you-take-it-before-the-elite-four) Missable
- [Indigo Plateau slope (final chapter): Steven's and Cynthia's confessions](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch32-final-march-hall-of-fame/#indigo-plateau-slope-final-chapter-stevens-and-cynthias-confessions) Missable

**The Elite Four's rooms under Team Rocket.** Once you go through the Elite Four door you cannot come back and the attendants cannot heal you; a Rocket nurse in the entrance hall heals your party for **$10,000** a time. In each of the four rooms two Executives wait (Archie and Charon in Lorelei's, Maxie and Cyrus in Agatha's, Proton and Petrel in Bruno's, the Marauder and Lawrence in Lance's): fight them one after the other or as a Double Battle. Then **Archer and Ariana** in a Double Battle.

**Opens up:**

- [Pokémon League (final chapter): the Elite Four rooms under Team Rocket](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch32-final-march-hall-of-fame/#pok%C3%A9mon-league-final-chapter-the-elite-four-rooms-under-team-rocket)

**Giovanni and the final Hall of Fame.** In the Hall of Fame Giovanni waits with three battles in a row: a single battle (Arceus, Dialga, Nidoking, Empoleon and more), a Double Battle against Giovanni and his Cerulean Cave double (Mewtwo, Rhydon, Tyranitar, Arcanine and more), and finally a single battle against a lone **Lv. 100 Beedrill**. Your final entry into the Hall of Fame ends the story and **closes for good** the Six Island chief's trial, Mewtwo, and every confession scene (Victory Road, the plateau slope, Victory Road 3F and Misty's). Postgame starts at home in Pallet Town.

Quests in this chapter:

- Cerulean Gym / Cerulean Cape: Misty's romance
- Victory Road: "Which one is the real Blue?"
- Romance route: Victory Road confessions, Yellow's dates and your house
- Victory Road 3F (final chapter): Silver's and Crystal's confessions
- Indigo Plateau (final chapter): Mewtwo joins you (take it before the Elite Four)
- Indigo Plateau slope (final chapter): Steven's and Cynthia's confessions
- Pokémon League (final chapter): the Elite Four rooms under Team Rocket

---

## Chapter 33: Postgame, Lance's Visit and the Seized Items

Source: https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch33-postgame-lances-visit-seized-items/

The story ends with your final Hall of Fame entry. You wake up at home in Pallet Town, and **Lance** visits with the legendary items that were seized from Team Rocket. They are the keys to most of the postgame: the Red, Blue, Jade, Adamant and Lustrous Orbs, plus the Silver Wing and the Rainbow Wing. Johto's side of the postgame is in the next chapter.

**Main quest in this chapter:** none; this is the postgame. Walk into your house in Pallet Town to start Lance's visit, then use the orbs: Groudon in Mt. Moon, Kyogre in the Seafoam Islands, Rayquaza on Four Island, Deoxys on Six Island, and Dialga, Palkia and Giratina, with Regigigas and Arceus at the Sinjoh Ruins.

**One chance each, so save first:** Groudon, Kyogre, Rayquaza, Deoxys, Dialga, Palkia, Giratina, Regigigas and Arceus all disappear for good if you catch them, knock them out or run away. A loss lets you retry only where the quest says so.

### Walkthrough

**Lance's visit.** When you step onto the ground floor of your house, Mom invites you to watch President Goodshow's live speech about the Team Rocket affair. Then Lance arrives with the seized items: the **Silver Wing**, **Rainbow Wing**, **Red Orb**, **Blue Orb**, **Jade Orb**, **Adamant Orb** and **Lustrous Orb**. (The Griseous Orb is not among them.) The visit also brings **Articuno** back to the Seafoam Islands, **Cresselia and Darkrai** to the Dream World, **Dialga, Palkia and Giratina** to their places, and the **Fallen Red Star** back to Six Island. The Elite Four are back in their rooms and **Zapdos** (Power Plant) and **Moltres** (Cinnabar) can be caught.

**Opens up:**

- [Pallet Town: Lance's visit home (after the final Hall of Fame)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch33-postgame-lances-visit-seized-items/#pallet-town-lances-visit-home-after-the-final-hall-of-fame) Post-game
- [Power Plant: Zapdos and the ecologist](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch09-fuchsia-soul-badge/#power-plant-zapdos-and-the-ecologist)
- [Cinnabar Island: Lawrence and Moltres (League HQ investigation), and catching Moltres](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch28-silver-conference-hq-round-1/#cinnabar-island-lawrence-and-moltres-league-hq-investigation-and-catching-moltres)

**Kanto.** In the deepest part of **Mt. Moon's inner cave**, at the altar where Maxie summoned Groudon, use the **Red Orb**: a wild **Groudon**. In the deep chamber of the **Seafoam Islands**, melt the ice, then catch **Articuno** (back since Lance's visit) and use the **Blue Orb** on the pedestal at the north end for **Kyogre** (Lv. 95).

**Opens up:**

- [Mt. Moon: Groudon (post-game, Red Orb)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch33-postgame-lances-visit-seized-items/#mt-moon-groudon-post-game-red-orb) Post-game
- [Seafoam Islands: the ice walls, Articuno and the researcher (TM14 Blizzard)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch10-cinnabar-volcano-badge/#seafoam-islands-the-ice-walls-articuno-and-the-researcher-tm14-blizzard) Missable
- [Seafoam Islands: Team Rocket and Kyogre (League HQ investigation), and catching Kyogre](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch29-hq-rounds-2-and-3/#seafoam-islands-team-rocket-and-kyogre-league-hq-investigation-and-catching-kyogre)

**The Sevii Islands.** On **Four Island**, climb Sky Pillar Peak with the **Jade Orb** for **Rayquaza**. On **Six Island**, check the Fallen Red Star with both the **Red and Blue Orbs** in your Bag: a wild **Deoxys** (Lv. 95), one chance. The chief then demands a fortune; **Jessie, James and Meowth** work at the Island Restaurant on One Island, and the "Meowth God" settles the claim. **This closes for good** the Island Forest errands (the toll thug, the stolen doll and the wishing pond, and the Crawdaunt wallet thief) if you let the trio stay on Six Island, so finish those first. The shrine keeper at the Ritual Shrine on Seven Island may offer to lend the **Azure Flute**, but in a normal game the offer cannot be reached. With Latias leading your party, the fountain in the Secret Forest on One Island also has a short extra scene.

**Opens up:**

- [Sky Pillar Peak: Rayquaza (post-game, Jade Orb)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch33-postgame-lances-visit-seized-items/#sky-pillar-peak-rayquaza-post-game-jade-orb) Post-game
- [Six Island: Deoxys and the Lucky Meowth God (post-game)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch33-postgame-lances-visit-seized-items/#six-island-deoxys-and-the-lucky-meowth-god-post-game) Post-game
- [Ritual Shrine: borrowing the Azure Flute (post-game; probably unobtainable)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch33-postgame-lances-visit-seized-items/#ritual-shrine-borrowing-the-azure-flute-post-game-probably-unobtainable) Post-game
- [Secret Forest (One Island): Latios, Latias and the Soul Dew](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch31-island-pilgrimage/#secret-forest-one-island-latios-latias-and-the-soul-dew)

**Dialga, Palkia, Giratina and the Sinjoh Ruins.** With Lance's visit done, Dialga and Palkia are back at the north ends of their spaces (from the Ice Path and from Mt. Mortar) and Giratina at the end of the Distortion World in Reversal Cave. After the final Hall of Fame entry the Ice Path statue only works if you carry the **Adamant Orb**. Then, with **Dialga, Palkia and Giratina all in your party** and the **Azure Flute** in your Bag, step into the centre circle of the Sinjoh Ruins (the Ruins of Alph's temple of Arceus), fight **Regigigas** (Lv. 95) on the path to the steps, and call **Arceus**. If you could not get the flute, Arceus stays out of reach.

**Opens up:**

- [Dialga, Palkia and Giratina: catch them (after Lance's visit)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch33-postgame-lances-visit-seized-items/#dialga-palkia-and-giratina-catch-them-after-lances-visit) Post-game
- [Sinjoh Ruins (temple of Arceus): Regigigas and Arceus (after the final Hall of Fame)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch33-postgame-lances-visit-seized-items/#sinjoh-ruins-temple-of-arceus-regigigas-and-arceus-after-the-final-hall-of-fame) Post-game

**Dates.** After the final Hall of Fame entry the partners' dates open (if the romance route is on and you have confessed to someone). **Misty** (male players) offers a Resort Zone date from the Cerulean Gym menu with four Multi Battles in a row; winning the Couples Double Battle can leave her missing from the Gym afterwards, so save before. **Green or Red** (the reverse of every other partner) lives with their parents in the house on Route 30 and only offers dates if you have never confessed to anyone. Yellow's dates in Viridian City are in Chapter 32's romance entry.

**Opens up:**

- [Resort Zone: Misty's date, the Pal Park and the Couples Double Battle](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch33-postgame-lances-visit-seized-items/#resort-zone-mistys-date-the-pal-park-and-the-couples-double-battle)
- [Route 30: Green's (or Red's) dates (after the final Hall of Fame)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch33-postgame-lances-visit-seized-items/#route-30-greens-or-reds-dates-after-the-final-hall-of-fame) Post-game

Quests in this chapter:

- Pallet Town: Lance's visit home (after the final Hall of Fame)
- Mt. Moon: Groudon (post-game, Red Orb)
- Sky Pillar Peak: Rayquaza (post-game, Jade Orb)
- Six Island: Deoxys and the Lucky Meowth God (post-game)
- Ritual Shrine: borrowing the Azure Flute (post-game; probably unobtainable)
- Dialga, Palkia and Giratina: catch them (after Lance's visit)
- Sinjoh Ruins (temple of Arceus): Regigigas and Arceus (after the final Hall of Fame)
- Resort Zone: Misty's date, the Pal Park and the Couples Double Battle
- Route 30: Green's (or Red's) dates (after the final Hall of Fame)

---

## Chapter 34: Postgame, the Legends of Johto

Source: https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch34-postgame-johto-legends/

The second half of the postgame is Johto's: **Prof. Hale and Molly** free the three legendary beasts at the Burned Tower, Satsuki and Morty bring back **Ho-Oh** and **Lugia**, Dark Cave returns the Griseous Orb, and the Dream World's **Cresselia and Darkrai** are back. All of this needs your final Hall of Fame entry and, for most of it, **Lance's visit** (Chapter 33).

**Main quest in this chapter:** none; this is the postgame.

**Do this first, it can be lost:** the Burned Tower scene with Prof. Hale and Molly. **Do not talk to the leader of the Mt. Mortar expedition again** before you have seen it: if you say Yes to "Are you a really strong Trainer?" and beat him, the scene never plays and Entei, Raikou and Suicune never appear. Answer No to be safe.

**One chance each, so save first:** Raikou, Suicune, Entei, Lugia, Ho-Oh's trainer-style fight, Cresselia and Darkrai.

### Walkthrough

**The Burned Tower and the three beasts.** After Lance's visit, walk into the Burned Tower basement where the Sealing Mirror stood. **Prof. Hale and Molly** meet Entei, Raikou and Suicune, and all three run off. This unlocks their postgame encounters: **Suicune** on Cerulean Cape (Route 25) in Kanto, **Raikou** on Route 47 at the spot where Will's device stood, and **Entei** in the dream room of the Ruins of Alph. Before the scene, do **not** rematch the Mt. Mortar expedition leader (see above).

**Opens up:**

- [Burned Tower: Prof. Hale, Molly and the three beasts (post-game; frees Entei, Suicune, Raikou)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch34-postgame-johto-legends/#burned-tower-prof-hale-molly-and-the-three-beasts-post-game-frees-entei-suicune-raikou) Missable Post-game
- [Route 47: Raikou (after the final Hall of Fame)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch34-postgame-johto-legends/#route-47-raikou-after-the-final-hall-of-fame) Missable Post-game
- [Route 25: Suicune (post-game)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch34-postgame-johto-legends/#route-25-suicune-post-game) Missable Post-game
- [Ruins of Alph: small extras](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch18-ruins-of-alph-union-cave/#ruins-of-alph-small-extras)

**Rematching the Mt. Mortar leader first.** If you walk into the Mt. Mortar expedition (Chapter 25) after Lance's visit and beat its leader before the Burned Tower scene has played, the scene is lost for good and so are the three beasts. Answer No to his question.

**Ho-Oh, Lugia and the Griseous Orb.** In Ecruteak's Dance Theater, **Satsuki**, the eldest Kimono Girl, lets you ask to see **Ho-Oh** or **Lugia**. For Ho-Oh, Morty gives you the **Clear Bell** after a Single Battle against his full team, then you climb the Bell Tower roof and fight Ho-Oh (Lv. 95) trainer-style before the catch. For Lugia she sends the sisters to the Whirl Islands (Lugia, one chance). In **Dark Cave**, the old woman by the Route 45 entrance says the League sent the **Griseous Orb** back: take it from the shrine in the deepest part.

**Opens up:**

- [Dance Theater → Bell Tower: catch Ho-Oh (after the final Hall of Fame)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch34-postgame-johto-legends/#dance-theater--bell-tower-catch-ho-oh-after-the-final-hall-of-fame) Post-game
- [Whirl Islands: catch Lugia (after the final Hall of Fame)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch34-postgame-johto-legends/#whirl-islands-catch-lugia-after-the-final-hall-of-fame) Post-game
- [Dark Cave: the Griseous Orb returns (after the final Hall of Fame entry)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch34-postgame-johto-legends/#dark-cave-the-griseous-orb-returns-after-the-final-hall-of-fame-entry) Post-game

**The Battle Frontier and the Forest of Time.** At Frontier Access, the man beside the damaged stone on the east side explains it was dug up during the Frontier's construction and nothing could break it; after the final entry it leads to **Jirachi** (see the quest). In the Frontier Access Pokémon Center the psychic on the right now offers his memory battles. In the **Forest of Time**, if the S.S. Anne **sank** and you have both Shaymin and Celebi, lead with Celebi at the shrine and answer "I can't watch innocents be killed": Celebi takes you back to the ship to fight Archie, undoing the sinking.

**Opens up:**

- [Frontier Access: the damaged stone and Jirachi (after the final Hall of Fame)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch34-postgame-johto-legends/#frontier-access-the-damaged-stone-and-jirachi-after-the-final-hall-of-fame) Post-game
- [Frontier Access Pokémon Center: the psychic's memory battles (after the final Hall of Fame)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch34-postgame-johto-legends/#frontier-access-pok%C3%A9mon-center-the-psychics-memory-battles-after-the-final-hall-of-fame) Post-game
- [Forest of Time: Celebi takes you back to the S.S. Anne (post-game; only if the ship sank)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch34-postgame-johto-legends/#forest-of-time-celebi-takes-you-back-to-the-ss-anne-post-game-only-if-the-ship-sank) Post-game

**The Dream World.** In the MooMoo Farm stable on Route 39, enter by the west door and examine the spot at the back wall: the energy warps you to the Dream World (the game does not actually check the Lunar Wing). **Cresselia** waits on the west side and **Darkrai** on the east side, both at Lv. 90, one chance each. The broken statue at the north end brings you back.

**Opens up:**

- [Dream World: Cresselia and Darkrai (post-game)](https://originheartgold.github.io/guide/ch34-postgame-johto-legends/#dream-world-cresselia-and-darkrai-post-game) Post-game

Quests in this chapter:

- Burned Tower: Prof. Hale, Molly and the three beasts (post-game; frees Entei, Suicune, Raikou)
- Route 47: Raikou (after the final Hall of Fame)
- Route 25: Suicune (post-game)
- Dance Theater → Bell Tower: catch Ho-Oh (after the final Hall of Fame)
- Whirl Islands: catch Lugia (after the final Hall of Fame)
- Dark Cave: the Griseous Orb returns (after the final Hall of Fame entry)
- Frontier Access: the damaged stone and Jirachi (after the final Hall of Fame)
- Frontier Access Pokémon Center: the psychic's memory battles (after the final Hall of Fame)
- Forest of Time: Celebi takes you back to the S.S. Anne (post-game; only if the ship sank)
- Dream World: Cresselia and Darkrai (post-game)
